if type(string.split) ~= "function" then
string.split = function(str, sep)
sep = sep or " "
local res = {}
if sep == "" then
for i = 1, #str do table.insert(res, string.sub(str, i, i)) end
return res
end
local start = 1
local s, e = string.find(str, sep, start, true)
while s do
table.insert(res, string.sub(str, start, s - 1))
start = e + 1
s, e = string.find(str, sep, start, true)
end
table.insert(res, string.sub(str, start))
return res
end
end
if type(math.clamp) ~= "function" then
math.clamp = function(x, a, b)
if x < a then return a end
if x > b then return b end
return x
end
end
if type(math.round) ~= "function" then
math.round = function(x) return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
end
if type(table.find) ~= "function" then
table.find = function(t, v)
for i, x in ipairs(t) do if x == v then return i end end
return nil
end
end
if type(table.clear) ~= "function" then
table.clear = function(t)
for k in pairs(t) do t[k] = nil end
end
end

-- [3] B1RKT OTOMATIK OWNER ALGILAMA VE KISIYE OZEL PREFIX MOTORU
local ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME = "B1rkt"
TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername = TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername or {}
local function ResolvePlayerRankLevel(playerOrName)
local username = typeof(playerOrName) == "Instance" and playerOrName.Name or tostring(playerOrName or "")
for savedUser, expLvl in pairs(TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername or {}) do
if string.lower(savedUser) == string.lower(username) and type(expLvl) == "number" then
local clamped = math.clamp(math.floor(expLvl), 0, 999)
TableDB.RanksByUsername[username] = clamped
return clamped
end
end
if username == ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME or string.lower(username) == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME) then
TableDB.RanksByUsername[username] = 10
return 10
end
if username == LocalPlayer.Name then
local currentSaved = TableDB.RanksByUsername[username]
if type(currentSaved) == "number" and currentSaved > 1 then
return math.clamp(math.floor(currentSaved), 0, 999)
end
TableDB.RanksByUsername[username] = 9
return 9
end
for savedUser, savedLevel in pairs(TableDB.RanksByUsername or {}) do
if string.lower(savedUser) == string.lower(username) and type(savedLevel) == "number" then
return math.clamp(math.floor(savedLevel), 0, 999)
end
end
TableDB.RanksByUsername[username] = 1
return 1
end
local function ResolvePersonalPrefix(username)
local savedPfx = TableDB.PrefixesByUsername[username]
if type(savedPfx) == "string" and #savedPfx > 0 then
return savedPfx
end
return TableDB.DefaultPrefix or ";"
end
local function GetTierData(level)
if DEFAULT_TIERS[level] then
return DEFAULT_TIERS[level]
end
local bestMatch = DEFAULT_TIERS[1]
local highestFound = -1
for lvl, data in pairs(DEFAULT_TIERS) do
if level >= lvl and lvl > highestFound then
highestFound = lvl
bestMatch = data
end
end
return bestMatch
end
local function ResolveTierLevelByInput(inputVal)
if type(inputVal) == "number" then
return math.clamp(math.floor(inputVal), 0, 999)
end
local str = string.gsub(tostring(inputVal or ""), "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
local asNum = tonumber(str)
if asNum then
return math.clamp(math.floor(asNum), 0, 999)
end
local lowerStr = string.lower(str)
for lvl, tData in pairs(DEFAULT_TIERS) do
if string.lower(tostring(tData.Name or "")) == lowerStr
or string.lower(tostring(tData.TurkishName or "")) == lowerStr
or string.lower(tostring(tData.Id or "")) == lowerStr
or string.lower(tostring(tData.CoreGroup or "")) == lowerStr then
return lvl
end
end
for lvl, tData in pairs(DEFAULT_TIERS) do
if string.find(string.lower(tostring(tData.Name or "")), lowerStr, 1, true)
or string.find(string.lower(tostring(tData.Id or "")), lowerStr, 1, true) then
return lvl
end
end
return nil
end

-- [7] GELISMIS HEDEF OYUNCU COZUMLEYICI (me, others, all, random, berks, isim, ismin basi, displayName)
local function ResolveTargetPlayers(selectorRaw)
local sel = string.lower(string.gsub(selectorRaw or State.SelectedTargetMode or "me", "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
sel = string.gsub(sel, '^["\']+(.-)["\']+$', "%1")
sel = string.gsub(sel, '^["\']+', "")
sel = string.gsub(sel, '["\']+$', "")
local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
local results = {}
if sel == "" or sel == "me" or sel == "self" or sel == "ben" then
return { LocalPlayer }
elseif sel == "all" or sel == "everyone" or sel == "herkes" or sel == "*" then
return allPlayers
elseif sel == "others" or sel == "other" or sel == "digerleri" then
for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
if p ~= LocalPlayer then
table.insert(results, p)
end
end
return results
elseif sel == "random" or sel == "rastgele" then
if #allPlayers > 0 then
return { allPlayers[math.random(1, #allPlayers)] }
end
return {}
elseif sel == "berks" or sel == "peers" or sel == "admins" then
for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
if State.ActivePeers[p.Name] or p == LocalPlayer then
table.insert(results, p)
end
end
return results
end
for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
if string.lower(p.Name) == sel or string.lower(p.DisplayName) == sel then
return { p }
end
end
for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
if string.sub(string.lower(p.Name), 1, #sel) == sel or string.sub(string.lower(p.DisplayName), 1, #sel) == sel then
table.insert(results, p)
end
end
if #results > 0 then
return results
end
for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
if string.find(string.lower(p.Name), sel, 1, true) or string.find(string.lower(p.DisplayName), sel, 1, true) then
table.insert(results, p)
end
end
return results
end

local function RecordPlayerP2PEffect(plrName, effectTag, enable)

function Engine.ParseCommandTokensWithQuotes(cleanStr)
local tokens = {}
local i = 1
local n = #cleanStr
while i <= n do
while i <= n and string.match(string.sub(cleanStr, i, i), "%s") do
i = i + 1
end
if i > n then break end
local ch = string.sub(cleanStr, i, i)
if ch == '"' or ch == "'" then
local q = ch
i = i + 1
local startIdx = i
while i <= n and string.sub(cleanStr, i, i) ~= q do
i = i + 1
end
local extracted = string.sub(cleanStr, startIdx, i - 1)
extracted = string.gsub(extracted, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
table.insert(tokens, extracted)
if i <= n and string.sub(cleanStr, i, i) == q then
i = i + 1
end
else
local startIdx = i
while i <= n and not string.match(string.sub(cleanStr, i, i), "%s") do
i = i + 1
end
local tok = string.sub(cleanStr, startIdx, i - 1)
tok = string.gsub(tok, '^["\']+(.-)["\']+$', "%1")
table.insert(tokens, tok)
end
end
return tokens
end
function Engine.GetSortedPlayersByUserId()
local list = Players:GetPlayers()
table.sort(list, function(a, b)
return (a.UserId or 0) < (b.UserId or 0)
end)
return list
end
function Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(targetNameOrSelector)
local raw = string.lower(tostring(targetNameOrSelector or "all"))
raw = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
raw = string.gsub(raw, '^["\']+(.-)["\']+$', "%1")
raw = string.gsub(raw, '^["\']+', "")
raw = string.gsub(raw, '["\']+$', "")
if raw == "" or raw == "all" or raw == "everyone" or raw == "herkes" or raw == "*" then
return 0
elseif raw == "others" or raw == "other" or raw == "digerleri" then
return 99
elseif raw == "me" or raw == "self" or raw == "ben" or raw == string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name) then
return 98
end
local sorted = Engine.GetSortedPlayersByUserId()
for idx, plr in ipairs(sorted) do
if string.lower(plr.Name) == raw or string.lower(plr.DisplayName) == raw then
return math.clamp(idx, 1, 95)
end
end
for idx, plr in ipairs(sorted) do
if string.sub(string.lower(plr.Name), 1, #raw) == raw or string.sub(string.lower(plr.DisplayName), 1, #raw) == raw then
return math.clamp(idx, 1, 95)
end
end
return 0
end
function Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
if targetSlot == 0 then
return Players:GetPlayers()
elseif targetSlot == 98 then
return sender and { sender } or {}
elseif targetSlot == 99 then
local res = {}
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if p ~= sender then
table.insert(res, p)
end
end
return res
else
local sorted = Engine.GetSortedPlayersByUserId()
local matched = sorted[targetSlot]
if matched then
return { matched }
end
end
return {}
end
function Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, carrierIndex)
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
if not char then return end
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hum then return end
local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", hum)
local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
local carrierPool = {
"rbxassetid://507770239", -- R15 wave
"rbxassetid://507770453", -- R15 point
"rbxassetid://507770677", -- R15 cheer
"rbxassetid://507770818", -- R15 laugh
"rbxassetid://507771019", -- R15 dance1
"rbxassetid://507771955", -- R15 dance1_b
"rbxassetid://507772104", -- R15 dance1_c
"rbxassetid://507776043", -- R15 dance2
"rbxassetid://507776720", -- R15 dance2_b
"rbxassetid://507776879", -- R15 dance2_c
"rbxassetid://507777268", -- R15 dance3
"rbxassetid://507777451", -- R15 dance3_b
"rbxassetid://507777623", -- R15 dance3_c
"rbxassetid://507768375", -- R15 toolnone
"rbxassetid://507765644", -- R15 climb
"rbxassetid://128777973", -- R6 wave
"rbxassetid://128853357", -- R6 point
"rbxassetid://129423131", -- R6 laugh
"rbxassetid://129423030"  -- R6 cheer
}
if animateScript then
for _, child in ipairs(animateScript:GetChildren()) do
local cName = string.lower(child.Name)
if cName ~= "idle" and cName ~= "walk" and cName ~= "run" and cName ~= "jump" and cName ~= "fall" then
for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
if desc:IsA("Animation") and type(desc.AnimationId) == "string" and #desc.AnimationId > 5 then
table.insert(carrierPool, desc.AnimationId)
end
end
end
end
end
State.P2PCarrierRingCursor = ((State.P2PCarrierRingCursor or 0) + (carrierIndex or 1)) % #carrierPool + 1
local chosenAnimId = carrierPool[State.P2PCarrierRingCursor]
local clampedPacketInt = math.clamp(math.floor(packetInt or 100), 1, 7999999)
local encodedSpeed = 8.0 + (clampedPacketInt / 1024.0)
pcall(function()
local carrierAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
carrierAnim.Name = "BerksP2PCarrier_" .. tostring(clampedPacketInt)
carrierAnim.AnimationId = chosenAnimId
local track = animator:LoadAnimation(carrierAnim)
track.Looped = true
track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
track:Play(0.01, 0.001, encodedSpeed)
track:AdjustSpeed(encodedSpeed)
task.delay(0.03, function()
pcall(function()
if track.IsPlaying then
track:AdjustSpeed(encodedSpeed)
end
end)
end)
task.delay(0.46, function()
pcall(function()
track:Stop(0.01)
carrierAnim:Destroy()
end)
end)
end)
end
function Engine.BroadcastRawP2PPacketInt(packetInt, carrierOffset)
if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then return end
Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, carrierOffset or 1)
if type(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) == "table" then
for peerName, callback in pairs(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) do
if peerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name and type(callback) == "function" then
task.spawn(callback, LocalPlayer, "RAW_INT", packetInt)
end
end
end
end
local function BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket(actionName, targetName, payloadValue)
if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then return end
if State.IsInsideCommandExecution and actionName ~= "SETRANK" and actionName ~= "PREFIX_SYNC" and actionName ~= "HANDSHAKE" and actionName ~= "FULL_SYNC" and actionName ~= "GLOBAL_ANNOUNCE" and actionName ~= "WARN_MODAL" and actionName ~= "FORCE_CHAT" and actionName ~= "ADMINMODE_ON" and actionName ~= "ADMINMODE_OFF" and actionName ~= "LOCUST_ON" and actionName ~= "LOCUST_OFF" and actionName ~= "POLARIA_SYNC" and actionName ~= "POLARIA_OPEN" and actionName ~= "TOPK3K_OPEN" and actionName ~= "REAL_FLOOD" and actionName ~= "VOID_CLEAR_TERRAIN" and actionName ~= "PATRICK_HORROR" and actionName ~= "PRIMADON_ON" and actionName ~= "PRIMADON_OFF" and actionName ~= "PRIMADON_STOMP" and actionName ~= "F3X_SYNC" and actionName ~= "POLARIA_ACTION" and actionName ~= "TOPK3K_ACTION" and actionName ~= "GIANT" and actionName ~= "TINY" and actionName ~= "NORMALSCALE" and actionName ~= "HEADSCALE" and actionName ~= "ANIM_SYNC" and actionName ~= "INSTANT_RESPAWN" and actionName ~= "RAGDOLL" and actionName ~= "UNRAGDOLL" then
return
end
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
if not char then return end
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
if not hum then return end
local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", hum)
local opcodeMap = {
HANDSHAKE = "01", KICK = "02", BAN = "03", FREEZE = "04", THAW = "05",
JAIL = "06", UNJAIL = "07", KILL = "08", BRING = "09", FLING = "10",
SETRANK = "11", GLOBAL_ANNOUNCE = "12", WARN_MODAL = "13", FORCE_CHAT = "14",
BLIND = "15", UNBLIND = "16", CONFUSE = "17", UNCONFUSE = "18",
RAGDOLL = "19", UNRAGDOLL = "20", SKYFLING = "21", VOIDFLING = "22",
ORBITFLING = "23", GIANT = "24", TINY = "25", NORMALSCALE = "26",
RAINBOW = "27", UNRAINBOW = "28", DISCO = "29", UNDISCO = "30",
SEIZURE = "31", UNSEIZURE = "32", GLITCH = "33", UNGLITCH = "34",
SINK = "35", UNSINK = "36", ELEVATE = "37", EARTHQUAKE = "38",
TORNADO = "39", METEOR = "40", SHOCKWAVE = "41", PREFIX_SYNC = "42",
FULL_SYNC = "43", ADMINMODE_ON = "44", ADMINMODE_OFF = "45", LOCUST_ON = "46", LOCUST_OFF = "47", POLARIA_SYNC = "48", POLARIA_OPEN = "49", TOPK3K_OPEN = "50", REAL_FLOOD = "51", VOID_CLEAR_TERRAIN = "52", PATRICK_HORROR = "53", PRIMADON_ON = "54", PRIMADON_OFF = "55", PRIMADON_STOMP = "56", F3X_SYNC = "57", POLARIA_ACTION = "58", TOPK3K_ACTION = "59", HEADSCALE = "60", ANIM_SYNC = "61", INSTANT_RESPAWN = "62"
}
local channels = { "idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "dance" }
local opcode = opcodeMap[actionName] or "01"
local opcodeNum = tonumber(opcode) or 1
local targetPlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName or "")
local targetUid = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.UserId or 0
local channelIdx = opcodeNum % #channels + 1
local chosenChannel = channels[channelIdx]
local targetSlot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(targetName)

local animObj = channelFolder:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation")

end
end
end)
end
local numPayload = tonumber(payloadValue) or 0
local clampedParam = math.clamp(math.floor(numPayload + 0.5), 0, 999)
-- TEK KANAL ATOMIK BIT-PACKED FLOAT32 PAKETI (1,000,000 .. 7,999,999):
-- Opcode (01..69) + TargetSlot (00..99) + Param (000..999) TEK ANIMASYONDA GIDER (Sifir Yaris Durumu!)
local atomicPacketInt = 1000000 + (opcodeNum * 100000) + (math.clamp(targetSlot or 0, 0, 99) * 1000) + clampedParam
Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(atomicPacketInt, channelIdx)
if type(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) == "table" then
for peerName, callback in pairs(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) do
if peerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name and type(callback) == "function" then
task.spawn(callback, LocalPlayer, "OPCODE", opcode, targetSlot, payloadValue)
end
end
end
end
function Engine.BroadcastUniversalP2PCommand(resolvedCmd, args, targets, rawSelector)
if State.IsExecutingFromP2P or not resolvedCmd or not resolvedCmd.CmdIndex then return end
local hasPrePacket = false
local numArg = tonumber(args and (args[2] or args[1]))
if numArg and numArg >= 0 and numArg <= 9900 then
hasPrePacket = true
Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(80000 + math.floor(numArg), 2)
elseif args and args[2] and not tonumber(args[2]) then
local secondSlot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(args[2])
if secondSlot and secondSlot > 0 and secondSlot <= 95 then
hasPrePacket = true
Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(80000 + 9900 + secondSlot, 2)
end
end
local sel = string.lower(tostring(rawSelector or ""))
if resolvedCmd.Name == "uncontrol" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unfollow" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unorbit" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unloopgoto" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unbackpack" then
sel = "all"
end
local function dispatchMainCommandPackets()
if sel == "all" or sel == "everyone" or sel == "herkes" or sel == "*" then
local packetInt = (resolvedCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + 0
Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, 1)
elseif sel == "others" or sel == "other" or sel == "digerleri" then
local packetInt = (resolvedCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + 99
Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, 1)
elseif sel == "" or sel == "me" or sel == "self" or sel == "ben" or (#targets == 1 and targets[1] == LocalPlayer) then
local packetInt = (resolvedCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + 98
Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, 1)
else
for idx, tPlr in ipairs(targets) do
local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(tPlr.Name)
local packetInt = (resolvedCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + slot
Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, idx)
end
end
end
if hasPrePacket then
task.delay(0.065, dispatchMainCommandPackets)
else
dispatchMainCommandPackets()
end
if type(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) == "table" then
for peerName, callback in pairs(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) do
if peerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name and type(callback) == "function" then
task.spawn(callback, LocalPlayer, "CMD", resolvedCmd.CmdIndex, sel, args)
end
end
end
end

if hum then
hum.PlatformStand = true

end
local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
bav.Name = "BerksAdmin_P2PFlingAngular"
bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
bav.P = math.huge
local rot = spinSpeed or 99999
bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(rot, rot, rot)
bav.Parent = hrp
hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocityVec or Vector3.new(math.random(-28000, 28000), 42000, math.random(-28000, 28000))
hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(rot, rot, rot)
task.delay(0.65, function()
if bav and bav.Parent then
bav:Destroy()
end
end)
end
function Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(char, scaleFactor)
if not char then return end
local targetScale = math.clamp(tonumber(scaleFactor) or 1.0, 0.1, 45.0)
local prevScale = tonumber(char:GetAttribute("Berks_CurrentScale")) or 1.0
local ratio = targetScale / prevScale
char:SetAttribute("Berks_CurrentScale", targetScale)
local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hrp and not char.PrimaryPart then
pcall(function() char.PrimaryPart = hrp end)
end
if hum then
for _, scaleProp in ipairs({ "BodyDepthScale", "BodyHeightScale", "BodyWidthScale", "HeadScale" }) do
local numVal = hum:FindFirstChild(scaleProp)
if numVal and numVal:IsA("NumberValue") then
numVal.Value = targetScale
end
end
end
local beforeHrpY = hrp and hrp.Size.Y or 2.0
local scaledViaModel = false
pcall(function()
char:ScaleTo(targetScale)
if hrp and math.abs(hrp.Size.Y - beforeHrpY) > 0.02 then
scaledViaModel = true
end
end)
if not scaledViaModel and math.abs(ratio - 1.0) > 0.01 then
for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
desc.Size = desc.Size * ratio
elseif desc:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
desc.Scale = desc.Scale * ratio
elseif desc:IsA("Motor6D") or desc:IsA("Weld") then
local c0 = desc.C0
local c1 = desc.C1
desc.C0 = CFrame.new(c0.Position * ratio) * (c0 - c0.Position)
desc.C1 = CFrame.new(c1.Position * ratio) * (c1 - c1.Position)
end
end
if hum then
pcall(function()
if hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
hum.HipHeight = 2.0 * targetScale
end
end)
end
end
end
function Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor(char, headScale, fromP2P, targetPlr)
if not char then return end
local hs = math.clamp(tonumber(headScale) or 1.0, 0.2, 25.0)
local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
local origX = tonumber(head:GetAttribute("Berks_OrigHeadX")) or head.Size.X
local origY = tonumber(head:GetAttribute("Berks_OrigHeadY")) or head.Size.Y
local origZ = tonumber(head:GetAttribute("Berks_OrigHeadZ")) or head.Size.Z
head:SetAttribute("Berks_OrigHeadX", origX)
head:SetAttribute("Berks_OrigHeadY", origY)
head:SetAttribute("Berks_OrigHeadZ", origZ)
head.Size = Vector3.new(origX * hs, origY * hs, origZ * hs)
head.Massless = (hs > 1.2)
local mesh = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
if mesh then
local mOrig = tonumber(mesh:GetAttribute("Berks_OrigMeshScale")) or 1.25
mesh:SetAttribute("Berks_OrigMeshScale", mOrig)
mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(mOrig * hs, mOrig * hs, mOrig * hs)
end
end
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
local hsVal = hum:FindFirstChild("HeadScale")
if hsVal and hsVal:IsA("NumberValue") then hsVal.Value = hs end
end
if not fromP2P and targetPlr then
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("HEADSCALE", targetPlr.Name, tostring(math.clamp(math.floor(hs * 20 + 0.5), 1, 999)))
end
end
function Engine.ExecuteAngularVelocityFling(targetPlayer)
if not targetPlayer then return end
PlayUiSound("fling")
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("FLING", targetPlayer.Name, "99999")
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLUNG", true)
if targetPlayer.Character then
Engine.ApplyPhysicalFlingToCharacter(targetPlayer.Character, Vector3.new(25000, 52000, -25000), 99999)
end
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local tChar = targetPlayer.Character
local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if myHrp and tHrp and targetPlayer ~= LocalPlayer then
local savedCF = myHrp.CFrame
local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
bav.Name = "BerksRootFlingSpinner"
bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
bav.P = math.huge
bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
bav.Parent = myHrp
task.spawn(function()
for _ = 1, 18 do
if tHrp and tHrp.Parent and myHrp and myHrp.Parent then
myHrp.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-1, 1), 0, math.random(-1, 1))
myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if bav and bav.Parent then bav:Destroy() end
if myHrp and myHrp.Parent then
myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
myHrp.CFrame = savedCF
end
end)
end
end
function Engine.StopAngularVelocityFling()
State.WalkFling = false
State.TouchFling = false
State.LoopFlingTarget = nil
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if myHrp then
for _, child in ipairs(myHrp:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") then
child:Destroy()
end
end
myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
end

end

function Engine.CreateNeonJailAroundPlayer(targetPlayer, enable)
if not targetPlayer then return end
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket(enable and "JAIL" or "UNJAIL", targetPlayer.Name, "")
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "JAILED", enable)
local jailName = "BerksAdmin_Jail_" .. targetPlayer.Name
local existing = Workspace:FindFirstChild(jailName)
if existing then existing:Destroy() end
State.JailedPlayers[targetPlayer.Name] = nil
if not enable or not targetPlayer.Character then return end
local tHrp = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not tHrp then return end
local centerPos = tHrp.Position
State.JailedPlayers[targetPlayer.Name] = centerPos

jailModel.Name = jailName
jailModel.Parent = Workspace
local function makeWall(name, sz, offset, mat, col, trans)
local p = Instance.new("Part")
p.Name = name
p.Size = sz
p.CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + offset)
p.Anchored = true
p.CanCollide = true
p.Material = mat
p.Color = col
p.Transparency = trans
p.Parent = jailModel
return p
end

makeWall("Ceiling", Vector3.new(9.6, 0.8, 9.6), Vector3.new(0, 6.0, 0), Enum.Material.Metal, Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 38), 0.05)
makeWall("NorthWall", Vector3.new(9.6, 9.0, 0.4), Vector3.new(0, 1.1, -4.6), Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.65)
makeWall("SouthWall", Vector3.new(9.6, 9.0, 0.4), Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 4.6), Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.65)
makeWall("EastWall", Vector3.new(0.4, 9.0, 9.6), Vector3.new(4.6, 1.1, 0), Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.65)
makeWall("WestWall", Vector3.new(0.4, 9.0, 9.6), Vector3.new(-4.6, 1.1, 0), Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.65)
for i = -3, 3, 2 do
makeWall("BarN_" .. tostring(i), Vector3.new(0.35, 9.0, 0.35), Vector3.new(i, 1.1, -4.6), Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.15)
makeWall("BarS_" .. tostring(i), Vector3.new(0.35, 9.0, 0.35), Vector3.new(i, 1.1, 4.6), Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.15)
makeWall("BarE_" .. tostring(i), Vector3.new(0.35, 9.0, 0.35), Vector3.new(4.6, 1.1, i), Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.15)
makeWall("BarW_" .. tostring(i), Vector3.new(0.35, 9.0, 0.35), Vector3.new(-4.6, 1.1, i), Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.15)
end
tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
tHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
end

function Engine.StartFlightEngine(targetPlayer, speed)
if targetPlayer and targetPlayer ~= LocalPlayer then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLYING", true)
return
end
State.Flying = true
State.VehicleFlying = false
State.CFFly = false
State.FlySpeed = speed or 65
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if myHrp then
local oldBg = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyGyro")
if oldBg then oldBg:Destroy() end
local oldBv = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity")
if oldBv then oldBv:Destroy() end
local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
bg.Name = "BerksAdmin_FlyGyro"
bg.P = 90000
bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
bg.CFrame = Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame or myHrp.CFrame
bg.Parent = myHrp
local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
bv.Name = "BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity"
bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
bv.Parent = myHrp
end
if myHum and not myHum.SeatPart then
myHum.PlatformStand = true
end
if targetPlayer then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLYING", true)
end
end

if myHrp then
local oldBg = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyGyro")
if oldBg then oldBg:Destroy() end

myHum.PlatformStand = false
end
if targetPlayer then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLYING", false)
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "VFLY", false)
end
end

part.CanCollide = true
end
end
end
if targetPlayer then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "NOCLIP", state)
end
end

function Engine.SetPlayerRankInTable(targetNameOrPlayer, newLevelOrName)
if type(newLevelOrName) == "table" and newLevelOrName.Level then
newLevelOrName = newLevelOrName.Level
end
local targetPlr = nil
if typeof(targetNameOrPlayer) == "Instance" and targetNameOrPlayer:IsA("Player") then
targetPlr = targetNameOrPlayer
elseif type(targetNameOrPlayer) == "string" and #targetNameOrPlayer > 0 then
targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(targetNameOrPlayer)
if not targetPlr then
local resolved = ResolveTargetPlayers(targetNameOrPlayer)
if resolved and resolved[1] then
targetPlr = resolved[1]
end
end
end
local exactName = targetPlr and targetPlr.Name or tostring(targetNameOrPlayer or LocalPlayer.Name)
local resolvedLvl = ResolveTierLevelByInput(newLevelOrName) or tonumber(newLevelOrName) or 6
resolvedLvl = math.clamp(math.floor(resolvedLvl), 0, 999)
local isCallerB1rkt = Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer)
local isTargetB1rkt = (string.lower(exactName) == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME)) or (targetPlr and Engine.IsB1rktOwner(targetPlr))
if isTargetB1rkt and State.IsExecutingFromP2P and resolvedLvl < 10 then
return
end
if not State.IsExecutingFromP2P and not isCallerB1rkt then
local myCurrentRank = ResolvePlayerRankLevel(LocalPlayer)
if myCurrentRank < 2 then
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("YETKİ YETERSİZ", "Başkasına rütbe verebilmek için en az Tier 2 yetkiniz olmalı!", Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), 3)
end
return
end
if isTargetB1rkt then
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("KORUMALI KURUCU", "B1rkt kurucusunun rütbesi değiştirilemez!", Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), 3)
end
return
end
local maxAllowedToGive = math.max(1, myCurrentRank - 1)
if string.lower(exactName) ~= string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name) then
local targetCurrentRank = ResolvePlayerRankLevel(targetPlr or exactName)
if targetCurrentRank >= myCurrentRank then
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("YETKİ SINIRI", string.format("Kendi rütbenizden (Tier %d) eşit veya yüksek bir oyuncunun rütbesini değiştiremezsiniz!", myCurrentRank), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), 3)
end
return
end
if resolvedLvl > maxAllowedToGive then
resolvedLvl = maxAllowedToGive
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("MAX RANK SINIRI", string.format("Kendi rankınızın (Tier %d) en fazla 1 aşağısını (Tier %d) verebilirsiniz!", myCurrentRank, maxAllowedToGive), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 3)
end
end
else
-- Kişi yanlışlıkla kendine daha düşük rank vermeye çalışırsa rütbesinin düşmesini engelle:
if resolvedLvl ~= myCurrentRank then
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("KENDİ RÜTBENİZ KORUNDU", string.format("Kendi rütbenizi (Tier %d) düşüremez veya yükseltemezsiniz. Lütfen listeden başka bir oyuncu seçin!", myCurrentRank), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 3.5)
end
return
end
end
end
TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername = TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername or {}
TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[exactName] = resolvedLvl
TableDB.RanksByUsername[exactName] = resolvedLvl
SyncTablePersistence()
PlayUiSound("rank")
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("SETRANK", exactName, tostring(resolvedLvl))
if targetPlr then
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(targetPlr)
end
if string.lower(exactName) == string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name) then
State.LocalRankLevel = resolvedLvl
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(LocalPlayer)
if UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay then UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay() end
if UI.RefreshCommandListUI and UI.CmdTextBox then UI.RefreshCommandListUI(UI.CmdTextBox.Text) end
end
if UI.RefreshServerInfoModalContent and State.ServerInfoOpen then
UI.RefreshServerInfoModalContent()
end
if UI.RebuildSideOwnerDrawer then
UI.RebuildSideOwnerDrawer()
end
local tData = GetTierData(resolvedLvl)
if UI.SendNotification and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("RÜTBE VERİLDİ", "RANK ASSIGNED"),
string.format("%s -> %s (Tier %d)", exactName, tData.Name, resolvedLvl),
tData.Color,
3
)
end
end
function Engine.CreateCustomPermissionTierInTable(firstArgNameOrLevel, secondArgLevelOrCode, thirdArgDisplayName, coreGroup)
local isCallerB1rkt = Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer)
local myCurrentRank = ResolvePlayerRankLevel(LocalPlayer)
if myCurrentRank < 2 and not isCallerB1rkt then
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("YETKİ KİLİTLİ", "Yeni rank oluşturmak için en az Tier 2 yetkiniz olmalı!", Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), 3)
end
return nil
end
local rankName = "Özel Rank"
local level = 6
if type(firstArgNameOrLevel) == "string" and tonumber(firstArgNameOrLevel) == nil then
rankName = string.gsub(firstArgNameOrLevel, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
if rankName == "" then rankName = "Özel Rank" end
level = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(secondArgLevelOrCode) or tonumber(thirdArgDisplayName) or 6), 0, 999)
else
level = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(firstArgNameOrLevel) or 6), 0, 999)
rankName = tostring(thirdArgDisplayName or secondArgLevelOrCode or ("Tier " .. tostring(level)))
end
if not isCallerB1rkt then
local maxAllowed = math.max(1, myCurrentRank - 1)
if level > maxAllowed then
level = maxAllowed
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("MAX RANK SINIRI", string.format("Kendi rütbeniz Tier %d olduğu için en fazla Tier %d (1 aşağısı) oluşturabilirsiniz!", myCurrentRank, maxAllowed), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 3)
end
end
end
local palette = {
Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94),
Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247),
Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94),
Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11),
Color3.fromRGB(236, 72, 153)
}
local chosenColor = palette[(level % #palette) + 1] or Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
local grp = coreGroup or (level >= 10 and "Owner" or (level >= 6 and "Admin" or "User"))
local newTier = {
Level = level,
Id = string.upper(rankName),
Name = rankName,
TurkishName = rankName,
CoreGroup = grp,
BadgeText = string.format("TIER %d · %s", level, string.upper(rankName)),
Color = chosenColor,
CanModifyRanks = (level >= 6),
CanCreateCustomTiers = (level >= 7),
MaxTargetRank = math.max(1, level - 1),
IsCustom = true
}
DEFAULT_TIERS[level] = newTier
TableDB.CustomTiers[level] = newTier
SyncTablePersistence()
PlayUiSound("rank")
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(p)
end
if UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay then UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay() end
if UI.RefreshServerInfoModalContent and State.ServerInfoOpen then UI.RefreshServerInfoModalContent() end
if UI.RebuildSideOwnerDrawer then UI.RebuildSideOwnerDrawer() end
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("YENİ RÜTBE OLUŞTURULDU", "CUSTOM RANK CREATED"),
string.format("İsim: %s | Seviye: Tier %d", rankName, level),
chosenColor,
3.5
)
end
return level
end
function Engine.SetCharacterFriction(f, w, targetPlayer)

if not myChar then return end
for _, part in ipairs(myChar:GetDescendants()) do

part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, f or 0.7, 0.5, w or 1, 1)
end
end
end
function Engine.SetPlayerSpin(p, s)
local target = p or LocalPlayer
local spd = tonumber(s) or 0
State.SpinPlayers[target.Name] = spd > 0 and spd or nil
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(target.Name, "SPINNING", spd > 0)
if target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
local hrp = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart
local oldSpin = hrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_SpinBAV")
if oldSpin then oldSpin:Destroy() end
if spd > 0 then
local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
bav.Name = "BerksAdmin_SpinBAV"
bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
bav.P = 50000
bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spd, 0)
bav.Parent = hrp
end
end
end
function Engine.ToggleAirWalkPlatform(b, targetPlayer)
local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
if p ~= LocalPlayer then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "AIRWALK", b)
return
end
State.AirWalk = b
if not b then
State.AirFly = false
local existing = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksAirWalkPart")
if existing then existing:Destroy() end
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "AIRWALK", false)
return
end
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if myHrp then
local footOffset = (myHum and myHum.HipHeight or 2) + (myHrp.Size.Y / 2) + 0.45
State.AirWalkY = myHrp.Position.Y - footOffset
local part = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksAirWalkPart")
if not part then
part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Name = "BerksAirWalkPart"
part.Size = Vector3.new(9, 0.7, 9)
part.Anchored = true
part.CanCollide = true
part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
part.Transparency = 0.45
part.Parent = Workspace
local cyl = Instance.new("CylinderMesh")
cyl.Parent = part
end
part.CFrame = CFrame.new(myHrp.Position.X, State.AirWalkY, myHrp.Position.Z)
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "AIRWALK", true)
end
end

function Engine.TweenToTargetPlayer(p, duration)

local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local tHrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if myHrp and tHrp then
TweenService:Create(myHrp, TweenInfo.new(tonumber(duration) or 1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
}):Play()
end
end

function Engine.SetPlayerRagdollState(p, b, fromP2P)
  if not p then return end
  if not fromP2P then
    BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket(b and "RAGDOLL" or "UNRAGDOLL", p.Name, b and "1" or "0")
  end
  RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "RAGDOLLED", b)
  local char = p.Character
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not char or not hum then return end

  if b then
    hum.PlatformStand = true
    hum.AutoRotate = false
    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)
    for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
      if desc:IsA("Motor6D") and desc.Part0 and desc.Part1 and desc.Name ~= "RootJoint" and desc.Name ~= "Root" then
        if not desc:FindFirstChild("BerksRagdollSocket") then
          local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
          a0.Name = "BerksRagdollAtt0"
          a0.CFrame = desc.C0
          a0.Parent = desc.Part0
          local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
          a1.Name = "BerksRagdollAtt1"
          a1.CFrame = desc.C1
          a1.Parent = desc.Part1
          local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
          socket.Name = "BerksRagdollSocket"
          socket.Attachment0 = a0
          socket.Attachment1 = a1
          socket.LimitsEnabled = true
          socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
          socket.UpperAngle = 55
          socket.TwistLowerAngle = -45
          socket.TwistUpperAngle = 45
          socket.Parent = desc
        end
        desc.Enabled = false
      elseif desc:IsA("BasePart") and desc.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
        desc.CanCollide = true
      end
    end
    if hrp then
      hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-8, 8), math.random(-5, 5), math.random(-8, 8))
    end
  else
    for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
      if desc:IsA("Motor6D") then
        desc.Enabled = true
        local sock = desc:FindFirstChild("BerksRagdollSocket")
        if sock then sock:Destroy() end
      elseif desc:IsA("Attachment") and (desc.Name == "BerksRagdollAtt0" or desc.Name == "BerksRagdollAtt1") then
        desc:Destroy()
      end
    end
    hum.PlatformStand = false
    hum.Sit = false
    hum.AutoRotate = true
    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
  end
end

function Engine.PossessTargetViaAnimateBridge(p, b)
if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
if b then
if p == LocalPlayer and State.CurrentP2PSender then
State.PossessedByController = State.CurrentP2PSender
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "CONTROLLED", true)
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"P2P CONTROL AKTIF",
string.format("%s karakterinizi P2P uzerinden kontrol ediyor!", State.CurrentP2PSender.Name),
Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247),
4
)
end
elseif p then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "CONTROLLED", true)
end
else
if State.PossessedByController and (not State.CurrentP2PSender or State.PossessedByController == State.CurrentP2PSender or p == LocalPlayer) then
State.PossessedByController = nil
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "CONTROLLED", false)
local myHum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if myHum then myHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("P2P CONTROL BITTI", "Karakter kontrolunuz serbest birakildi.", Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128), 3)
end
end
if p then RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "CONTROLLED", false) end
end
return
end
if b and p and p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
State.ControllingTarget = p
local myHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if myHrp then
State.ControlSavedCFrame = myHrp.CFrame
end
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "CONTROLLED", true)
local tHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if tHum and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = tHum
end
else
if State.ControllingTarget then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(State.ControllingTarget.Name, "CONTROLLED", false)
end
State.ControllingTarget = nil
State.ControlSavedCFrame = nil
if LocalPlayer.Character and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
end
end

function Engine.AttachClassicRobloxForceField(char, durationSec)
  if not char then return end
  for _, old in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
    if old:IsA("ForceField") or old.Name == "BerksClassicForceFieldVisual" then
      old:Destroy()
    end
  end
  local ff = Instance.new("ForceField")
  ff.Name = "BerksSpawnForceField"
  ff.Visible = true
  ff.Parent = char

  local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local visualSphere = nil
  if hrp then
    visualSphere = Instance.new("Part")
    visualSphere.Name = "BerksClassicForceFieldVisual"
    visualSphere.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    visualSphere.Size = Vector3.new(8.5, 8.5, 8.5)
    visualSphere.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
    visualSphere.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
    visualSphere.Transparency = 0.25
    visualSphere.CanCollide = false
    visualSphere.Massless = true
    visualSphere.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    visualSphere.Parent = char
    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    w.Part0 = hrp
    w.Part1 = visualSphere
    w.Parent = visualSphere
  end

  if durationSec and durationSec > 0 then
    task.delay(durationSec, function()
      if ff and ff.Parent then ff:Destroy() end
      if visualSphere and visualSphere.Parent then visualSphere:Destroy() end
    end)
  end
end

function Engine.PerformInstantVisualRespawn(p, destinationCFrame, fromP2P)
  local target = p or LocalPlayer
  if not target then return end
  if not fromP2P then
    BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("INSTANT_RESPAWN", target.Name, "1")
  end
  local char = target.Character
  local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not char or not hrp or not hum then return end

  local savedCF = destinationCFrame or hrp.CFrame
  local savedMaxHealth = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 100)

  Engine.SetPlayerRagdollState(target, false, true)
  local specialMorph = char:FindFirstChild("Polaria_Special3DMorph")
  if specialMorph then specialMorph:Destroy() end

  local cachedTrans = {}
  for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
    if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
      cachedTrans[d] = d.Transparency
      d.Transparency = 0.85
    end
  end
  pcall(function() hum.Health = 0.1 end)

  local flashRing = Instance.new("Part", Workspace)
  flashRing.Name = "BerksInstantRespawnPulse"
  flashRing.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
  flashRing.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
  flashRing.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
  flashRing.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
  flashRing.Anchored = true
  flashRing.CanCollide = false
  flashRing.Transparency = 0.15
  flashRing.CFrame = savedCF
  TweenService:Create(flashRing, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
    Size = Vector3.new(14, 14, 14),
    Transparency = 1
  }):Play()
  task.delay(0.38, function() if flashRing and flashRing.Parent then flashRing:Destroy() end end)

  task.delay(0.08, function()
    if not char or not char.Parent then return end
    for part, _ in pairs(cachedTrans) do
      if part and part.Parent then
        part.Transparency = 0
      end
    end
    if hum and hum.Parent then
      hum.MaxHealth = savedMaxHealth
      hum.Health = savedMaxHealth
      hum.PlatformStand = false
      hum.Sit = false
      hum.WalkSpeed = 16
      hum.JumpPower = 50
    end
    if hrp and hrp.Parent then
      hrp.Anchored = false
      hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
      hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
      hrp.CFrame = savedCF
    end
    Engine.AttachClassicRobloxForceField(char, 10)
  end)
end

end

function Engine.GiveClientBuildingTools()

local toolName = "Berk's " .. mode
local old = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
if old then old:Destroy() end
local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
tool.Name = toolName
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Activated:Connect(function()
local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
local target = mouse and mouse.Target
if not target or target.Locked then return end
PlayUiSound("click")
if mode == "Delete" then
target.Parent = nil
table.insert(State.DeletedPartsBackup, target)
elseif mode == "Clone" then
local c = target:Clone()
c.CFrame = target.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, target.Size.Y, 0)
c.Parent = Workspace
elseif mode == "Move" and mouse.Hit then
target.CFrame = CFrame.new(mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, target.Size.Y / 2, 0))
end
end)
tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
end
end

tool.Name = "Berk's Telekinesis"

local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
if heldPart then
PlayUiSound("fling")
if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
heldPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * 220
end
heldPart = nil
elseif mouse and mouse.Target and not mouse.Target.Anchored then
PlayUiSound("command")
heldPart = mouse.Target
end
end)

if heldPart and heldPart.Parent and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
heldPart.CFrame = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -14)
heldPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
end)
tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
end

task.delay(2.5, function()
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "FARTED", false)
end)
end
-- [9.2.1] HD ADMIN POOP KULESI: ALTIMIZDA SUREKLI KAKA CIKAR, STACKLENIR, COK YUKARI CIKARIZ VE EN SONUNDA PATLARIZ!
function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminPoop(targetPlayer)
local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
PlayUiSound("fart")
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "POOP_TOWER", true)
local char = p.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hrp then return end
local oldTower = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_PoopTower_" .. p.Name)
if oldTower then oldTower:Destroy() end
local poopTowerModel = Instance.new("Model")
poopTowerModel.Name = "BerksAdmin_PoopTower_" .. p.Name
poopTowerModel.Parent = Workspace
local originPos = hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
local totalLayers = 38
local layerStepHeight = 1.75
local poopSound = Instance.new("Sound")
poopSound.Name = "BerksPoopLoopSfx"
poopSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://4809574295"
poopSound.Volume = 1.6
poopSound.Parent = hrp
task.spawn(function()
for layerIdx = 1, totalLayers do
if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or not poopTowerModel.Parent then
break
end
pcall(function()
poopSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.8 + (layerIdx / totalLayers) * 0.95
poopSound:Play()
end)
local curHeight = (layerIdx - 1) * layerStepHeight
local layerRadius = math.clamp(4.2 - (layerIdx * 0.04), 1.8, 4.2)
local wobbleX = math.sin(layerIdx * 0.7) * 0.35
local wobbleZ = math.cos(layerIdx * 0.7) * 0.35
local layerPos = originPos + Vector3.new(wobbleX, curHeight, wobbleZ)
local mainTurd = Instance.new("Part")
mainTurd.Name = "PoopStackLayer_" .. tostring(layerIdx)
mainTurd.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
mainTurd.Size = Vector3.new(1.9, layerRadius, layerRadius)
mainTurd.CFrame = CFrame.new(layerPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
mainTurd.Anchored = true
mainTurd.CanCollide = true
mainTurd.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
mainTurd.Color = (layerIdx % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(92, 54, 24) or Color3.fromRGB(110, 66, 30)
mainTurd.Parent = poopTowerModel
local sideBlob = Instance.new("Part")
sideBlob.Name = "PoopCoilBlob_" .. tostring(layerIdx)
sideBlob.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
sideBlob.Size = Vector3.new(layerRadius * 0.85, 2.1, layerRadius * 0.85)
sideBlob.Position = layerPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0)
sideBlob.Anchored = true
sideBlob.CanCollide = false
sideBlob.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
sideBlob.Color = Color3.fromRGB(82, 46, 18)
sideBlob.Parent = poopTowerModel
if layerIdx % 4 == 1 then
local stink = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
stink.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(101, 163, 13), Color3.fromRGB(77, 124, 15))
stink.Size = NumberSequence.new({
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.8),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 2.6)
})
stink.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
})
stink.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.5)
stink.Rate = 18
stink.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 7)
stink.Parent = sideBlob
end
if layerIdx <= 6 then
mainTurd.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
local hitChar = hit and hit.Parent
if hitChar and hitChar ~= char then
local hitHum = hitChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local hitHrp = hitChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hitHum and hitHrp and not hitHum.Sit then
PlayUiSound("slip")
hitHum.Sit = true
hitHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-35, 35), 48, math.random(-35, 35))
end
end
end)
end
local playerTopPos = originPos + Vector3.new(wobbleX, curHeight + 3.6, wobbleZ)
local curRot = hrp.CFrame - hrp.CFrame.Position
hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(playerTopPos) * curRot
if hum then
hum.Sit = (layerIdx % 2 == 0)
end
task.wait(0.18)
end
local topPeakPos = hrp and hrp.Position or (originPos + Vector3.new(0, totalLayers * layerStepHeight, 0))
for shake = 1, 12 do
if hrp and hrp.Parent then
hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(topPeakPos + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10) * 0.12, 0.5, math.random(-10, 10) * 0.12))
hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
task.wait(0.05)
end
PlayUiSound("explosion")
PlayUiSound("fart")
local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
exp.Position = topPeakPos
exp.BlastRadius = 38
exp.BlastPressure = 850000
exp.Parent = Workspace
local blastBall = Instance.new("Part")
blastBall.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
blastBall.Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
blastBall.Position = topPeakPos
blastBall.Anchored = true
blastBall.CanCollide = false
blastBall.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
blastBall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(161, 98, 7)
blastBall.Parent = Workspace
TweenService:Create(blastBall, TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = Vector3.new(58, 58, 58),
Transparency = 1
}):Play()
task.delay(0.9, function()
if blastBall and blastBall.Parent then blastBall:Destroy() end
end)
for chunkIdx = 1, 26 do
local chunk = Instance.new("Part")
chunk.Name = "PoopExplosionChunk_" .. tostring(chunkIdx)
chunk.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
chunk.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2)
chunk.Position = topPeakPos + Vector3.new(math.random(-3, 3), math.random(-2, 4), math.random(-3, 3))
chunk.Anchored = false
chunk.CanCollide = true
chunk.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
chunk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(92, 54, 24)
chunk.Parent = poopTowerModel
chunk.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-95, 95), math.random(45, 125), math.random(-95, 95))
end
if hum and hum.Parent then
hum.Sit = false
hum.Health = 0
end
if char and char.Parent then
pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end)
end
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "POOP_TOWER", false)
task.delay(6, function()
if poopSound and poopSound.Parent then poopSound:Destroy() end
if poopTowerModel and poopTowerModel.Parent then poopTowerModel:Destroy() end
end)
end)
end

end

function Engine.SetHDAdminHeadScale(targetPlayer, scale)
local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
local s = math.clamp(tonumber(scale) or 1, 0.2, 12.0)
local char = p and p.Character
if not char then return end
if Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor then
Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor(char, s, State.IsExecutingFromP2P, p)
else
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum and hum:FindFirstChild("HeadScale") then
hum.HeadScale.Value = s
elseif char:FindFirstChild("Head") then
char.Head.Size = Vector3.new(2 * s, 1 * s, 1 * s)
end
end
end
function Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions(targetPlayer, widthScale, heightScale, depthScale)
local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
local char = p and p.Character
if not char then return end
local w = tonumber(widthScale) or 1
local h = tonumber(heightScale) or 1
local d = tonumber(depthScale) or 1
if widthScale == "squash" then
w, h, d = 2.2, 0.25, 2.2
elseif widthScale == "normal" then
w, h, d = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
end
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
pcall(function()
if hum:FindFirstChild("BodyWidthScale") then hum.BodyWidthScale.Value = w end
if hum:FindFirstChild("BodyHeightScale") then hum.BodyHeightScale.Value = h end
if hum:FindFirstChild("BodyDepthScale") then hum.BodyDepthScale.Value = d end
end)
end
pcall(function()
for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
if not obj:GetAttribute("OrigPropSizeX") then
obj:SetAttribute("OrigPropSizeX", obj.Size.X)
obj:SetAttribute("OrigPropSizeY", obj.Size.Y)
obj:SetAttribute("OrigPropSizeZ", obj.Size.Z)
end
local ox = obj:GetAttribute("OrigPropSizeX") or obj.Size.X
local oy = obj:GetAttribute("OrigPropSizeY") or obj.Size.Y
local oz = obj:GetAttribute("OrigPropSizeZ") or obj.Size.Z
local csf = char:GetAttribute("BerksAppliedScale") or 1.0
obj.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.1, ox * w * csf), math.max(0.1, oy * h * csf), math.max(0.1, oz * d * csf))
end
end
end)
end

-- [9.4] 3D ARACLAR (CAR / HELI / TANK), 3D KOZMETIKLER (WINGS / CROWN / HALO / HORNS / AURA / PET / THRONE / TITAN), 3D YAPILAR VE FELAKETLER
function Engine.Spawn3DAdminVehicle(targetPlayer, vehicleType, enable)
local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
local char = p.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hrp then return end
local vName = "Berks3DVehicle_" .. tostring(vehicleType)
local old = char:FindFirstChild(vName)
if old then old:Destroy() end
if not enable then
if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 16 end
if vehicleType == "heli" then Engine.StopFlightEngine(p) end
return
end
PlayUiSound("horn")
local vModel = Instance.new("Model")
vModel.Name = vName
vModel.Parent = char
local function weldVehPart(sz, shape, offsetCF, col, mat, trans)
local pt = Instance.new("Part")
pt.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
pt.Size = sz
pt.Color = col
pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Metal
pt.Transparency = trans or 0
pt.CanCollide = false
pt.Massless = true
pt.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * offsetCF
pt.Parent = vModel
local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", pt)
w.Part0 = hrp
w.Part1 = pt
return pt
end
if vehicleType == "car" then
if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 85 end
weldVehPart(Vector3.new(6.8, 1.4, 13.5), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -1.8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(225, 29, 72), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
weldVehPart(Vector3.new(6.9, 0.35, 13.7), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -2.3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
weldVehPart(Vector3.new(5.8, 1.8, 4.5), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.5), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.45)
weldVehPart(Vector3.new(6.8, 0.3, 1.4), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -0.3, 6.2), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
for _, wOff in ipairs({ CFrame.new(-3.5, -2.2, -4.2), CFrame.new(3.5, -2.2, -4.2), CFrame.new(-3.5, -2.2, 4.2), CFrame.new(3.5, -2.2, 4.2) }) do

function Engine.Toggle3DCharacterCosmetic(targetPlayer, cosmeticType, enable)

if cosmeticType == "titan" then Engine.SetP2PCharacterScale(p, 1.0) end
return
end

pt.Size = sz

w.Part0 = anchorPart
w.Part1 = pt
return pt
end

function Engine.Spawn3DCloneArmy(targetPlayer)

v:Destroy()
end
end
return
end
local builderPlr = targetPlayer or State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer

local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

model.Name = "BerksBuiltStructure_" .. s
model.Parent = Workspace
local function makeStructPart(sz, cf, col, mat, trans)

pt.CFrame = cf
pt.Anchored = true
pt.CanCollide = true
pt.Color = col
pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminDisaster(targetPlayer, disasterType)
local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
local tHrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not tHrp then return end
local d = string.lower(tostring(disasterType or "tsunami"))
PlayUiSound("explosion")
if d == "tsunami" then
local wave = Instance.new("Part")
wave.Size = Vector3.new(120, 45, 14)
wave.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 18, 95)
wave.Anchored = true
wave.CanCollide = false
wave.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
wave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
wave.Transparency = 0.25
wave.Parent = Workspace
TweenService:Create(wave, TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 18, -110)
}):Play()
task.delay(1.0, function()
Engine.ExecuteDirectionalP2PFling(p, Vector3.new(0, 35000, -45000))
end)
task.delay(2.3, function()
if wave and wave.Parent then wave:Destroy() end
end)
elseif d == "volcano" then
local cone = Instance.new("Part")
cone.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
cone.Size = Vector3.new(26, 36, 36)
cone.CFrame = CFrame.new(tHrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
cone.Anchored = true
cone.CanCollide = false
cone.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
cone.Color = Color3.fromRGB(68, 64, 60)
cone.Parent = Workspace
Engine.CreateExplosionAtPlayer(p)
task.delay(4, function()
if cone and cone.Parent then cone:Destroy() end
end)
elseif d == "meteorstorm" then
task.spawn(function()
for _ = 1, 10 do
Engine.SpawnP2PMeteorStrike(p)
task.wait(0.25)
end
end)
end
end

function Engine.AssembleVoxelBlueprint(blueprintId, parentInstance, originCFrame, weldTarget)
local bp = Engine.VoxelBlueprints and Engine.VoxelBlueprints[blueprintId]
if not bp or not parentInstance then return nil end
local container = Instance.new("Model")
container.Name = "BerksVoxel_" .. tostring(blueprintId)
container.Parent = parentInstance
for _, node in ipairs(bp.Nodes) do
local pt = Instance.new("Part")
pt.Name = node.NodeName
pt.Size = node.Size
pt.Color = node.Color or bp.BaseColor
pt.Material = node.Material or bp.DefaultMaterial
pt.Transparency = node.Transparency or 0
pt.CanCollide = false
pt.Massless = true
pt.Anchored = (weldTarget == nil)
pt.CFrame = (originCFrame or CFrame.new()) * node.Offset
pt.Parent = container
if weldTarget then
local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
w.Part0 = weldTarget
w.Part1 = pt
w.Parent = pt
end
end
return container
end
function Engine.ToggleOverheadRankTags(enable)
State.ShowRankTags = enable
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(p)
end
end
function Engine.OpenComprehensiveBanKickMenu(mode, targetPlayer)
local normalizedMode = (string.upper(tostring(mode or "BAN")) == "KICK") and "KICK" or "BAN"
State.BanKickMenuMode = normalizedMode
State.BanKickMenuOpen = true
if UI.OpenBanKickModal then
UI.OpenBanKickModal(normalizedMode, targetPlayer)
end
end
function Engine.ToggleServerRanksAndScriptInfoModal(openState)
if openState == nil then
State.ServerInfoOpen = not State.ServerInfoOpen
else
State.ServerInfoOpen = (openState == true)
end
if UI.ToggleServerInfoModal then
UI.ToggleServerInfoModal(State.ServerInfoOpen)
end
end
function Engine.SetScriptLanguage(langCode)
local raw = string.lower(tostring(langCode or "tr"))
if raw == "en" or raw == "eng" or raw == "english" or raw == "ingilizce" then
State.Language = "EN"
else
State.Language = "TR"
end
TableDB.Language = State.Language
SyncTablePersistence()
if UI.ApplyLanguageToUI then
UI.ApplyLanguageToUI()
end
if UI.SendNotification then
if State.Language == "EN" then
UI.SendNotification("LANGUAGE UPDATED", "Interface and command descriptions switched to English (EN).", Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 3)
else
UI.SendNotification("DIL GUNCELLENDI", "Arayuz ve tum komut aciklamalari Turkce (TR) diline cevrildi.", Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 3)
end
end
end
function Engine.SetupDeltaAutoExecAndTeleportPersistence(forceInstallNow)
State.AutoExecActive = true
TableDB.AutoExecEnabled = true
SyncTablePersistence()
local savedToDeltaAutoExec = false
pcall(function()
local writeFn = (type(writefile) == "function" and writefile) or (GlobalEnv and type(GlobalEnv.writefile) == "function" and GlobalEnv.writefile)
local isFolderFn = (type(isfolder) == "function" and isfolder) or (GlobalEnv and type(GlobalEnv.isfolder) == "function" and GlobalEnv.isfolder)
local makeFolderFn = (type(makefolder) == "function" and makefolder) or (GlobalEnv and type(GlobalEnv.makefolder) == "function" and GlobalEnv.makefolder)
if writeFn then
local bootstrapCode = "-- Berk's Admin FE v5.0 Delta Executor AutoExec Loader\n"
.. "repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded() and game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer\n"
.. "local env = (type(getgenv) == 'function' and getgenv()) or _G\n"
.. "if type(env.BerksAdmin_SourceRunner) == 'function' then pcall(env.BerksAdmin_SourceRunner) end\n"
pcall(function()
if isFolderFn and makeFolderFn and not isFolderFn("autoexec") then
makeFolderFn("autoexec")
end
writeFn("autoexec/BerksAdmin_v5_AutoExec.lua", bootstrapCode)
savedToDeltaAutoExec = true
end)
pcall(function()
writeFn("BerksAdmin_v5_AutoExec.lua", bootstrapCode)
savedToDeltaAutoExec = true
end)
end
end)
pcall(function()
local qot = (type(queue_on_teleport) == "function" and queue_on_teleport)
or (GlobalEnv and type(GlobalEnv.queue_on_teleport) == "function" and GlobalEnv.queue_on_teleport)
or (type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.queue_on_teleport) == "function" and syn.queue_on_teleport)
or (type(fluxus) == "table" and type(fluxus.queue_on_teleport) == "function" and fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
or (type(delta) == "table" and type(delta.queue_on_teleport) == "function" and delta.queue_on_teleport)
if not GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_TeleportHooked then
GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_TeleportHooked = true
LocalPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function()
SyncTablePersistence()
if qot and type(GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_RawSource) == "string" and #GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_RawSource > 0 then
pcall(function()
qot(GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_RawSource)
end)
end
end)
end
end)
if forceInstallNow and UI.SendNotification then
if State.Language == "EN" then
UI.SendNotification(
"DELTA AUTOEXEC ACTIVE",
savedToDeltaAutoExec
and "Saved to Delta autoexec folder + Teleport queue armed! Will auto-run in every game."
or "Teleport queue + GlobalEnv persistence armed! Script will auto-run on rejoin.",
Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
3.8
)
else
UI.SendNotification(
"DELTA AUTOEXEC AKTIF",
savedToDeltaAutoExec
and "Delta autoexec klasorune yazildi + Teleport kuyrugu kuruldu! Oyuna girince aninda calisir."
or "Teleport kuyrugu + GlobalEnv kaliciligi aktif! Oyun degistirince aninda yeniden calisir.",
Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
3.8
)
end
end
end
function Engine.PlayHalloweenSplashIntro()
if UI.TriggerHalloweenIntro then
UI.TriggerHalloweenIntro()
end
end

local CommandRegistry = {}
for idx, cmd in ipairs(CommandList) do
cmd.CmdIndex = idx
CommandRegistry[string.lower(cmd.Name)] = cmd
end
for cmdName, overrideTier in pairs(TableDB.CommandMinTierOverrides) do
if CommandRegistry[cmdName] then
CommandRegistry[cmdName].MinTier = overrideTier
end
end
-- [10.4] Topk3k MOTOR FONKSIYONLARI VE B1RKT IZIN KALKANI (SIFIR LOCAL DEGISKEN YUKU!)
do
function Engine.IsB1rktOwner(plrOrName)
local pName = typeof(plrOrName) == "Instance" and plrOrName.Name or tostring(plrOrName or LocalPlayer.Name)
if string.lower(pName) == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME) then
return true
end
if plrOrName == LocalPlayer or pName == LocalPlayer.Name then
return true
end
return false
end
function Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(senderPlr, targetPlr)
if not targetPlr then return true end
State.AdminModePlayers = State.AdminModePlayers or {}
if State.AdminModePlayers[targetPlr.Name] and senderPlr ~= targetPlr then
return false
end
if string.lower(targetPlr.Name) ~= string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME) then
return true
end
local senderName = typeof(senderPlr) == "Instance" and senderPlr.Name or tostring(senderPlr or "")
if string.lower(senderName) == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME) then
return true
end
if State.B1rktAllowAll ~= false then
return true
end
if senderName ~= "" and State.B1rktAllowedPlayers[string.lower(senderName)] == true then
return true
end
return false
end
function Engine.Topk3k_StopAllSounds()
for _, parentInst in ipairs({ SoundService, Workspace }) do
for _, desc in ipairs(parentInst:GetDescendants()) do
if desc:IsA("Sound") and (string.sub(desc.Name, 1, 7) == "Topk3k_" or string.sub(desc.Name, 1, 11) == "BerksAdmin_") then
pcall(function()
desc:Stop()
desc:Destroy()
end)
end
end
end
end
function Engine.Topk3k_PlaySyncedSound(assetIdStr, vol, pitch, looped, shakeCamera, ultraDistort)
local cleanId = string.gsub(tostring(assetIdStr or "9043345732"), "[^%d]", "")
if cleanId == "" then cleanId = "9043345732" end
pcall(function()
if looped then
for _, s in ipairs(SoundService:GetChildren()) do
if s:IsA("Sound") and s.Name == "Topk3k_LoopedMusic" then
s:Stop()
s:Destroy()
end
end
end
local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
snd.Name = looped and "Topk3k_LoopedMusic" or ("Topk3k_SFX_" .. cleanId)
snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanId
snd.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(vol) or 10, 0.5, 10)
snd.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(pitch) or 1.0, 0.2, 4.0)
snd.Looped = (looped == true)
if ultraDistort then
local dist = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
dist.Level = 0.96
dist.Parent = snd
local eq = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
eq.HighGain = 10
eq.MidGain = 10
eq.LowGain = 10
eq.Parent = snd
end
snd.Parent = SoundService
snd:Play()
if not looped then
snd.Ended:Connect(function()
pcall(function() snd:Destroy() end)
end)
task.delay(18, function()
pcall(function() if snd and snd.Parent then snd:Destroy() end end)
end)
end
end)
if shakeCamera then
task.spawn(function()
local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
for _ = 1, 36 do
pcall(function()
cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(
math.rad(math.random(-6, 6)),
math.rad(math.random(-6, 6)),
math.rad(math.random(-6, 6))
)
end)
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
end
end)
end
end
function Engine.Topk3k_SetSkybox(assetIdStr)
local cleanId = string.gsub(tostring(assetIdStr or "1365169983"), "[^%d]", "")
if cleanId == "" then cleanId = "1365169983" end
local tex = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanId
pcall(function()
for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Sky") then
child:Destroy()
end
end
local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
sky.Name = "Topk3k_CustomSkybox"
sky.SkyboxBk = tex
sky.SkyboxDn = tex
sky.SkyboxFt = tex
sky.SkyboxLf = tex
sky.SkyboxRt = tex
sky.SkyboxUp = tex
sky.SunTextureId = tex
sky.MoonTextureId = tex
sky.Parent = Lighting
end)
end
function Engine.Topk3k_DecalSpam(assetIdStr)
local cleanId = string.gsub(tostring(assetIdStr or "1365169983"), "[^%d]", "")
if cleanId == "" then cleanId = "1365169983" end
local tex = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanId
local faces = {
Enum.NormalId.Front,
Enum.NormalId.Back,
Enum.NormalId.Top,
Enum.NormalId.Bottom,
Enum.NormalId.Left,
Enum.NormalId.Right
}
pcall(function()
for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
local dec = Instance.new("Decal")
dec.Name = "Topk3k_SpamDecal"
dec.Face = face
dec.Texture = tex
dec.Parent = obj
end
end
end
end)
end
function Engine.Topk3k_ClearDecalsAndSky()
pcall(function()
for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if (obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture")) and obj.Name == "Topk3k_SpamDecal" then
obj:Destroy()
elseif obj:IsA("SelectionBox") and obj.Name == "Topk3k_666Box" then
obj:Destroy()
elseif obj:IsA("Fire") and obj.Name == "Topk3k_666Fire" then
obj:Destroy()
end
end
for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Sky") and child.Name == "Topk3k_CustomSkybox" then
child:Destroy()
elseif child.Name == "Topk3k_HorrorCC" or child.Name == "Topk3k_HorrorBlur" then
child:Destroy()
end
end
State.Mode666Active = false
State.DiscoMode = false
Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(138, 138, 138)
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
Lighting.Brightness = 2
Lighting.ClockTime = 14
end)
end
function Engine.Topk3k_ClearNil(notifyUser)
local cleanedCount = 0
pcall(function()
local charMap = {}
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr.Character then
charMap[plr.Character] = true
end
end
local function isInsidePlayerChar(inst)
local cur = inst
while cur and cur ~= Workspace do
if charMap[cur] then return true end
cur = cur.Parent
end
return false
end
local oldSafeFloor = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_ClearNilSafetyFloor")
if oldSafeFloor then oldSafeFloor:Destroy() end
if notifyUser ~= false then
for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")
and not obj:IsA("Terrain")
and not isInsidePlayerChar(obj)
and obj.Parent ~= nil then
table.insert(State.DeletedPartsBackup, {
Part = obj,
Parent = obj.Parent,
CFrame = obj.CFrame,
Transparency = obj.Transparency,
CanCollide = obj.CanCollide,
Anchored = obj.Anchored
})
obj.Parent = nil
cleanedCount = cleanedCount + 1
end
end
pcall(function()
if Workspace.Terrain then
Workspace.Terrain:Clear()
end
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
local c = plr.Character
local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hm = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h then
h.Anchored = false
h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, -45, h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
end
if hm then
hm.Sit = false
hm.PlatformStand = false
hm:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
end
end
end)
else
for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
if string.sub(child.Name, 1, 7) == "Topk3k_" or string.sub(child.Name, 1, 6) == "Berks_" or string.sub(child.Name, 1, 13) == "BerksLaserRig" then
if child.Name ~= "Topk3k_ClearNilSafetyFloor" then
child:Destroy()
cleanedCount = cleanedCount + 1
end
end
end
end
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
local char = plr.Character
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local anim = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
if anim then
for _, trk in ipairs(anim:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
local aId = tostring(trk.Animation and trk.Animation.AnimationId or "")
if string.find(aId, "9900") or trk.Speed >= 8.0 then
trk:Stop(0)
end
end
end
end
State.RecentP2PPackets = {}
State.PendingPeerNumericArg = {}
end)
print(string.format("[Topk3k · CLEARNIL] %d adet oyun yapisi ve harita blogu silindi (Geri Alinabilir)!", cleanedCount))
if notifyUser and UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"Topk3k · CLEARNIL",
string.format("Oyun yapıları dahil %d harita bloğu silindi! ('Geri Al' ile geri yükleyebilirsiniz)", cleanedCount),
Color3.fromRGB(58, 106, 204),
3.5
)
end
end
function Engine.Topk3k_ClearExecutedScripts()
State.Flying = false
State.CFFly = false
State.AirWalk = false
State.Noclip = false
State.WalkFling = false
State.TouchFling = false
State.LoopGod = false
State.SemiGod = false
State.LevitateMode = false
State.NoGravMode = false
State.RainbowNameMode = false
State.Mode666Active = false
State.DiscoMode = false
State.OrbitTarget = nil
State.FollowTarget = nil
State.LoopGotoTarget = nil
State.BackpackTarget = nil
State.ControllingTarget = nil
State.PossessedByController = nil
State.SpinPlayers = {}
State.LaserEyesPlayers = {}
State.SeizurePlayers = {}
State.GlitchPlayers = {}
State.RainbowPlayers = {}
Engine.Topk3k_StopAllSounds()
Engine.Topk3k_ClearDecalsAndSky()
Engine.Topk3k_ClearNil(false)
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if myHrp then
myHrp.Anchored = false
for _, ch in ipairs(myHrp:GetChildren()) do
if ch:IsA("BodyMover") or ch:IsA("BodyForce") or ch:IsA("BodyVelocity") or ch:IsA("BodyGyro") or ch:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") then
ch:Destroy()
end
end
end
if myHum then
myHum.PlatformStand = false
myHum.WalkSpeed = 16
myHum.JumpPower = 50
end
if Workspace.CurrentCamera and myHum then
Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = myHum
end
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("Topk3k", "Clear Executed Scripts & ClearNil tamamlandı!", Color3.fromRGB(58, 106, 204), 3)
end
end

function Engine.Topk3k_DealSyncedDamage(targetPlayer, dmgAmount)
if not targetPlayer or not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, targetPlayer) then
return
end
local char = targetPlayer.Character
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local dmg = math.clamp(tonumber(dmgAmount) or 25, 1, 1000)
if hum then
if targetPlayer == LocalPlayer and (State.LoopGod or State.SemiGod) then
if State.SemiGod then
hum:TakeDamage(dmg * 0.15)
end
else
pcall(function()
hum:TakeDamage(dmg)
end)
end
end
PlayUiSound("slap")
if head or hrp then
pcall(function()
local popPart = Instance.new("Part")
popPart.Name = "Topk3k_DmgPopup"
popPart.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
popPart.Transparency = 1
popPart.Anchored = true
popPart.CanCollide = false
popPart.Position = (head and head.Position or hrp.Position) + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10) / 10, 2.5, math.random(-10, 10) / 10)
popPart.Parent = Workspace
local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 32)
bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
bb.Parent = popPart
local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
txt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
txt.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
txt.TextSize = 22
txt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 45)
txt.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
txt.Text = "-" .. tostring(math.floor(dmg)) .. " HP"
txt.Parent = bb
TweenService:Create(popPart, TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Position = popPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0)
}):Play()
task.delay(0.9, function()
if popPart and popPart.Parent then popPart:Destroy() end
end)
end)
end
end
function Engine.Topk3k_HealPlayer(targetPlayer, healAmount)
local char = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
hum.Health = math.min(hum.MaxHealth, hum.Health + (tonumber(healAmount) or 100))
end
end
function Engine.Topk3k_SpawnP2PBlock(builderPlayer, colorCode, explicitPartId)
local p = builderPlayer or LocalPlayer
local char = p and p.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not hrp then return nil end
local palette = {
[1] = Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233),
[2] = Color3.fromRGB(129, 26, 255),
[3] = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38),
[4] = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94),
[5] = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21),
[6] = Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22),
[7] = Color3.fromRGB(236, 72, 153),
[8] = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252),
[9] = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 27),
[10] = Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235)
}
State.SpawnedBlocksCount = (State.SpawnedBlocksCount or 0) + 1
local blk = Instance.new("Part")
blk.Name = "Topk3k_P2PBlock_" .. tostring(State.SpawnedBlocksCount)
blk.Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6)
blk.Anchored = true
blk.CanCollide = true
blk.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
blk.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
blk.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Inlet
local cIdx = math.clamp(tonumber(colorCode) or 1, 1, #palette)
blk.Color = palette[cIdx] or palette[1]
blk.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -8)
local pid = (tonumber(explicitPartId) and tonumber(explicitPartId) > 0) and tonumber(explicitPartId) or (701 + ((State.SpawnedBlocksCount - 1) % 298))
blk:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", pid)
blk.Parent = Workspace
if Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId then
Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(blk)
end
PlayUiSound("click")
return blk
end
function Engine.Topk3k_BuildP2PTrowelWall(builderPlayer)

local char = p and p.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not hrp then return end
local baseCF = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -7)
local wallModel = Instance.new("Model")

wallModel.Parent = Workspace
PlayUiSound("click")

for row = 0, 3 do
for col = -2, 2 do
local brick = Instance.new("Part")
brick.Name = "Topk3k_P2PBrick"

brick.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")

brick.CFrame = baseCF * CFrame.new(xOff, row * 1.4, 0)
brick.Parent = wallModel
task.wait(0.02)
end
end
end)
end
function Engine.Topk3k_ComputePartHash(part)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return 0 end
local pos = part.Position
local h = (math.abs(math.floor(pos.X + 2000)) * 73 + math.abs(math.floor(pos.Y + 500)) * 37 + math.abs(math.floor(pos.Z + 2000)) * 19) % 8800 + 100
return h
end
function Engine.Topk3k_DeletePartByHash(senderPlayer, targetHash)
local bestPart = nil
local bestDist = math.huge
local senderHrp = senderPlayer and senderPlayer.Character and senderPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Parent and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj.Parent) and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj.Parent.Parent) and obj.Name ~= "Terrain" then
if targetHash and targetHash >= 100 then
if Engine.Topk3k_ComputePartHash(obj) == targetHash then
bestPart = obj
break
end
elseif senderHrp then
local lookPos = (senderHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -8)).Position
local d = (obj.Position - lookPos).Magnitude
if d < bestDist and d < 35 then
bestDist = d
bestPart = obj
end
end
end
end
if bestPart then
table.insert(State.DeletedPartsBackup, {
Part = bestPart,
Parent = bestPart.Parent,
CFrame = bestPart.CFrame,
Transparency = bestPart.Transparency,
CanCollide = bestPart.CanCollide
})
bestPart.Parent = nil
PlayUiSound("explosion")
end
end
function Engine.Topk3k_RestoreDeletedParts()
local restoredCount = 0
for i = #State.DeletedPartsBackup, 1, -1 do
local item = State.DeletedPartsBackup[i]
if item and item.Part then
pcall(function()
item.Part.Parent = item.Parent or Workspace
item.Part.CFrame = item.CFrame
item.Part.Transparency = item.Transparency
item.Part.CanCollide = item.CanCollide
if item.Anchored ~= nil then
item.Part.Anchored = item.Anchored
end
restoredCount = restoredCount + 1
end)
end
table.remove(State.DeletedPartsBackup, i)
end
local safeFloor = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_ClearNilSafetyFloor")
if safeFloor then
safeFloor:Destroy()
end
PlayUiSound("rank")
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"HARİTA GERİ YÜKLENDİ (UNDO)",
string.format("%d adet silinen oyun yapısı ve harita bloğu eski yerine geri yüklendi!", restoredCount),
Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94),
3.5
)
end
end

end
