local function createR6Limb(limbName, sizeVec, colorVal)
local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Name = limbName
part.Size = sizeVec
part.Color = colorVal
part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
part.CanCollide = false
part.Massless = true
part.Anchored = false
part.CFrame = savedCF
part.Parent = r6Model
return part
end
local torso = createR6Limb("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), torsoCol)
local lArm = createR6Limb("Left Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), lArmCol)
local rArm = createR6Limb("Right Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), rArmCol)
local lLeg = createR6Limb("Left Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), lLegCol)
local rLeg = createR6Limb("Right Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), rLegCol)
local rootJoint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
rootJoint.Name = "RootJoint"
rootJoint.Part0 = hrp
rootJoint.Part1 = torso
rootJoint.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
rootJoint.C1 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
rootJoint.Parent = torso
local rShoulder = Instance.new("Motor6D")
rShoulder.Name = "Right Shoulder"
rShoulder.Part0 = torso
rShoulder.Part1 = rArm
rShoulder.C0 = CFrame.new(1.5, 0.5, 0)
rShoulder.C1 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
rShoulder.Parent = torso
local lShoulder = Instance.new("Motor6D")
lShoulder.Name = "Left Shoulder"
lShoulder.Part0 = torso
lShoulder.Part1 = lArm
lShoulder.C0 = CFrame.new(-1.5, 0.5, 0)
lShoulder.C1 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
lShoulder.Parent = torso
local rHip = Instance.new("Motor6D")
rHip.Name = "Right Hip"
rHip.Part0 = torso
rHip.Part1 = rLeg
rHip.C0 = CFrame.new(0.5, -1, 0)
rHip.C1 = CFrame.new(0, 1, 0)
rHip.Parent = torso
local lHip = Instance.new("Motor6D")
lHip.Name = "Left Hip"
lHip.Part0 = torso
lHip.Part1 = lLeg
lHip.C0 = CFrame.new(-0.5, -1, 0)
lHip.C1 = CFrame.new(0, 1, 0)
lHip.Parent = torso
local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
if head then
head.Transparency = 0
local neckMotor = head:FindFirstChild("Neck")
if neckMotor and neckMotor:IsA("Motor6D") then
neckMotor.Part0 = torso
neckMotor.Part1 = head
neckMotor.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
neckMotor.C1 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
end
end
hrp.CFrame = savedCF
if p == LocalPlayer and cam then
cam.CameraSubject = hum
cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
if savedCamCF then cam.CFrame = savedCamCF end
end
task.spawn(function()
local animClock = 0
while r6Model and r6Model.Parent == char and hum and hum.Parent == char do
local dt = RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
animClock = animClock + (dt or 0.016)
for partName, _ in pairs(r15PartsToHide) do
local rp = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
if rp and rp:IsA("BasePart") and rp.Transparency < 1 then
rp.Transparency = 1
rp.CanCollide = false
end
end
local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local horizSpeed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
local isJumping = (math.abs(vel.Y) > 2.5 and hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air)
if isJumping then
rShoulder.C0 = rShoulder.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(1.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(155), 0, 0), 0.22)
lShoulder.C0 = lShoulder.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(-1.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(155), 0, 0), 0.22)
rHip.C0 = rHip.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(0.5, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-15), 0, 0), 0.22)
lHip.C0 = lHip.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(-0.5, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-15), 0, 0), 0.22)
elseif horizSpeed > 1.2 then
local freq = math.clamp(horizSpeed * 0.65, 6, 16)
local swing = math.sin(animClock * freq) * 0.78
rShoulder.C0 = CFrame.new(1.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0)
lShoulder.C0 = CFrame.new(-1.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0)
rHip.C0 = CFrame.new(0.5, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0)
lHip.C0 = CFrame.new(-0.5, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0)
else
local idleWave = math.sin(animClock * 2.2) * 0.04
rShoulder.C0 = rShoulder.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(1.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(idleWave, 0, math.rad(2)), 0.18)
lShoulder.C0 = lShoulder.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(-1.5, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-idleWave, 0, math.rad(-2)), 0.18)
rHip.C0 = rHip.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(0.5, -1, 0), 0.18)
lHip.C0 = lHip.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(-0.5, -1, 0), 0.18)
end
end
end)
if p == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"R6 KARAKTER DÖNÜŞÜMÜ",
"Karakteriniz olduğu yerde bugsuz klasik R6 olarak respawnlandı (P2P Senkron)!",
Color3.fromRGB(58, 106, 204),
3.5
)
end
end

function Engine.ExecuteRealWaterFlood(fromP2P, modeOverride)
local existing = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksRealFloodOcean") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_FloodWater")
local turnOn = true
if modeOverride == 0 then
turnOn = false
elseif modeOverride == 1 then
turnOn = true
elseif existing or State.RealFloodActive then
turnOn = false
end
if not fromP2P then
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("REAL_FLOOD", "ALL", turnOn and "1" or "0")
end
if not turnOn then
State.RealFloodActive = false
if existing then existing:Destroy() end
local f2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksRealFloodOcean")
if f2 then f2:Destroy() end
pcall(function()
if Workspace.Terrain then
Workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(0, 10, 0), Vector3.new(2048, 160, 2048), Enum.Material.Air)
end
end)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hrp then
local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("BerksFloodSwimBV")
if bv then bv:Destroy() end
end
end
return
end
State.RealFloodActive = true
State.RealFloodSurfaceY = -18
if existing then existing:Destroy() end
local ocean = Instance.new("Part")
ocean.Name = "BerksRealFloodOcean"
ocean.Size = Vector3.new(2048, 12, 2048)
ocean.Position = Vector3.new(0, -24, 0)
ocean.Anchored = true
ocean.CanCollide = false
ocean.Transparency = 0.32
ocean.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
ocean.Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 145, 215)
ocean.Parent = Workspace
pcall(function()
Workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0.85
Workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 22
Workspace.Terrain.WaterTransparency = 0.25
Workspace.Terrain.WaterColor = Color3.fromRGB(12, 130, 195)
end)
task.spawn(function()
for step = 1, 28 do
if not State.RealFloodActive then break end
local topY = -18 + (step * 2.2)
State.RealFloodSurfaceY = topY
local h = math.max(12, topY + 36)
local centerY = topY - (h * 0.5)
if ocean and ocean.Parent then
ocean.Size = Vector3.new(2048, h, 2048)
ocean.Position = Vector3.new(0, centerY, 0)
end
pcall(function()
if Workspace.Terrain then
Workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(0, centerY, 0), Vector3.new(1024, h, 1024), Enum.Material.Water)
end
end)
task.wait(0.16)
end
end)
if not State.RealFloodSwimLoopRunning then
State.RealFloodSwimLoopRunning = true
task.spawn(function()
while State.RealFloodActive do
local surfY = State.RealFloodSurfaceY or 25
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
local char = plr.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hrp and hum then
if hrp.Position.Y < (surfY - 1.2) then
pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming) end)
local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("BerksFloodSwimBV")
if not bv then
bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
bv.Name = "BerksFloodSwimBV"
bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 18000, 0)
bv.Parent = hrp
end
local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
local upVel = (hum.Jump and 22) or ((surfY - hrp.Position.Y > 4) and 9 or 2)
bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(moveDir.X * 18, upVel, moveDir.Z * 18)
else
local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("BerksFloodSwimBV")
if bv then bv:Destroy() end
end
end
end
task.wait(0.08)
end
State.RealFloodSwimLoopRunning = false
end)
end

function Engine.SetAdminModeOnPlayer(targetPlayer, enableState, fromP2P)
local plr = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
if not plr then return end
local pName = plr.Name
local nextState = (enableState == true)
State.AdminModePlayers[pName] = nextState and true or nil

TableDB.AdminModeUsers[pName] = nextState and true or nil
local char = plr.Character

if nextState then
if hum then
hum.MaxHealth = math.huge
hum.Health = math.huge
hum.PlatformStand = false
end
if hrp then
hrp.Anchored = false
State.AdminModeSafeCF[pName] = hrp.CFrame
end
if char then
local ff = char:FindFirstChild("BerksAdminImmunityFF")
if not ff then
ff = Instance.new("ForceField")
ff.Name = "BerksAdminImmunityFF"
ff.Visible = true
ff.Parent = char
end
end
if head and not head:FindFirstChild("BerksAdminImmunityHalo") then
local halo = Instance.new("Part")
halo.Name = "BerksAdminImmunityHalo"
halo.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 0.18, 2.2)
halo.Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
halo.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
halo.CanCollide = false
halo.Massless = true
halo.Parent = head
local mesh = Instance.new("CylinderMesh", halo)
mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 0.4, 1)
local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
weld.Part0 = head
weld.Part1 = halo
weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.45, 0)
weld.Parent = halo
end
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(pName, "ADMINMODE", true)
if not fromP2P then
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("ADMINMODE_ON", pName, "1")
end
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"ADMIN DOKUNULMAZLIĞI: AKTİF",
string.format("%s için Admin Dokunulmazlığı (God + Anti-Fling + Anti-Void + P2P Shield) AÇILDI!", pName),
Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21),
3.5
)
end
else
if hum then
hum.MaxHealth = 100
hum.Health = 100
end
if char then
local ff = char:FindFirstChild("BerksAdminImmunityFF")
if ff then ff:Destroy() end
end
if head then
local halo = head:FindFirstChild("BerksAdminImmunityHalo")
if halo then halo:Destroy() end
end
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(pName, "ADMINMODE", false)
if not fromP2P then
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("ADMINMODE_OFF", pName, "0")
end
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"ADMIN DOKUNULMAZLIĞI: KAPALI",
string.format("%s için Admin Dokunulmazlığı kapatıldı (Normale döndü).", pName),
Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184),
3.0
)
end
end
end

local CachedCharParts = {}
local SavedOriginalTransparencies = {}
local SavedOriginalCanCollide = {}
local SavedWalkSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed
local SavedJumpPower = Humanoid.JumpPower
local SavedFOV = (IsSelfTarget and Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView) or 70
local SavedMaxZoom = (IsSelfTarget and RealLocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance) or 128
local SavedMinZoom = (IsSelfTarget and RealLocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance) or 0.5
local function CacheAndHidePlayerCharacter(char)
if not char then return end
CachedCharParts = {}
for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
if desc ~= RootPart then
desc.CanCollide = false
desc.Massless = true
end
if SavedOriginalTransparencies[desc] == nil then
SavedOriginalTransparencies[desc] = desc.Transparency
SavedOriginalCanCollide[desc] = desc.CanCollide
end
desc.Transparency = 1
desc.CastShadow = false
table.insert(CachedCharParts, desc)
elseif desc:IsA("Decal") or desc:IsA("Texture") then
if SavedOriginalTransparencies[desc] == nil then
SavedOriginalTransparencies[desc] = desc.Transparency
end
desc.Transparency = 1
table.insert(CachedCharParts, desc)
elseif desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") or desc:IsA("Beam") then
desc.Enabled = false
elseif desc:IsA("Accessory") then
local handle = desc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
if SavedOriginalTransparencies[handle] == nil then
SavedOriginalTransparencies[handle] = handle.Transparency
SavedOriginalCanCollide[handle] = handle.CanCollide
end
handle.Transparency = 1
handle.CanCollide = false
end
end
end
end
local function EnforceCharacterHidden()
for i = 1, #CachedCharParts do
local inst = CachedCharParts[i]
if inst and inst.Parent and inst.Transparency < 1 then
inst.Transparency = 1
end
end
end

for _, desc in ipairs(locustModel:GetDescendants()) do
if desc:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
or desc:IsA("Animator")
or desc:IsA("AnimationController")
or desc:IsA("Humanoid")
or desc:IsA("BodyMover")
then
desc:Destroy()
elseif desc:IsA("BasePart") then
desc.CanCollide = false
desc.CanTouch = false
desc.CanQuery = false
desc.Massless = true
desc.Anchored = true
desc.CastShadow = true
table.insert(allMeshParts, desc)
if not mainMesh or (desc:IsA("MeshPart") and desc.Size.Magnitude > mainMesh.Size.Magnitude) then
mainMesh = desc
end
elseif desc:IsA("Bone") then
desc.Transform = CFrame.new()
table.insert(allBones, desc)
elseif desc:IsA("Sound") then
if not modelSound then
modelSound = desc
end
end
end
if locustModel:IsA("BasePart") and not mainMesh then
mainMesh = locustModel
mainMesh.CanCollide = false
mainMesh.Anchored = true
table.insert(allMeshParts, mainMesh)
end
if not mainMesh then
warn("❌ [The Locust V4] MeshPart bulunamadı!")
return
end
local CALIBRATION_ORIGIN = CFrame.new(0, 80, 0)
if locustModel:IsA("Model") then
locustModel:PivotTo(CALIBRATION_ORIGIN)
else
mainMesh.CFrame = CALIBRATION_ORIGIN
end
local BoneRestRot = {}
local BoneRestPosObj = {}
local BoneChainDepth = {}
local meshInvRot = mainMesh.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse()
for _, bone in ipairs(allBones) do
BoneRestRot[bone] = meshInvRot * bone.WorldCFrame.Rotation
BoneRestPosObj[bone] = mainMesh.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(bone.WorldPosition)
local d = 0
local p = bone.Parent
while p and p:IsA("Bone") do
d = d + 1
p = p.Parent
end
BoneChainDepth[bone] = d
end
local RigBones = {
Pelvis = {},
LowerSpine = {},
MidSpine = {},
UpperChest = {},
Spine = {},
NeckBase = {},
NeckUpper = {},
Neck = {},
Head = {},
Jaw = {},
RightClavicle = {},
LeftClavicle = {},
RightUpperArm = {},
RightLowerArm = {},
RightHand = {},
RightFingers = {},
LeftUpperArm = {},
LeftLowerArm = {},
LeftHand = {},
LeftFingers = {},
RightUpperLeg = {},
RightLowerLeg = {},
RightFoot = {},
RightToes = {},
LeftUpperLeg = {},
LeftLowerLeg = {},
LeftFoot = {},
LeftToes = {},
}
local function GetLimbDepthByKeyword(b, kw1, kw2, kw3)
local depth = 0
local p = b.Parent
while p and p:IsA("Bone") do
local pn = string.lower(p.Name)
if (kw1 and string.find(pn, kw1))
or (kw2 and string.find(pn, kw2))
or (kw3 and string.find(pn, kw3))
then
depth = depth + 1
end
p = p.Parent
end
return depth
end
local function ClassifyAllSkeletonBones()
local spineCandidates = {}
for _, bone in ipairs(allBones) do
local n = string.lower(bone.Name)
local relPos = BoneRestPosObj[bone] or Vector3.new()
local isLeft = string.find(n, "left")
or string.find(n, "_l")
or string.find(n, "%.l")
or string.find(n, "l_")
or string.sub(n, -2) == "_l"
or (not string.find(n, "right") and not string.find(n, "_r") and not string.find(n, "r_") and relPos.X < -0.14)
local isRight = string.find(n, "right")
or string.find(n, "_r")
or string.find(n, "%.r")
or string.find(n, "r_")
or string.sub(n, -2) == "_r"
or (not isLeft and relPos.X > 0.14)
if string.find(n, "jaw") or string.find(n, "mandible") or string.find(n, "chin") or string.find(n, "mouth") then
table.insert(RigBones.Jaw, bone)
table.insert(RigBones.Head, bone)
elseif string.find(n, "head") or string.find(n, "skull") or string.find(n, "face") or string.find(n, "cranium") then
table.insert(RigBones.Head, bone)
elseif string.find(n, "neck") or string.find(n, "cervical") then
table.insert(RigBones.Neck, bone)
if GetLimbDepthByKeyword(bone, "neck", "cervical", nil) >= 1 then
table.insert(RigBones.NeckUpper, bone)
else
table.insert(RigBones.NeckBase, bone)
end
elseif string.find(n, "clavicle") or string.find(n, "collar") or string.find(n, "scapula") then
if isRight then
table.insert(RigBones.RightClavicle, bone)
elseif isLeft then
table.insert(RigBones.LeftClavicle, bone)
end
elseif string.find(n, "finger") or string.find(n, "thumb") or string.find(n, "index") or string.find(n, "middle") or string.find(n, "pinky") or string.find(n, "ring") or string.find(n, "claw") or string.find(n, "digit") then
if isRight then
table.insert(RigBones.RightFingers, bone)
table.insert(RigBones.RightLowerArm, bone)
elseif isLeft then
table.insert(RigBones.LeftFingers, bone)
table.insert(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, bone)
end
elseif string.find(n, "hand") or string.find(n, "wrist") or string.find(n, "palm") or string.find(n, "carpal") then
if isRight then
table.insert(RigBones.RightHand, bone)
table.insert(RigBones.RightLowerArm, bone)
elseif isLeft then
table.insert(RigBones.LeftHand, bone)
table.insert(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, bone)
end
elseif string.find(n, "arm") or string.find(n, "shoulder") or string.find(n, "forearm") or string.find(n, "elbow") or string.find(n, "bicep") or string.find(n, "humerus") or string.find(n, "radius") or string.find(n, "ulna") then
local armDepth = GetLimbDepthByKeyword(bone, "arm", "shoulder", "clavicle")
local isLower = string.find(n, "low")
or string.find(n, "fore")
or string.find(n, "elbow")
or string.find(n, "radius")
or string.find(n, "ulna")
or armDepth >= 1
if isRight then
if isLower then
table.insert(RigBones.RightLowerArm, bone)
else
table.insert(RigBones.RightUpperArm, bone)
end
elseif isLeft then
if isLower then
table.insert(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, bone)
else
table.insert(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, bone)
end
end
elseif string.find(n, "toe") or string.find(n, "ball") or string.find(n, "hoof") or string.find(n, "talon") then
if isRight then
table.insert(RigBones.RightToes, bone)
table.insert(RigBones.RightFoot, bone)
elseif isLeft then
table.insert(RigBones.LeftToes, bone)
table.insert(RigBones.LeftFoot, bone)
end
elseif string.find(n, "leg") or string.find(n, "thigh") or string.find(n, "calf") or string.find(n, "shin") or string.find(n, "knee") or string.find(n, "foot") or string.find(n, "ankle") or string.find(n, "hip") or string.find(n, "femur") or string.find(n, "tibia") or string.find(n, "upleg") then
local isFoot = string.find(n, "foot") or string.find(n, "ankle") or string.find(n, "heel")
local legDepth = GetLimbDepthByKeyword(bone, "leg", "thigh", "hip")
local isLower = not isFoot and (
string.find(n, "low")
or string.find(n, "calf")
or string.find(n, "shin")
or string.find(n, "knee")
or string.find(n, "tibia")
or legDepth >= 1
)
if isRight then
if isFoot then
table.insert(RigBones.RightFoot, bone)
elseif isLower then
table.insert(RigBones.RightLowerLeg, bone)
else
table.insert(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, bone)
end
elseif isLeft then
if isFoot then
table.insert(RigBones.LeftFoot, bone)
elseif isLower then
table.insert(RigBones.LeftLowerLeg, bone)
else
table.insert(RigBones.LeftUpperLeg, bone)
end
end
elseif string.find(n, "pelvis") or string.find(n, "hips") or string.find(n, "waist") or string.find(n, "root") then
table.insert(RigBones.Pelvis, bone)
if bone.Parent and bone.Parent:IsA("Bone") then
table.insert(spineCandidates, bone)
end
elseif string.find(n, "spine") or string.find(n, "torso") or string.find(n, "chest") or string.find(n, "rib") or string.find(n, "abdomen") or string.find(n, "body") then
if bone.Parent and bone.Parent:IsA("Bone") then
table.insert(spineCandidates, bone)
end
end
end
table.sort(spineCandidates, function(a, b)
return (BoneRestPosObj[a] and BoneRestPosObj[a].Y or 0) < (BoneRestPosObj[b] and BoneRestPosObj[b].Y or 0)
end)
local totalSpine = #spineCandidates
for idx, sb in ipairs(spineCandidates) do
table.insert(RigBones.Spine, sb)
if idx <= math.max(1, math.floor(totalSpine * 0.34)) then
table.insert(RigBones.LowerSpine, sb)
elseif idx <= math.max(2, math.floor(totalSpine * 0.68)) then
table.insert(RigBones.MidSpine, sb)
else
table.insert(RigBones.UpperChest, sb)
end
end
end
ClassifyAllSkeletonBones()
-- MODÜL 04: KİNEMATİK PROBE & KAFA YÖNÜ (HEAD-FORWARD) OTOMATİK KALİBRATÖRÜ
local function GetAverageBoneWorldPos(group)
if not group or #group == 0 then
return nil
end
local sum = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
for i = 1, #group do
local b = group[i]
local ok, pos = pcall(function()
return b.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position
end)
sum = sum + ((ok and pos) and pos or b.WorldPosition)
end
return sum / #group
end
local function ComputeBoneGroupModelRotation(group, pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
local modelSpaceRot = CFrame.fromOrientation(math.rad(pitchDeg), math.rad(yawDeg), math.rad(rollDeg))
local count = math.max(1, #group)
local scale = (count > 1) and (1 / math.sqrt(count)) or 1.0
if scale < 1.0 then
modelSpaceRot = CFrame.new():Lerp(modelSpaceRot, scale)
end
return modelSpaceRot
end
local function ApplyImmediateGroupRotation(group, pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
local modelSpaceRot = ComputeBoneGroupModelRotation(group, pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
for i = 1, #group do
local bone = group[i]
local rest = BoneRestRot[bone] or CFrame.new()
bone.Transform = rest:Inverse() * modelSpaceRot * rest
end
end
local function ResetAllBonesToRest()
for i = 1, #allBones do
allBones[i].Transform = CFrame.new()
end
end
local CalibratedAxes = {
HeadForwardLocalZ = -1, -- Model uzayında yürünen ileri yön (-Z = RootPart.CFrame.LookVector)
ModelYawOffsetRad = math.rad(CONFIG.MODEL_YAW_OFFSET_DEG),
ArmForwardSign = CONFIG.ARM_FORWARD_SIGN,         -- -1: Kollar yürünen yöne (LookVector) uzanır
ElbowInwardSign = CONFIG.ELBOW_INWARD_SIGN,       -- -1: Dirsekler yürünen yöne doğru bükülür
SpineForwardSign = CONFIG.SPINE_FORWARD_SIGN,     -- -1: Gövde yürünen yöne doğru eğilir
LegForwardSign = CONFIG.LEG_FORWARD_SIGN,         -- -1: Üst bacak yürünen yöne adım atar
KneeBackwardSign = CONFIG.KNEE_BACKWARD_SIGN,     -- +1: Dizler anatomik olarak geriye kırılır
HeadPitchForwardSign = CONFIG.SPINE_FORWARD_SIGN, -- -1: Kafa/boyun ileri eğim ekseni
}
local function RunKinematicHeadForwardCalibration()
ResetAllBonesToRest()
local alignedOrigin = CALIBRATION_ORIGIN * CFrame.Angles(0, CalibratedAxes.ModelYawOffsetRad, 0)
if locustModel:IsA("Model") then
locustModel:PivotTo(alignedOrigin)
else
mainMesh.CFrame = alignedOrigin
end
local currentMeshInvRot = mainMesh.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse()
for _, bone in ipairs(allBones) do
BoneRestRot[bone] = currentMeshInvRot * bone.WorldCFrame.Rotation
end
if not CONFIG.AUTO_CALIBRATE_AXES then
print(string.format(
"🧭 [Kalibrasyon Kilidi Aktif] Yürüme Yönü (LookVector) Eksenleri: Kol=%d | Dirsek=%d | Gövde=%d | Bacak=%d | Diz=%d",
CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign,
CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign,
CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign,
CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign,
CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign
))
return
end
local headWorldForward = alignedOrigin.LookVector -- (0, 0, -1)
local probeHandGroup = (#RigBones.RightHand > 0 and RigBones.RightHand)
or (#RigBones.RightLowerArm > 0 and RigBones.RightLowerArm)
or RigBones.RightUpperArm
if #RigBones.RightUpperArm > 0 and #probeHandGroup > 0 then
ResetAllBonesToRest()
local restHandPos = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(probeHandGroup)
ApplyImmediateGroupRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, 35, 0, 0)
local testHandPosPos = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(probeHandGroup)
ApplyImmediateGroupRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, -35, 0, 0)
local testHandPosNeg = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(probeHandGroup)
ResetAllBonesToRest()
if restHandPos and testHandPosPos and testHandPosNeg then
local forwardDeltaPos = (testHandPosPos - restHandPos):Dot(headWorldForward)
local forwardDeltaNeg = (testHandPosNeg - restHandPos):Dot(headWorldForward)
if math.abs(forwardDeltaNeg - forwardDeltaPos) > 0.15 then
CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign = (forwardDeltaNeg > forwardDeltaPos) and -1 or 1
CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
end
end
end
if #RigBones.Spine > 0 and #RigBones.Head > 0 then
ResetAllBonesToRest()
local restHead = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(RigBones.Head)
ApplyImmediateGroupRotation(RigBones.Spine, 20, 0, 0)
local headPlus = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(RigBones.Head)
ApplyImmediateGroupRotation(RigBones.Spine, -20, 0, 0)
local headMinus = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(RigBones.Head)
ResetAllBonesToRest()
if restHead and headPlus and headMinus then
local fwdPlus = (headPlus - restHead):Dot(headWorldForward)
local fwdMinus = (headMinus - restHead):Dot(headWorldForward)
if math.abs(fwdMinus - fwdPlus) > 0.15 then
CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign = (fwdMinus > fwdPlus) and -1 or 1
CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
end
end
end
local probeFootGroup = (#RigBones.RightFoot > 0 and RigBones.RightFoot)
or (#RigBones.RightLowerLeg > 0 and RigBones.RightLowerLeg)
or RigBones.RightUpperLeg
if #RigBones.RightUpperLeg > 0 and #probeFootGroup > 0 then
ResetAllBonesToRest()
local restFoot = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(probeFootGroup)
ApplyImmediateGroupRotation(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, 30, 0, 0)
local footPlus = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(probeFootGroup)
ApplyImmediateGroupRotation(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, -30, 0, 0)
local footMinus = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(probeFootGroup)
ResetAllBonesToRest()
if restFoot and footPlus and footMinus then
local legFwdPlus = (footPlus - restFoot):Dot(headWorldForward)
local legFwdMinus = (footMinus - restFoot):Dot(headWorldForward)
if math.abs(legFwdMinus - legFwdPlus) > 0.15 then
CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign = (legFwdMinus > legFwdPlus) and -1 or 1
CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign = -CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign
end
end
end
end
RunKinematicHeadForwardCalibration()
local BoneTargetTransforms = {}
for _, b in ipairs(allBones) do
BoneTargetTransforms[b] = CFrame.new()
end
local function SetGroupTargetRotation(group, pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
if not group or #group == 0 then
return
end
local modelSpaceRot = ComputeBoneGroupModelRotation(group, pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
for i = 1, #group do
local bone = group[i]
local rest = BoneRestRot[bone] or CFrame.new()
BoneTargetTransforms[bone] = rest:Inverse() * modelSpaceRot * rest
end
end
local function AddGroupTargetRotation(group, addPitchDeg, addYawDeg, addRollDeg)
if not group or #group == 0 then
return
end
local deltaRot = ComputeBoneGroupModelRotation(group, addPitchDeg, addYawDeg, addRollDeg)
for i = 1, #group do
local bone = group[i]
local rest = BoneRestRot[bone] or CFrame.new()
local localDelta = rest:Inverse() * deltaRot * rest
BoneTargetTransforms[bone] = (BoneTargetTransforms[bone] or CFrame.new()) * localDelta
end
end
local baseHeightOffset = (mainMesh.Size.Y * 0.5) - 2.95
-- MODÜL 05: ÇOK-HARMONİKLİ PERLIN GÜRÜLTÜSÜ, YAY FİZİĞİ VE ANALOG KORKU SEĞİRME MOTORU
local HorrorMath = {}
function HorrorMath.FractalNoise(t, freq, octaves, seed)
local total = 0
local amp = 1.0
local maxAmp = 0
local curFreq = freq
for i = 1, (octaves or 3) do
total = total + math.noise(t * curFreq + (seed or 0) * 17.3, i * 31.7, (seed or 0) * 5.1) * amp
maxAmp = maxAmp + amp
amp = amp * 0.5
curFreq = curFreq * 2.08
end
return (maxAmp > 0) and (total / maxAmp) or 0
end
function HorrorMath.SpasmPulse(clock, seed, threshold)
local n = math.noise(clock * 3.8, seed * 19.1, 7.3)
local cutoff = threshold or 0.36
if math.abs(n) > cutoff then
local excess = (math.abs(n) - cutoff) / (1.0 - cutoff)
local highFreqJitter = math.sin(clock * 68 + seed * 11) * math.cos(clock * 43)
return math.clamp(excess * 2.8, 0, 1.5) * highFreqJitter * CONFIG.HORROR_TWITCH_INTENSITY
end
return 0
end
local NeckSnapState = {
TargetRoll = 0,
TargetYaw = 0,
TargetPitch = 0,
CurrentRoll = 0,
CurrentYaw = 0,
CurrentPitch = 0,
NextSnapTime = 0,
IsSnapped = false,
}
function HorrorMath.UpdateNeckSnap(now, dt, walkBlend, isExecuting)
if isExecuting then
NeckSnapState.TargetRoll = 0
NeckSnapState.TargetYaw = 0
NeckSnapState.TargetPitch = 0
elseif now >= NeckSnapState.NextSnapTime then
local rollChance = math.random()
if rollChance < CONFIG.NECK_SNAP_FREQUENCY then
local side = (math.random(0, 1) == 0) and -1 or 1
local intensity = (1.0 - walkBlend * 0.45) * CONFIG.HORROR_TWITCH_INTENSITY
NeckSnapState.TargetRoll = side * math.random(32, CONFIG.NECK_SNAP_MAX_ANGLE) * intensity
NeckSnapState.TargetYaw = -side * math.random(15, 42) * intensity
NeckSnapState.TargetPitch = math.random(-22, 28) * intensity
NeckSnapState.IsSnapped = true
NeckSnapState.NextSnapTime = now + math.random(18, 55) / 100
else
NeckSnapState.TargetRoll = math.sin(now * 1.3) * 8
NeckSnapState.TargetYaw = math.cos(now * 0.9) * 6
NeckSnapState.TargetPitch = 0
NeckSnapState.IsSnapped = false
NeckSnapState.NextSnapTime = now + math.random(65, 160) / 100
end
end
local snapLerpSpeed = NeckSnapState.IsSnapped and 28 or 9
local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-snapLerpSpeed * dt)
NeckSnapState.CurrentRoll = NeckSnapState.CurrentRoll + (NeckSnapState.TargetRoll - NeckSnapState.CurrentRoll) * alpha
NeckSnapState.CurrentYaw = NeckSnapState.CurrentYaw + (NeckSnapState.TargetYaw - NeckSnapState.CurrentYaw) * alpha
NeckSnapState.CurrentPitch = NeckSnapState.CurrentPitch + (NeckSnapState.TargetPitch - NeckSnapState.CurrentPitch) * alpha
return NeckSnapState.CurrentPitch, NeckSnapState.CurrentYaw, NeckSnapState.CurrentRoll
end
-- MODÜL 06: TERS KİNEMATİK (IK) ZEMİN AYAK BASIŞI VE KANLI AYAK İZİ SİSTEMİ
local FootIKRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
FootIKRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
FootIKRayParams.IgnoreWater = false
local FootIKState = {
LeftHeightAdjustment = 0,
RightHeightAdjustment = 0,
LeftSlopePitch = 0,
RightSlopePitch = 0,
PelvisDropOffset = 0,
LastLeftFootstepClock = 0,
LastRightFootstepClock = 0,
}
local function SpawnFootstepImpact(worldPos, groundNormal, isRunning, isCrawling)
if os.clock() - FootIKState.LastLeftFootstepClock < 0.08 then
return
end
if math.random() < (isRunning and 0.65 or 0.30) and EntityState.ActiveBloodCount < CONFIG.MAX_ACTIVE_BLOOD_PARTS then
EntityState.ActiveBloodCount = EntityState.ActiveBloodCount + 1
local footprint = Instance.new("Part")
footprint.Name = "LocustFootTrace"
footprint.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
footprint.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
footprint.Color = isRunning and Color3.fromRGB(65, 8, 10) or Color3.fromRGB(16, 12, 13)
footprint.Transparency = 0.35
footprint.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.85, 0.85)
footprint.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(worldPos + groundNormal * 0.03, worldPos + groundNormal * 2)
* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
footprint.Anchored = true
footprint.CanCollide = false
footprint.CanQuery = false
footprint.CanTouch = false
footprint.Parent = GoreFolder
TweenService:Create(footprint, TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Transparency = 1,
Size = Vector3.new(0.02, 1.35, 1.35),
}):Play()
task.delay(2.25, function()
EntityState.ActiveBloodCount = math.max(0, EntityState.ActiveBloodCount - 1)
if footprint and footprint.Parent then
footprint:Destroy()
end
end)
end
end
local function SolveFootSurfaceIK(dt, rootCF, sSin, sCos, walkBlend, runBlend)
if not CONFIG.ENABLE_FOOTSTEP_IK then
FootIKState.LeftHeightAdjustment = 0
FootIKState.RightHeightAdjustment = 0
FootIKState.LeftSlopePitch = 0
FootIKState.RightSlopePitch = 0
FootIKState.PelvisDropOffset = 0
return
end
FootIKRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character, locustModel, GoreFolder }
local rightFootOrigin = (rootCF * CFrame.new(0.85, 1.8, -sSin * 1.4 * walkBlend)).Position
local leftFootOrigin = (rootCF * CFrame.new(-0.85, 1.8, sSin * 1.4 * walkBlend)).Position
local rayVec = Vector3.new(0, -CONFIG.FOOT_RAYCAST_DEPTH, 0)
local rightHit = Workspace:Raycast(rightFootOrigin, rayVec, FootIKRayParams)
local leftHit = Workspace:Raycast(leftFootOrigin, rayVec, FootIKRayParams)
local expectedGroundY = rootCF.Position.Y - 3.0
local targetRightH = 0
local targetLeftH = 0
local targetRightSlope = 0
local targetLeftSlope = 0
if rightHit then
targetRightH = math.clamp(rightHit.Position.Y - expectedGroundY, -1.4, 1.6)
local fwdDot = rightHit.Normal:Dot(rootCF.LookVector)
targetRightSlope = math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(fwdDot, -0.6, 0.6)))
if sSin < -0.75 and not EntityState.RightFootPlanted and walkBlend > 0.25 then
EntityState.RightFootPlanted = true
SpawnFootstepImpact(rightHit.Position, rightHit.Normal, runBlend > 0.4, EntityState.IsCrawling)
elseif sSin > 0 then
EntityState.RightFootPlanted = false
end
end
if leftHit then
targetLeftH = math.clamp(leftHit.Position.Y - expectedGroundY, -1.4, 1.6)
local fwdDot = leftHit.Normal:Dot(rootCF.LookVector)
targetLeftSlope = math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(fwdDot, -0.6, 0.6)))
if sSin > 0.75 and not EntityState.LeftFootPlanted and walkBlend > 0.25 then
EntityState.LeftFootPlanted = true
SpawnFootstepImpact(leftHit.Position, leftHit.Normal, runBlend > 0.4, EntityState.IsCrawling)
elseif sSin < 0 then
EntityState.LeftFootPlanted = false
end
end
local ikAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-16 * dt)
FootIKState.RightHeightAdjustment = FootIKState.RightHeightAdjustment + (targetRightH - FootIKState.RightHeightAdjustment) * ikAlpha
FootIKState.LeftHeightAdjustment = FootIKState.LeftHeightAdjustment + (targetLeftH - FootIKState.LeftHeightAdjustment) * ikAlpha
FootIKState.RightSlopePitch = FootIKState.RightSlopePitch + (targetRightSlope - FootIKState.RightSlopePitch) * ikAlpha
FootIKState.LeftSlopePitch = FootIKState.LeftSlopePitch + (targetLeftSlope - FootIKState.LeftSlopePitch) * ikAlpha
local lowestFoot = math.min(FootIKState.RightHeightAdjustment, FootIKState.LeftHeightAdjustment)
FootIKState.PelvisDropOffset = math.clamp(lowestFoot * 0.45, -0.8, 0.6)
end
-- MODÜL 07: AV TAKİBİ (HEAD-TRACKING) VE PROSEDÜREL KORKU BİYOMEKANİK ÇÖZÜCÜSÜ
local function ScanNearestPreyAndTargetHead(maxRange)
local bestModel = nil
local bestHead = nil
local bestDist = maxRange or CONFIG.HEAD_TRACKING_RANGE
local myPos = RootPart.Position
for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("Humanoid") and obj.Health > 0 then
local m = obj.Parent
if m and m:IsA("Model")
and m ~= Character
and m ~= locustModel
and m.Name ~= CONFIG.VICTIM_CLONE_NAME
and m.Name ~= "LocustVictimClone"
then
local r = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
or m:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
or m:FindFirstChild("Torso")
local h = m:FindFirstChild("Head") or r
if r and r:IsA("BasePart") then
local d = (r.Position - myPos).Magnitude
if d < bestDist then
bestDist = d
bestModel = m
bestHead = h
end
end
end
end
end
EntityState.NearestPreyModel = bestModel
EntityState.NearestPreyHead = bestHead
EntityState.NearestPreyDist = bestDist
return bestModel, bestHead, bestDist
end
local LastPreyScanClock = 0
local function ComputePreyHeadTrackingAngles(entityCF)
if not EntityState.NearestPreyHead or not EntityState.NearestPreyHead.Parent then
return 0, 0
end
local headWorldPos = entityCF.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
local toPrey = EntityState.NearestPreyHead.Position - headWorldPos
local dist = toPrey.Magnitude
if dist < 1.5 or dist > CONFIG.HEAD_TRACKING_RANGE then
return 0, 0
end
local localDir = entityCF:VectorToObjectSpace(toPrey.Unit)
local lookYawDeg = math.deg(math.atan2(-localDir.X, -localDir.Z))
local lookPitchDeg = math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(localDir.Y, -0.85, 0.85)))
local weight = math.clamp(1.0 - (dist / CONFIG.HEAD_TRACKING_RANGE), 0.15, 1.0) * CONFIG.HEAD_TRACKING_WEIGHT
return math.clamp(lookPitchDeg * weight, -38, 42), math.clamp(lookYawDeg * weight, -62, 62)
end
local function SolveLocomotionAndHorrorPose(dt, now, entityCF, sSin, sCos, breathe)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local lf = CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign
local kf = CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
local walkB = EntityState.WalkBlend
local runB = EntityState.RunBlend
local crawlB = EntityState.CrawlBlend
local ambushB = EntityState.AmbushBlend
local idleB = math.clamp(1.0 - walkB, 0, 1)
local stalkOnlyB = walkB * (1.0 - runB)
local spasmArmR = HorrorMath.SpasmPulse(now, 1.1, 0.38)
local spasmArmL = HorrorMath.SpasmPulse(now, 2.7, 0.38)
local spasmSpine = HorrorMath.SpasmPulse(now, 4.3, 0.42)
local eerieFbm = HorrorMath.FractalNoise(now, 1.65, 3, 9.2)
local clawTremor = math.sin(now * 34) * (1.8 + runB * 4.5) * CONFIG.HORROR_TWITCH_INTENSITY
local snapPitch, snapYaw, snapRoll = HorrorMath.UpdateNeckSnap(now, dt, walkB, false)
local trackPitch, trackYaw = ComputePreyHeadTrackingAngles(entityCF)
local strideAmp = (26 * stalkOnlyB + 38 * runB) * (1.0 - crawlB * 0.35) * (1.0 - ambushB)
local rHipForward = (sSin * strideAmp) + (6 * idleB) + (26 * crawlB) - (62 * ambushB)
local lHipForward = (-sSin * strideAmp) + (4 * idleB) + (26 * crawlB) - (64 * ambushB)
local rSwingLift = math.clamp(sCos, 0, 1)
local lSwingLift = math.clamp(-sCos, 0, 1)
local rKneeFlex = (10 * idleB)
+ (rSwingLift * (34 * stalkOnlyB + 42 * runB) + 8 * walkB)
+ (46 * crawlB)
+ (90 * ambushB)
local lKneeFlex = (12 * idleB)
+ (lSwingLift * (34 * stalkOnlyB + 42 * runB) + 8 * walkB)
+ (46 * crawlB)
+ (88 * ambushB)
rKneeFlex = rKneeFlex + math.max(0, FootIKState.RightHeightAdjustment * 12)
lKneeFlex = lKneeFlex + math.max(0, FootIKState.LeftHeightAdjustment * 12)
local rFootAngle = -rHipForward * 0.38 + FootIKState.RightSlopePitch
local lFootAngle = -lHipForward * 0.38 + FootIKState.LeftSlopePitch
local legSplayRoll = 3 + 4 * runB + 15 * crawlB + 26 * ambushB
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, lf * rHipForward, -3 * idleB, legSplayRoll)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerLeg, kf * rKneeFlex, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightFoot, lf * rFootAngle, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightToes, lf * (rSwingLift * 20 - 8), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperLeg, lf * lHipForward, 3 * idleB, -legSplayRoll)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerLeg, kf * lKneeFlex, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFoot, lf * lFootAngle, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftToes, lf * (lSwingLift * 20 - 8), 0, 0)
local forwardHunch = (7 * idleB)
+ (CONFIG.STALK_SPINE_HUNCH_DEG * stalkOnlyB)
+ (CONFIG.RUN_SPINE_HUNCH_DEG * runB)
+ (42 * crawlB)
+ (50 * ambushB)
+ (breathe * 2.4 * idleB)
+ (spasmSpine * 5)
local spineTwistYaw = sSin * (6 * stalkOnlyB + 11 * runB + 14 * crawlB) + (eerieFbm * 5 * idleB)
local spineLurchRoll = sCos * (3.5 * stalkOnlyB + 6.5 * runB) + (spasmSpine * 7)
if #RigBones.LowerSpine > 0 or #RigBones.MidSpine > 0 or #RigBones.UpperChest > 0 then
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Pelvis, sf * (forwardHunch * 0.12), -spineTwistYaw * 0.35, spineLurchRoll * 0.25)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LowerSpine, sf * (forwardHunch * 0.24), spineTwistYaw * 0.30, spineLurchRoll * 0.30)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.MidSpine, sf * (forwardHunch * 0.30), spineTwistYaw * 0.35, spineLurchRoll * 0.35)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.UpperChest, sf * (forwardHunch * 0.34 + breathe * 2.5), spineTwistYaw * 0.40, spineLurchRoll * 0.40)
else
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * forwardHunch, spineTwistYaw, spineLurchRoll)
end
local rClavicleLift = 5 * idleB + 9 * stalkOnlyB + 16 * runB + breathe * 3 + spasmArmR * 10
local lClavicleLift = 4 * idleB + 9 * stalkOnlyB + 16 * runB - breathe * 2.5 + spasmArmL * 10
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightClavicle, af * (6 + 10 * runB), -6, rClavicleLift)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftClavicle, af * (6 + 10 * runB), 6, -lClavicleLift)
local baseForwardReach = (12 * idleB)
+ (CONFIG.STALK_ARM_REACH_DEG * stalkOnlyB)
+ (CONFIG.RUN_ARM_REACH_DEG * runB)
+ (68 * crawlB)
+ (36 * ambushB)
local predStrideSwing = (24 * stalkOnlyB + 34 * runB + 32 * crawlB) * (1.0 - ambushB)
local rArmForwardSwing = -sSin * predStrideSwing
local lArmForwardSwing = sSin * predStrideSwing
local rArmForwardDeg = baseForwardReach + rArmForwardSwing + (breathe * 2.5 * idleB) + (spasmArmR * 12)
local lArmForwardDeg = baseForwardReach + lArmForwardSwing - (breathe * 2.2 * idleB) + (spasmArmL * 12)
local rForwardPhase = math.clamp(-sSin, 0, 1)
local lForwardPhase = math.clamp(sSin, 0, 1)
local rElbowFlexDeg = (24 * idleB)
+ ((20 + rForwardPhase * 22) * stalkOnlyB)
+ ((34 + rForwardPhase * 28) * runB)
+ (38 * crawlB)
+ (64 * ambushB)
+ (spasmArmR * 12)
local lElbowFlexDeg = (22 * idleB)
+ ((20 + lForwardPhase * 22) * stalkOnlyB)
+ ((34 + lForwardPhase * 28) * runB)
+ (38 * crawlB)
+ (62 * ambushB)
+ (spasmArmL * 12)
local armYawInward = 6 * stalkOnlyB + 14 * runB - 16 * crawlB + math.sin(now * 2.8) * 3
local armOutwardRoll = 9 + 8 * stalkOnlyB + 14 * runB + 22 * crawlB
SetGroupTargetRotation(
RigBones.RightUpperArm,
af * rArmForwardDeg,
-armYawInward + spasmArmR * 8,
armOutwardRoll + spasmArmR * 9
)
SetGroupTargetRotation(
RigBones.RightLowerArm,
ef * rElbowFlexDeg,
-6 * stalkOnlyB - 12 * runB,
5 * runB
)
SetGroupTargetRotation(
RigBones.LeftUpperArm,
af * lArmForwardDeg,
armYawInward + spasmArmL * 8,
-armOutwardRoll - spasmArmL * 9
)
SetGroupTargetRotation(
RigBones.LeftLowerArm,
ef * lElbowFlexDeg,
6 * stalkOnlyB + 12 * runB,
-5 * runB
)
local clawCurl = CONFIG.CLAW_CURL_BASE_DEG + 14 * stalkOnlyB + 24 * runB + clawTremor
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightHand, ef * (14 + 12 * runB), -8, 10 + clawTremor * 0.5)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftHand, ef * (14 + 12 * runB), 8, -10 - clawTremor * 0.5)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightFingers, ef * clawCurl, 0, clawTremor)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * clawCurl, 0, -clawTremor)
local rootPitchDeg = 4 * walkB + 10 * runB + 22 * crawlB
local headHorizonCompensation = -(forwardHunch + rootPitchDeg) * 0.78
local finalHeadPitch = headHorizonCompensation + trackPitch + (snapPitch * (1.0 - walkB * 0.65)) + (breathe * 2.2)
local finalHeadYaw = trackYaw + (snapYaw * (1.0 - walkB * 0.5)) + (eerieFbm * 10 * idleB)
local finalHeadRoll = snapRoll + math.cos(now * 1.45) * 7 * idleB + (sSin * 5 * runB)
if #RigBones.NeckBase > 0 or #RigBones.NeckUpper > 0 then
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.NeckBase, hf * (finalHeadPitch * 0.45), finalHeadYaw * 0.4, finalHeadRoll * 0.35)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.NeckUpper, hf * (finalHeadPitch * 0.55), finalHeadYaw * 0.5, finalHeadRoll * 0.55)
else
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (finalHeadPitch * 0.5), finalHeadYaw * 0.5, finalHeadRoll * 0.5)
end
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * finalHeadPitch, finalHeadYaw, finalHeadRoll)
local preyProximityFactor = math.clamp(1.0 - (EntityState.NearestPreyDist / 28), 0, 1)
local jawOpenDeg = (5 * idleB)
+ (12 * stalkOnlyB)
+ (26 * runB)
+ (preyProximityFactor * 22)
+ math.abs(spasmSpine) * 18
+ math.sin(now * 26) * (2.5 + preyProximityFactor * 5)
EntityState.JawOpenRatio = math.clamp(jawOpenDeg / CONFIG.JAW_UNHINGE_MAX_DEG, 0, 1)
if #RigBones.Jaw > 0 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Jaw, -hf * jawOpenDeg, math.sin(now * 41) * 2.2, 0)
end
end
-- MODÜL 08: ARTERYEL KAN PÜSKÜRTME, ZEMİN KAN GÖLÜ VE UZUV PARÇALAMA FİZİK MOTORU
local GoreRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
GoreRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local function SpawnExpandingBloodPuddle(groundPos, groundNormal, maxRadius)
if not CONFIG.ENABLE_BLOOD_PUDDLES or EntityState.ActiveBloodCount >= CONFIG.MAX_ACTIVE_BLOOD_PARTS then
return
end
EntityState.ActiveBloodCount = EntityState.ActiveBloodCount + 1
local puddle = Instance.new("Part")
puddle.Name = "LocustBloodPuddle"
puddle.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
puddle.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
puddle.Reflectance = 0.18
puddle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(105, 4, 8)
puddle.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.35, 0.35)
puddle.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(groundPos + groundNormal * 0.03, groundPos + groundNormal * 2)
* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
puddle.Anchored = true
puddle.CanCollide = false
puddle.CanQuery = false
puddle.CanTouch = false
puddle.Parent = GoreFolder
local finalDiam = math.clamp((maxRadius or 3.2) * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.5), 1.5, 6.5)
local spreadDur = 0.65 + math.random() * 0.45
TweenService:Create(puddle, TweenInfo.new(spreadDur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = Vector3.new(0.05, finalDiam, finalDiam),
}):Play()
task.delay(4.5, function()
if puddle and puddle.Parent then
TweenService:Create(puddle, TweenInfo.new(1.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
Transparency = 1,
}):Play()
end
task.delay(1.85, function()
EntityState.ActiveBloodCount = math.max(0, EntityState.ActiveBloodCount - 1)
if puddle and puddle.Parent then
puddle:Destroy()
end
end)
end)
end
local function SpawnBloodBurst(originPos, baseCount, power, directionalBiasVec)
local scaledCount = math.clamp(math.floor(baseCount * CONFIG.BLOOD_INTENSITY), 1, 48)
GoreRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character, locustModel, GoreFolder }
for i = 1, scaledCount do
if EntityState.ActiveBloodCount >= CONFIG.MAX_ACTIVE_BLOOD_PARTS then
break
end
EntityState.ActiveBloodCount = EntityState.ActiveBloodCount + 1
local isBoneShard = CONFIG.ENABLE_BONE_SHARDS and (i % 9 == 0)
local drop = Instance.new("Part")
drop.Name = isBoneShard and "LocustBoneShard" or "LocustArterialBlood"
drop.Shape = (not isBoneShard and i % 2 == 0) and Enum.PartType.Ball or Enum.PartType.Block
drop.Material = isBoneShard and Enum.Material.Slate or Enum.Material.Neon
drop.Color = isBoneShard
and Color3.fromRGB(215, 200, 185)
or Color3.fromRGB(math.random(125, 175), math.random(4, 14), math.random(8, 18))
local sz = math.random(25, 68) / 100
drop.Size = isBoneShard
and Vector3.new(sz * 0.6, sz * 1.4, sz * 0.5)
or Vector3.new(sz, sz, sz * 2.2)
drop.CFrame = CFrame.new(originPos)
drop.CanCollide = false
drop.CanQuery = false
drop.CanTouch = false
drop.Anchored = true
drop.Parent = GoreFolder
local randSpread = Vector3.new(
math.random(-100, 100),
math.random(5, 135),
math.random(-100, 100)
)
if randSpread.Magnitude < 0.01 then
randSpread = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
end
local dir = randSpread.Unit
if directionalBiasVec and directionalBiasVec.Magnitude > 0.01 then
dir = (dir + directionalBiasVec.Unit * 0.85).Unit
end
local dist = (math.random(28, 64) / 10) * (power or 1.0)
local targetPos = originPos + dir * dist - Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
local dur = math.random(24, 46) / 100
TweenService:Create(drop, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(targetPos, targetPos + dir),
Size = Vector3.new(0.06, 0.06, 0.06),
Transparency = 0.95,
}):Play()
if i <= 3 and math.random() < 0.55 then
local groundHit = Workspace:Raycast(originPos, (targetPos - originPos) + Vector3.new(0, -6, 0), GoreRayParams)
if groundHit then
task.delay(dur * 0.75, function()
SpawnExpandingBloodPuddle(groundHit.Position, groundHit.Normal, 1.8 * (power or 1.0))
end)
end
end
task.delay(dur + 0.05, function()
EntityState.ActiveBloodCount = math.max(0, EntityState.ActiveBloodCount - 1)
if drop and drop.Parent then
drop:Destroy()
end
end)
end
end

local function SolveExecutionBonePose(execPhase, elapsed)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local lf = CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign
local kf = CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, lf * 16, -6, 10)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerLeg, kf * 22, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightFoot, -lf * 8, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperLeg, -lf * 14, 6, -10)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerLeg, kf * 18, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFoot, lf * 10, 0, 0)
if execPhase == 1 then
local stabAlpha = math.clamp(elapsed / 0.35, 0, 1)
local liftAlpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 0.35) / 0.75, 0, 1)
local rightArmPitch = 65 + stabAlpha * 30 + liftAlpha * 22
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (18 - liftAlpha * 28), -12, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (-8 - liftAlpha * 14), 10, -6)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-10 - liftAlpha * 18), 12, -10)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightClavicle, af * 24, -10, 18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * rightArmPitch, -6, 8)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * (12 + liftAlpha * 14), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightHand, ef * 10, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (22 + liftAlpha * 35), 24, -22)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 48, 12, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * 55, 0, 0)
elseif execPhase == 2 then
local phaseTime = elapsed - 1.10
local isRippingPull = (phaseTime >= 0.55)
local ripOsc = math.sin(elapsed * 45) * 14
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (-10 + (isRippingPull and -14 or 6)), isRippingPull and -22 or 14, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (-14), isRippingPull and -16 or 12, isRippingPull and 18 or -12)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-18 + ripOsc * 0.4), isRippingPull and -18 or 14, isRippingPull and 22 or -14)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * 116, -8, 10)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * 20, 0, 0)
if not isRippingPull then
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 96, -24, -8)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 38, -16, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftHand, ef * 45, -12, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * 78, 0, 0)
else
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (38 + ripOsc), 58, -54)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * (74 + ripOsc), 28, -18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftHand, ef * 65, 20, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * 85, 0, 0)
end
elseif execPhase == 3 then
local hoistAlpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 2.35) / 0.85, 0, 1)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (-22 - hoistAlpha * 12), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (-24 - hoistAlpha * 14), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-32 - hoistAlpha * 16), math.sin(elapsed * 28) * 6, 0)
if #RigBones.Jaw > 0 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Jaw, -hf * CONFIG.JAW_UNHINGE_MAX_DEG, 0, 0)
end
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * (118 + hoistAlpha * 26), -18, 14)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * (34 + hoistAlpha * 28), -16, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (118 + hoistAlpha * 26), 18, -14)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * (34 + hoistAlpha * 28), 16, 0)
elseif execPhase == 4 then
local biteThrash = math.sin(elapsed * 64) * 24
local biteSide = math.cos(elapsed * 48) * 18
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (-16 + biteThrash * 0.35), biteSide * 0.4, biteSide * 0.25)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (-18 + biteThrash * 0.5), -biteSide * 0.6, biteThrash * 0.4)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-22 + biteThrash), biteSide, biteThrash * 0.85)
if #RigBones.Jaw > 0 then
local jawChomp = (math.sin(elapsed * 58) * 0.5 + 0.5) * CONFIG.JAW_UNHINGE_MAX_DEG
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Jaw, -hf * jawChomp, 0, 0)
end
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * (132 + biteThrash * 0.3), -28, 18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * 76, -24, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (132 - biteThrash * 0.3), 28, -18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 76, 24, 0)
else
local throwAlpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 4.25) / 0.45, 0, 1)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (28 * throwAlpha), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (18 * throwAlpha), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (24 * throwAlpha), math.sin(elapsed * 35) * 10, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * (130 - throwAlpha * 85), -12 + throwAlpha * 38, 25)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * (70 - throwAlpha * 50), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (130 - throwAlpha * 85), 12 - throwAlpha * 38, -25)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * (70 - throwAlpha * 50), 0, 0)
end
end
-- MODÜL 09 (DEVAM): 5 AŞAMALI VAHŞİ İNFAZ ÇALIŞTIRICI VE KURBAN KİNEMATİĞİ
local PlayProceduralHorrorSound -- İleri bildirim (Modül 11'de tanımlanır)
local TriggerVHSGlitchPulse     -- İleri bildirim (Modül 11'de tanımlanır)
local function PerformLocustExecution()
local now = os.clock()
if EntityState.IsExecuting or EntityState.IsShrieking or EntityState.IsLunging then
return
end
if (now - EntityState.LastExecTime) < CONFIG.EXECUTION_COOLDOWN then
return
end
local targetModel = ScanNearestPreyAndTargetHead(CONFIG.EXECUTION_RANGE)
EntityState.IsExecuting = true
EntityState.ExecPhase = 1
EntityState.ExecStartTime = now
EntityState.LastExecTime = now
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.min(1.0, EntityState.CameraTrauma + 0.55)
local prevWalkSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed
Humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.EXECUTION_WALK_SPEED
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("EXECUTION_START", RootPart, 1.0)
end
if TriggerVHSGlitchPulse then
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse(0.85, 0.55)
end
local victimClone = nil
local victimTorso = nil
local victimHead = nil
local victimArms = {}
local victimLegs = {}
local allVictimLimbs = {}
local hiddenRealParts = {}
local targetHum = nil
if targetModel then
targetHum = targetModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local targetRoot = targetModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
or targetModel:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
or targetModel:FindFirstChild("Torso")
if targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
local lookTarget = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X, RootPart.Position.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z)
if (lookTarget - RootPart.Position).Magnitude > 0.2 then
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(RootPart.Position, lookTarget)
end
end
local origArch = targetModel.Archivable
targetModel.Archivable = true
local okClone, cloned = pcall(function()
return targetModel:Clone()
end)
targetModel.Archivable = origArch
if okClone and cloned then
victimClone = cloned
end
for _, desc in ipairs(targetModel:GetDescendants()) do
if (desc:IsA("BasePart") or desc:IsA("Decal") or desc:IsA("Texture")) and desc.Transparency < 1 then
hiddenRealParts[desc] = desc.Transparency
desc.Transparency = 1
end
end
end
if not victimClone then
victimClone = BuildFallbackVictimDummy()
end
if victimClone then
victimClone.Name = CONFIG.VICTIM_CLONE_NAME
for _, desc in ipairs(victimClone:GetDescendants()) do
if desc:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or desc:IsA("Humanoid") or desc:IsA("Animator") then
desc:Destroy()
elseif desc:IsA("BasePart") then
desc.CanCollide = false
desc.CanQuery = false
desc.CanTouch = false
desc.Massless = true
local nl = string.lower(desc.Name)
if nl == "torso" or nl == "uppertorso" or nl == "humanoidrootpart" then
if not victimTorso or nl == "torso" or nl == "uppertorso" then
victimTorso = desc
end
elseif nl == "head" then
victimHead = desc
elseif string.find(nl, "arm") or string.find(nl, "hand") then
table.insert(victimArms, desc)
table.insert(allVictimLimbs, desc)
elseif string.find(nl, "leg") or string.find(nl, "foot") then
table.insert(victimLegs, desc)
table.insert(allVictimLimbs, desc)
end
end
end
if not victimTorso then
victimTorso = victimClone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
if victimTorso then
victimTorso.Anchored = true
victimTorso.CFrame = RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, -3.6)
end
victimClone.Parent = Workspace
table.insert(EntityState.CreatedInstances, victimClone)
end
local function DetachAndLaunchLimbGroup(limbList, baseCF, upwardBoost, lateralSpeed)
for idx, limbPart in ipairs(limbList) do
if limbPart and limbPart.Parent then
for _, j in ipairs(limbPart:GetJoints()) do
j:Destroy()
end
for _, ch in ipairs(limbPart:GetChildren()) do
if ch:IsA("Motor6D") or ch:IsA("Weld") or ch:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
ch:Destroy()
end
end
limbPart.Anchored = false
limbPart.CanCollide = true
local sideSign = (idx % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
limbPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = baseCF.RightVector * (sideSign * (lateralSpeed or 22))
+ Vector3.new(0, upwardBoost or 16, 0)
+ baseCF.LookVector * 8
limbPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(
math.random(-28, 28),
math.random(-28, 28),
math.random(-28, 28)
)
SpawnBloodBurst(limbPart.Position, 10, 1.45, baseCF.RightVector * sideSign)
end
end
end
task.spawn(function()
local startTime = os.clock()
local legsRipped = false
local armsRipped = false
local devoured = false
local carcassThrown = false
while EntityState.IsExecuting and (os.clock() - startTime) < 4.85 do
local elapsed = os.clock() - startTime
local entityForwardCF = RootPart.CFrame
if elapsed < 1.10 then
EntityState.ExecPhase = 1
local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / 0.42, 0, 1)
local liftY = 0.5 + alpha * 2.8
local distForward = -3.6 - alpha * 0.65
if victimTorso then
local panicKick = math.sin(elapsed * 42) * 0.08
local targetVictimCF = entityForwardCF
* CFrame.new(0.55, liftY, distForward)
* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(12 + panicKick * 45), math.rad(180), math.rad(panicKick * 32))
victimTorso.CFrame = victimTorso.CFrame:Lerp(targetVictimCF, 0.42)
if math.random() < 0.45 then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position, 4, 1.15, -entityForwardCF.LookVector)
end
end
elseif elapsed < 2.35 then
EntityState.ExecPhase = 2
if victimTorso then
local ripShake = math.sin(elapsed * 58) * 0.11
local targetVictimCF = entityForwardCF
* CFrame.new(0.38 + ripShake, 3.3, -4.15)
* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(16), math.rad(180), math.rad(ripShake * 52))
victimTorso.CFrame = victimTorso.CFrame:Lerp(targetVictimCF, 0.45)
end
if elapsed >= 1.55 and not legsRipped then
legsRipped = true
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.min(1.0, EntityState.CameraTrauma + 0.48)
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("LIMB_RIP", RootPart, 1.15)
end
if victimTorso then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0), 20, 1.75, -entityForwardCF.RightVector)
end
DetachAndLaunchLimbGroup(victimLegs, entityForwardCF, 15, 24)
end
if elapsed >= 1.95 and not armsRipped then
armsRipped = true
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.min(1.0, EntityState.CameraTrauma + 0.52)
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("LIMB_RIP", RootPart, 0.92)
end
if victimTorso then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), 22, 1.95, entityForwardCF.RightVector)
end
DetachAndLaunchLimbGroup(victimArms, entityForwardCF, 18, 26)
end
elseif elapsed < 3.30 then
EntityState.ExecPhase = 3
local hoistAlpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 2.35) / 0.85, 0, 1)
local smoothHoist = hoistAlpha * hoistAlpha * (3 - 2 * hoistAlpha)
if victimTorso then
local targetMouthCF = entityForwardCF
* CFrame.new(0, 3.3 + smoothHoist * 2.35, -4.15 + smoothHoist * 2.15)
* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(18 + smoothHoist * 64), math.rad(180), 0)
victimTorso.CFrame = victimTorso.CFrame:Lerp(targetMouthCF, 0.38)
end
elseif elapsed < 4.25 then
EntityState.ExecPhase = 4
if victimTorso then
local crunchJitter = Vector3.new(
math.sin(elapsed * 75) * 0.18,
math.cos(elapsed * 62) * 0.18,
math.sin(elapsed * 54) * 0.14
)
victimTorso.CFrame = entityForwardCF
* CFrame.new(crunchJitter.X, 5.55 + crunchJitter.Y, -1.95 + crunchJitter.Z)
* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(82), math.rad(180), math.rad(math.sin(elapsed * 60) * 35))
end
if not devoured then
devoured = true
EntityState.CameraTrauma = 1.0
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("DEVOUR_CRUNCH", RootPart, 1.0)
end
if TriggerVHSGlitchPulse then
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse(1.0, 0.75)
end
if victimTorso then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position, 38, 2.6, entityForwardCF.LookVector)
end
if targetHum and targetHum.Parent then
pcall(function()
targetHum:TakeDamage(99999)
targetHum.Health = 0
end)
end
if victimHead and victimHead.Parent then
victimHead.Transparency = 1
end
elseif math.random() < 0.65 and victimTorso then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position, 6, 1.6, entityForwardCF.LookVector)
end
else
EntityState.ExecPhase = 5
if not carcassThrown then
carcassThrown = true
if victimTorso and victimTorso.Parent then
victimTorso.Anchored = false
victimTorso.CanCollide = true
victimTorso.Color = Color3.fromRGB(115, 12, 16)
victimTorso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = entityForwardCF.LookVector * 65 + Vector3.new(0, 22, 0)
victimTorso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(35, -20, 40)
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position, 18, 2.0, entityForwardCF.LookVector)
end
end
end
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
end
if victimClone and victimClone.Parent then
Debris:AddItem(victimClone, 3.0)
end
if targetHum and targetHum.Parent and targetHum.Health > 0 then
for inst, trans in pairs(hiddenRealParts) do
if inst and inst.Parent then
inst.Transparency = trans
end
end
end
EntityState.ExecPhase = 0
EntityState.IsExecuting = false
Humanoid.WalkSpeed = EntityState.IsSprinting and CONFIG.SPRINT_SPEED
or (EntityState.IsCrawling and CONFIG.CRAWL_SPEED or prevWalkSpeed)
end)
end
-- MODÜL 10: ÖZEL KORKU YETENEKLERİ ([Q] ANALOG ÇIĞLIK, [R] YIRTICI ATILMA, [F] GÖLGE & ESP)
-- [Q] ANALOG KORKU ÇIĞLIĞI VE DUYUSAL BOZULMA (PSYCHOLOGICAL SHRIEK)
local function PerformAnalogHorrorShriek()
local now = os.clock()
if EntityState.IsExecuting or EntityState.IsShrieking or EntityState.IsLunging then
return
end
if (now - EntityState.LastShriekTime) < CONFIG.SHRIEK_COOLDOWN then
return
end
EntityState.IsShrieking = true
EntityState.ShriekStartTime = now
EntityState.LastShriekTime = now
EntityState.CameraTrauma = 1.0
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("ANALOG_SHRIEK", RootPart, 1.0)
end
if TriggerVHSGlitchPulse then
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse(1.0, 1.35)
end
local shockRing = Instance.new("Part")
shockRing.Name = "LocustShriekWave"
shockRing.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
shockRing.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
shockRing.Color = Color3.fromRGB(185, 12, 22)
shockRing.Transparency = 0.25

shockRing.CFrame = RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
shockRing.Anchored = true
shockRing.CanCollide = false
shockRing.CanQuery = false

shockRing.Parent = GoreFolder

Transparency = 1,
}):Play()
Debris:AddItem(shockRing, 0.9)
task.delay(1.35, function()
EntityState.IsShrieking = false
end)
end
local function SolveShriekBonePose(elapsed)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
local tremor = math.sin(elapsed * 78) * 14
local archProgress = math.clamp(elapsed / 0.30, 0, 1)
local spineArch = (elapsed < 0.28) and (-18 * archProgress) or (28 + tremor * 0.35)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * spineArch, tremor * 0.25, tremor * 0.2)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (24 + tremor * 0.5), tremor * 0.4, tremor * 0.4)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (32 + tremor), tremor * 0.65, tremor * 0.75)
if #RigBones.Jaw > 0 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Jaw, -hf * CONFIG.JAW_UNHINGE_MAX_DEG, 0, 0)
end
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * (75 + tremor * 0.6), 42, 48 + tremor)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * (35 + tremor * 0.5), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightFingers, ef * (80 + tremor), 0, tremor)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (75 - tremor * 0.6), -42, -48 - tremor)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * (35 - tremor * 0.5), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * (80 + tremor), 0, -tremor)
end
-- [R] YIRTICI ATILMA VE ÇİFT PENÇE DEŞME (PREDATORY LUNGE & SCISSOR SLASH)
local function PerformPredatoryLunge()
local now = os.clock()
if EntityState.IsExecuting or EntityState.IsShrieking or EntityState.IsLunging then
return
end
if (now - EntityState.LastLungeTime) < CONFIG.LUNGE_COOLDOWN then
return
end
EntityState.IsLunging = true
EntityState.LungeStartTime = now
EntityState.LastLungeTime = now
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.min(1.0, EntityState.CameraTrauma + 0.65)
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("PREDATORY_LUNGE", RootPart, 1.05)
end
local lungeDir = RootPart.CFrame.LookVector
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = lungeDir * CONFIG.LUNGE_IMPULSE_SPEED + Vector3.new(0, 22, 0)
task.delay(0.28, function()
local hitTarget = ScanNearestPreyAndTargetHead(12)
local slashPos = (RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, -4.2)).Position
SpawnBloodBurst(slashPos, 18, 1.75, lungeDir)
if hitTarget then
local hum = hitTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
pcall(function()
hum:TakeDamage(45)
end)
end
end
end)
task.delay(0.68, function()
EntityState.IsLunging = false
end)
end
local function SolveLungeBonePose(elapsed)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local lf = CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign
local kf = CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
local isSlash = (elapsed >= 0.24)
if not isSlash then
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * 32, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-18), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * 124, 34, 28)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * 28, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 124, -34, -28)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 28, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, -lf * 36, 0, 8)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerLeg, kf * 48, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperLeg, lf * 28, 0, -8)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerLeg, kf * 36, 0, 0)
else
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * 42, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-10), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * 78, -46, -18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * 64, -28, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 78, 46, 18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 64, 28, 0)
end
end
-- [F] GÖLGE TİTREMESİ (SHADOW FLICKER) VE AV KALP ATIŞI GÖRÜŞÜ (PREY HEARTBEAT ESP)
local function UpdatePreyHighlights(now)
if not CONFIG.ENABLE_PREY_ESP or not EntityState.IsShadowStalking then
for model, hl in pairs(EntityState.PreyHighlights) do
if hl and hl.Parent then
hl.Enabled = false
end
end
return
end
local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 9.5)
for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("Humanoid") and obj.Health > 0 then
local m = obj.Parent
if m and m:IsA("Model") and m ~= Character and m ~= locustModel and m.Name ~= CONFIG.VICTIM_CLONE_NAME then
local hl = EntityState.PreyHighlights[m]
if not hl or not hl.Parent then
hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
hl.Name = "LocustPreySenseHighlight"
hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
hl.Parent = m
EntityState.PreyHighlights[m] = hl
table.insert(EntityState.CreatedInstances, hl)
end
hl.Enabled = true
hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(190, 12, 22)
hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 75)
hl.FillTransparency = 0.55 + pulse * 0.28
hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.1 + pulse * 0.35
end
end
end
end
local function ToggleShadowStalkMode()
EntityState.IsShadowStalking = not EntityState.IsShadowStalking
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("SHADOW_TOGGLE", RootPart, 0.9)
end
if TriggerVHSGlitchPulse then
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse(0.55, 0.35)
end
if not EntityState.IsShadowStalking then
for i = 1, #allMeshParts do
if allMeshParts[i] and allMeshParts[i].Parent then
allMeshParts[i].Transparency = 0
end
end
UpdatePreyHighlights(os.clock())
end
end
-- MODÜL 11: PROSEDÜREL KORKU SES SENTEZLEYİCİ VE VHS POST-PROCESSING EFEKT MOTORU
local HorrorColorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
HorrorColorCorrection.Name = "LocustHorror_ColorCorrection"
HorrorColorCorrection.Brightness = -0.02
HorrorColorCorrection.Contrast = 0.18
HorrorColorCorrection.Saturation = -0.28
HorrorColorCorrection.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 242, 242)
HorrorColorCorrection.Parent = Lighting
table.insert(EntityState.CreatedInstances, HorrorColorCorrection)
local HorrorBlur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
HorrorBlur.Name = "LocustHorror_Blur"
HorrorBlur.Size = 0
HorrorBlur.Parent = Lighting
table.insert(EntityState.CreatedInstances, HorrorBlur)
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse = function(strength, duration)
local s = (strength or 0.7) * CONFIG.VHS_GLITCH_INTENSITY
EntityState.GlitchPulse = math.max(EntityState.GlitchPulse, s)
HorrorColorCorrection.Contrast = 0.18 + s * 0.65
HorrorColorCorrection.Saturation = -0.28 - s * 0.55
HorrorColorCorrection.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, math.clamp(240 - math.floor(s * 140), 80, 255), math.clamp(240 - math.floor(s * 140), 80, 255))
HorrorBlur.Size = s * 8.5
TweenService:Create(HorrorColorCorrection, TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Contrast = EntityState.IsShadowStalking and 0.36 or 0.18,
Saturation = EntityState.IsShadowStalking and -0.55 or -0.28,
TintColor = EntityState.IsShadowStalking and Color3.fromRGB(255, 195, 195) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 242, 242),
}):Play()
TweenService:Create(HorrorBlur, TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = 0,
}):Play()
end
PlayProceduralHorrorSound = function(cueType, parentPart, pitchMult)
local targetParent = parentPart or RootPart
if modelSound then
local sfx = modelSound:Clone()
sfx.Parent = targetParent
if cueType == "EXECUTION_START" then
sfx.Volume = 2.8
sfx.PlaybackSpeed = 0.88 * (pitchMult or 1)
elseif cueType == "LIMB_RIP" then
sfx.Volume = 2.4
sfx.PlaybackSpeed = 1.32 * (pitchMult or 1)
elseif cueType == "DEVOUR_CRUNCH" then
sfx.Volume = 3.2
sfx.PlaybackSpeed = 0.68 * (pitchMult or 1)
elseif cueType == "ANALOG_SHRIEK" then
sfx.Volume = 3.5
sfx.PlaybackSpeed = 1.48 * (pitchMult or 1)
elseif cueType == "PREDATORY_LUNGE" then
sfx.Volume = 2.2
sfx.PlaybackSpeed = 1.18 * (pitchMult or 1)
else
sfx.Volume = 1.5
sfx.PlaybackSpeed = 0.72 * (pitchMult or 1)
end
sfx:Play()
Debris:AddItem(sfx, 5)
end
end

local vel = RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local planarVel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
local speed = planarVel.Magnitude
EntityState.CurrentSpeed = speed
local busyAction = EntityState.IsExecuting or EntityState.IsShrieking or EntityState.IsLunging
local targetWalk = (not busyAction and speed > 0.55) and math.clamp(speed / 11.5, 0, 1) or 0
local targetRun = (not busyAction and speed > 15.5) and math.clamp((speed - 13.5) / 12, 0, 1) or 0
local targetCrawl = (not busyAction and EntityState.IsCrawling) and 1.0 or 0.0
local targetAmbush = (not busyAction and EntityState.IsAmbushing and speed < 2.0) and 1.0 or 0.0
EntityState.WalkBlend = EntityState.WalkBlend + (targetWalk - EntityState.WalkBlend) * (1 - math.exp(-11 * clampedDt))
EntityState.RunBlend = EntityState.RunBlend + (targetRun - EntityState.RunBlend) * (1 - math.exp(-9 * clampedDt))
EntityState.CrawlBlend = EntityState.CrawlBlend + (targetCrawl - EntityState.CrawlBlend) * (1 - math.exp(-8 * clampedDt))
EntityState.AmbushBlend = EntityState.AmbushBlend + (targetAmbush - EntityState.AmbushBlend) * (1 - math.exp(-7 * clampedDt))
local stepFreq = 4.35 + (EntityState.RunBlend * 4.85) + (EntityState.CrawlBlend * 2.4)
EntityState.StridePhase = EntityState.StridePhase + clampedDt * stepFreq * math.max(0.22, EntityState.WalkBlend)
EntityState.IdleClock = EntityState.IdleClock + clampedDt * CONFIG.BREATH_SPEED
EntityState.HorrorClock = EntityState.HorrorClock + clampedDt
local sSin = math.sin(EntityState.StridePhase)
local sCos = math.cos(EntityState.StridePhase)
local breathe = math.sin(EntityState.IdleClock)
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.max(0, EntityState.CameraTrauma - clampedDt * 1.45)
local shakeMag = EntityState.CameraTrauma * EntityState.CameraTrauma * 0.55
local shakeVec = Vector3.new(
HorrorMath.FractalNoise(now, 28, 2, 1.1) * shakeMag,
HorrorMath.FractalNoise(now, 28, 2, 2.2) * shakeMag,
HorrorMath.FractalNoise(now, 28, 2, 3.3) * shakeMag
)
local camBobY = math.sin(EntityState.StridePhase * 2)
* (0.19 * EntityState.WalkBlend + 0.28 * EntityState.RunBlend)
+ breathe * 0.05
- (EntityState.CrawlBlend * 1.45)
- (EntityState.AmbushBlend * 2.1)
local camBobX = sCos * (0.13 * EntityState.WalkBlend + 0.20 * EntityState.RunBlend)
local desiredCamOffset = Vector3.new(camBobX, 3.45 + camBobY, 0) + shakeVec
if EntityState.IsExecuting then
desiredCamOffset = Vector3.new(1.75, 3.85 + math.sin(EntityState.IdleClock * 6) * 0.09, 1.35) + shakeVec
elseif EntityState.IsShrieking then
desiredCamOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.9, 1.8) + shakeVec * 1.6
end
currentCamOffset = currentCamOffset:Lerp(desiredCamOffset, 1 - math.exp(-14 * clampedDt))
if IsSelfTarget then Humanoid.CameraOffset = currentCamOffset end
if Camera then
local targetFOV = CONFIG.CAMERA_DEFAULT_FOV + (EntityState.RunBlend * (CONFIG.CAMERA_SPRINT_FOV - CONFIG.CAMERA_DEFAULT_FOV))
if EntityState.IsExecuting then
targetFOV = CONFIG.CAMERA_EXEC_FOV
elseif EntityState.IsShrieking then
targetFOV = CONFIG.CAMERA_SHRIEK_FOV
end
Camera.FieldOfView = Camera.FieldOfView + (targetFOV - Camera.FieldOfView) * (1 - math.exp(-9 * clampedDt))
end
SolveFootSurfaceIK(clampedDt, RootPart.CFrame, sSin, sCos, EntityState.WalkBlend, EntityState.RunBlend)
local bodyBobY = math.abs(sSin) * (CONFIG.PELVIS_BOB_WALK * EntityState.WalkBlend + CONFIG.PELVIS_BOB_RUN * EntityState.RunBlend)
+ breathe * 0.06 * (1 - EntityState.WalkBlend)
+ FootIKState.PelvisDropOffset
- (EntityState.CrawlBlend * 1.85)
- (EntityState.AmbushBlend * 2.65)
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local bodyPitch = math.rad(sf * (5 * EntityState.WalkBlend + 12 * EntityState.RunBlend + 26 * EntityState.CrawlBlend))
local bodyRoll = math.rad(sSin * (2.8 * EntityState.WalkBlend + 4.5 * EntityState.RunBlend))
if EntityState.IsExecuting then
if EntityState.ExecPhase == 1 then
bodyPitch = math.rad(sf * 12)
elseif EntityState.ExecPhase == 2 then
bodyPitch = math.rad(sf * 6)
elseif EntityState.ExecPhase == 3 or EntityState.ExecPhase == 4 then
bodyPitch = math.rad(-sf * 16)
else
bodyPitch = math.rad(sf * 18)
end
end
local targetPivot = RootPart.CFrame
* CFrame.new(0, baseHeightOffset + bodyBobY, 0)
* CFrame.Angles(0, CalibratedAxes.ModelYawOffsetRad, 0)
* CFrame.Angles(bodyPitch, 0, bodyRoll)
smoothPivotCF = smoothPivotCF:Lerp(targetPivot, 1 - math.exp(-20 * clampedDt))
if locustModel:IsA("Model") then
locustModel:PivotTo(smoothPivotCF)
else
mainMesh.CFrame = smoothPivotCF
end
if EntityState.IsExecuting then
SolveExecutionBonePose(EntityState.ExecPhase, now - EntityState.ExecStartTime)
elseif EntityState.IsShrieking then
SolveShriekBonePose(now - EntityState.ShriekStartTime)
elseif EntityState.IsLunging then
SolveLungeBonePose(now - EntityState.LungeStartTime)
else
SolveLocomotionAndHorrorPose(clampedDt, now, smoothPivotCF, sSin, sCos, breathe)
end
local boneSmoothAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-16 * clampedDt)
for i = 1, #allBones do
local bone = allBones[i]
local targetT = BoneTargetTransforms[bone] or CFrame.new()
bone.Transform = bone.Transform:Lerp(targetT, boneSmoothAlpha)
end
end)

-- MODÜL 13: BİREYSEL 10 PARMAK BOĞUMU (PHALANGE) VE PENÇE KİNEMATİK ÇÖZÜCÜSÜ
local PhalangeRegistry = {
Right = {
Thumb = {},
Index = {},
Middle = {},
Ring = {},
Pinky = {},
Generic = {},
},
Left = {
Thumb = {},
Index = {},
Middle = {},
Ring = {},
Pinky = {},
Generic = {},
},
}
local function IndexIndividualPhalanges()
local function classifyFingerSide(boneList, targetTable)
for idx, bone in ipairs(boneList) do
local n = string.lower(bone.Name)
local depth = GetLimbDepthByKeyword(bone, "finger", "hand", "thumb")
local entry = {
Bone = bone,
Depth = math.clamp(depth, 1, 3),
PhaseOffset = idx * 0.68,
}
if string.find(n, "thumb") or string.find(n, "pollex") then
table.insert(targetTable.Thumb, entry)
elseif string.find(n, "index") or string.find(n, "point") or string.find(n, "f1") then
table.insert(targetTable.Index, entry)
elseif string.find(n, "mid") or string.find(n, "f2") then
table.insert(targetTable.Middle, entry)
elseif string.find(n, "ring") or string.find(n, "f3") then
table.insert(targetTable.Ring, entry)
elseif string.find(n, "pink") or string.find(n, "little") or string.find(n, "f4") then
table.insert(targetTable.Pinky, entry)
else
table.insert(targetTable.Generic, entry)
end
end
end
classifyFingerSide(RigBones.RightFingers, PhalangeRegistry.Right)
classifyFingerSide(RigBones.LeftFingers, PhalangeRegistry.Left)
end
IndexIndividualPhalanges()
local function SolveDetailedPhalangeArticulation(now, walkBlend, runBlend, isExecuting, execPhase, isShrieking)
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local preyFactor = math.clamp(1.0 - (EntityState.NearestPreyDist / 26), 0, 1)
local function applyFingerChain(chainList, sideSign, fingerIndex, baseCurlDeg, spreadDeg)
for _, item in ipairs(chainList) do
local b = item.Bone
local d = item.Depth
local wave = math.sin(now * (5.5 + runBlend * 8.0) + fingerIndex * 0.95 + item.PhaseOffset)
local microTwitch = HorrorMath.SpasmPulse(now + fingerIndex * 0.31, fingerIndex * 3.7, 0.38) * 24
local curl = baseCurlDeg * (0.65 + d * 0.22) + wave * (9 + preyFactor * 14) + microTwitch
local splay = spreadDeg * sideSign * (1.0 - (d - 1) * 0.35)
if isExecuting then
if execPhase == 1 then
curl = 12 + d * 8
elseif execPhase == 2 then
curl = 78 + math.sin(now * 48 + fingerIndex) * 18
elseif execPhase == 3 or execPhase == 4 then
curl = 68 + d * 12
else
curl = 15
end
elseif isShrieking then
curl = -12 + math.sin(now * 65 + fingerIndex) * 28
splay = splay * 2.4
end
local rest = BoneRestRot[b] or CFrame.new()
local rot = CFrame.fromOrientation(
math.rad(ef * curl),
math.rad(splay * 0.5),
math.rad(splay)
)
BoneTargetTransforms[b] = rest:Inverse() * rot * rest
end
end
local baseCurl = CONFIG.CLAW_CURL_BASE_DEG + walkBlend * 14 + runBlend * 26 + preyFactor * 22
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Thumb, 1, 1, baseCurl * 0.75, 18)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Index, 1, 2, baseCurl * 1.05, 10)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Middle, 1, 3, baseCurl * 1.15, 2)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Ring, 1, 4, baseCurl * 1.10, -7)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Pinky, 1, 5, baseCurl * 0.95, -15)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Generic, 1, 6, baseCurl, 4)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Thumb, -1, 1, baseCurl * 0.75, 18)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Index, -1, 2, baseCurl * 1.05, 10)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Middle, -1, 3, baseCurl * 1.15, 2)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Ring, -1, 4, baseCurl * 1.10, -7)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Pinky, -1, 5, baseCurl * 0.95, -15)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Generic, -1, 6, baseCurl, 4)
end
-- MODÜL 14: OMURGA OMUR DALGALANMASI (VERTEBRAE WAVE) VE OMUZ ÇIKIĞI (DISLOCATION) MOTORU
local ShoulderDislocationState = {
RightPopDeg = 0,
LeftPopDeg = 0,
RightTargetDeg = 0,
LeftTargetDeg = 0,
NextDislocationClock = 0,
}
local function UpdateVertebraeWaveAndShoulderDislocation(now, dt, walkBlend, runBlend, isExecuting)
if isExecuting then
ShoulderDislocationState.RightTargetDeg = 0
ShoulderDislocationState.LeftTargetDeg = 0
elseif now >= ShoulderDislocationState.NextDislocationClock then
ShoulderDislocationState.NextDislocationClock = now + math.random(40, 130) / 100
if math.random() < 0.48 then
local which = math.random(1, 3)
local intensity = CONFIG.HORROR_TWITCH_INTENSITY
if which == 1 or which == 3 then
ShoulderDislocationState.RightTargetDeg = math.random(-24, 32) * intensity
end
if which == 2 or which == 3 then
ShoulderDislocationState.LeftTargetDeg = math.random(-24, 32) * intensity
end
else
ShoulderDislocationState.RightTargetDeg = 0
ShoulderDislocationState.LeftTargetDeg = 0
end
end
local popAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-18 * dt)
ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg = ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg
+ (ShoulderDislocationState.RightTargetDeg - ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg) * popAlpha
ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg = ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg
+ (ShoulderDislocationState.LeftTargetDeg - ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg) * popAlpha
if math.abs(ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg) > 0.5 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightClavicle, 0, 0, ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg)
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg * 0.4, 0, ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg * 0.6)
end
if math.abs(ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg) > 0.5 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftClavicle, 0, 0, -ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg)
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg * 0.4, 0, -ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg * 0.6)
end
local spineCount = #RigBones.Spine
if spineCount > 1 and not isExecuting then
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
for idx, sBone in ipairs(RigBones.Spine) do
local chainRatio = (idx - 1) / math.max(1, spineCount - 1)
local undulationWave = math.sin(now * (3.2 + runBlend * 5.0) - chainRatio * 2.4)
local breathExpansion = math.sin(EntityState.IdleClock * 2.0 - chainRatio * 1.2) * (2.2 + runBlend * 3.5)
local deltaRot = CFrame.fromOrientation(
math.rad(sf * breathExpansion),
math.rad(undulationWave * (3.5 + walkBlend * 4.5)),
math.rad(undulationWave * 2.2)
)
local rest = BoneRestRot[sBone] or CFrame.new()
local localDelta = rest:Inverse() * deltaRot * rest
BoneTargetTransforms[sBone] = (BoneTargetTransforms[sBone] or CFrame.new()) * localDelta
end
end
end
