-- MODÜL 16: DUVARA ÖRÜMCEK TIRMANMA [V] VE KURBAN YAKALAYIP SÜRÜKLEME [B] MEKANİĞİ
local WallClimbState = {
Enabled = false,
IsClimbingWall = false,
WallNormal = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
DraggedVictimModel = nil,
DraggedVictimRoot = nil,
}
local WallRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
WallRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local function UpdateSpiderWallClimbAndVictimDrag(dt)
WallRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character, locustModel, GoreFolder }
-- [V] Duvara Tırmanma Aktifse Kafanın Baktığı Yöndeki (RootPart.LookVector) Duvarı Algıla
if WallClimbState.Enabled and not EntityState.IsExecuting then
local origin = RootPart.Position
local forwardRay = RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 4.5
local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, forwardRay, WallRayParams)
if hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide and math.abs(hit.Normal.Y) < 0.45 then
WallClimbState.IsClimbingWall = true
WallClimbState.WallNormal = hit.Normal
local moveInput = Humanoid.MoveDirection
local climbUpSign = (moveInput.Magnitude > 0.1) and 1 or 0
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X * 0.5,
climbUpSign * (CONFIG.WALK_SPEED * 1.25),
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z * 0.5
) - hit.Normal * 6
else
WallClimbState.IsClimbingWall = false
end
else
WallClimbState.IsClimbingWall = false
end
-- [B] Yakalanmış Kurbanı Kafa Yönünde Sürükleme
if WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot and WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot.Parent and not EntityState.IsExecuting then
local holdCF = RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.9, 1.4, -3.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(65), 0, 0)
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot.CFrame = WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot.CFrame:Lerp(holdCF, 1 - math.exp(-18 * dt))
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
else
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot = nil
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimModel = nil
end
end

if WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot then
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot = nil
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimModel = nil

or targetModel:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
or targetModel:FindFirstChild("Torso")
if r and r:IsA("BasePart") then
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimModel = targetModel
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot = r
SpawnBloodBurst(r.Position, 8, 1.2, RootPart.CFrame.LookVector)
end
end
end

DebugVectorParts.RightArmLaser.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((rShoulder + rHand) * 0.5, rHand)
DebugVectorParts.RightArmLaser.Transparency = 0.2
end
local lShoulder = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(RigBones.LeftUpperArm)
local lHand = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(#RigBones.LeftHand > 0 and RigBones.LeftHand or RigBones.LeftLowerArm)
if lShoulder and lHand then
local len = math.max(0.5, (lHand - lShoulder).Magnitude)
DebugVectorParts.LeftArmLaser.Size = Vector3.new(0.11, 0.11, len)
DebugVectorParts.LeftArmLaser.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((lShoulder + lHand) * 0.5, lHand)
DebugVectorParts.LeftArmLaser.Transparency = 0.2
end

local function ApplyPoseTableInterpolated(poseA, poseB, alpha)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local lf = CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign
local kf = CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
local function lerpVal(a, b)
return a + (b - a) * alpha
end
local function blendGroup(group, key, pitchSign)
local pA = poseA[key]
local pB = poseB[key]
if not pA or not pB then return end
local p = lerpVal(pA.Pitch, pB.Pitch) * pitchSign
local y = lerpVal(pA.Yaw, pB.Yaw)
local r = lerpVal(pA.Roll, pB.Roll)
SetGroupTargetRotation(group, p, y, r)
end
blendGroup(RigBones.Spine, "Spine", sf)
blendGroup(RigBones.Neck, "Neck", hf)
blendGroup(RigBones.Head, "Head", hf)
blendGroup(RigBones.RightUpperArm, "RightUpperArm", af)
blendGroup(RigBones.RightLowerArm, "RightLowerArm", ef)
blendGroup(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, "LeftUpperArm", af)
blendGroup(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, "LeftLowerArm", ef)
blendGroup(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, "RightUpperLeg", lf)
blendGroup(RigBones.RightLowerLeg, "RightLowerLeg", kf)
blendGroup(RigBones.LeftUpperLeg, "LeftUpperLeg", lf)
blendGroup(RigBones.LeftLowerLeg, "LeftLowerLeg", kf)
end
local function PerformAnalogJumpscareTaunt()

end)
end

local function CleanupAndRestoreNormalCharacter()
EntityState.Alive = false
for _, c in ipairs(EntityState.Connections) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
EntityState.Connections = {}
for _, inst in ipairs(EntityState.CreatedInstances) do
pcall(function()
if inst and inst.Parent then inst:Destroy() end
end)
end
EntityState.CreatedInstances = {}
if locustModel and locustModel.Parent then
pcall(function() locustModel:Destroy() end)
end
if GoreFolder and GoreFolder.Parent then
pcall(function() GoreFolder:Destroy() end)
end
if screenGui and screenGui.Parent then
pcall(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)
end
for _, effect in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
if string.find(effect.Name, "LocustHorror_") then
pcall(function() effect:Destroy() end)
end
end
local curChar = TargetPlayer and TargetPlayer.Character
if curChar then
for _, desc in ipairs(curChar:GetDescendants()) do
if SavedOriginalTransparencies[desc] ~= nil then
pcall(function() desc.Transparency = SavedOriginalTransparencies[desc] end)
elseif desc:IsA("BasePart") and desc.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
pcall(function() desc.Transparency = 0 end)
elseif desc:IsA("Decal") or desc:IsA("Texture") then
pcall(function() desc.Transparency = 0 end)
end
if SavedOriginalCanCollide[desc] ~= nil and desc:IsA("BasePart") then
pcall(function() desc.CanCollide = SavedOriginalCanCollide[desc] end)
end
if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
pcall(function() desc.CastShadow = true end)
end
end
local curHum = curChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if curHum then
curHum.WalkSpeed = (SavedWalkSpeed and SavedWalkSpeed > 4) and SavedWalkSpeed or 16
curHum.JumpPower = (SavedJumpPower and SavedJumpPower > 10) and SavedJumpPower or 50
curHum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
end
end
if IsSelfTarget then
pcall(function()
RealLocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = SavedMaxZoom or 128
RealLocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = SavedMinZoom or 0.5
if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = SavedFOV or 70
end
end)
end
end
return {
Player = TargetPlayer,
Model = locustModel,
State = EntityState,
Cleanup = CleanupAndRestoreNormalCharacter
}
end
function Engine.SetLocustV4OnPlayer(targetPlayer, enableState, fromP2P)
local plr = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
if not plr then return end
local pName = plr.Name
local existingSession = State.LocustPlayers[pName]
if not enableState then
if existingSession and type(existingSession.Cleanup) == "function" then
pcall(existingSession.Cleanup)
end
State.LocustPlayers[pName] = nil
TableDB.LocustUsers = TableDB.LocustUsers or {}
TableDB.LocustUsers[pName] = nil

end

"LOCUST NORMALIZE EDİLDİ",
string.format("%s normale döndü! (The Locust V4.2 kaldırıldı)", pName),
Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
3.5
)
end
return
end
if existingSession and type(existingSession.Cleanup) == "function" then
pcall(existingSession.Cleanup)
State.LocustPlayers[pName] = nil
end
task.spawn(function()
local ok, session = pcall(function()
return Engine.SpawnLocustV4InstanceForPlayer(plr)
end)
if ok and session then

TableDB.LocustUsers[pName] = true

BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("LOCUST_ON", pName, "1")
end
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"THE LOCUST V4.2 AKTİF",
string.format("%s -> The Locust V4.2 Analog Horror dönüştürüldü! (Normale döndürmek için tekrar ;locust \"%s\" yazın)", pName, pName),
Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38),
4.0
)
end
else
warn("[BERK'S ADMIN · LOCUST V4] Yukleme hatasi:", session)
end
end)
end

PersonalPrefix = ResolvePersonalPrefix(sender.Name),
LastSignal = lastSignalName or "HANDSHAKE",
Effects = TableDB.ActiveEffectsByUsername[sender.Name] or {}
}

return senderRank

function Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(sender, cmdIndex, targetSlot, numericArg, customArgsTable)
if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
local resolvedCmd = CommandList[cmdIndex]
if not resolvedCmd then return end
RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, resolvedCmd.Name)
local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
if #targets == 0 then
targets = { sender }
end
print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · P2P KOMUT] %s -> ;%s (Hedef: %d oyuncu)", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name, #targets))
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
State.CurrentP2PSender = sender
local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local isPermissionSyncCmd = (resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktallow" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktdeny" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktallowall" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktdenyall")
for _, targetPlr in ipairs(targets) do
local allowedOnB1rkt = Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(sender, targetPlr)
if isPermissionSyncCmd and Engine.IsB1rktOwner(sender) then
allowedOnB1rkt = true
end
if not allowedOnB1rkt then
if targetPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"ADMIN KORUMA KALKANI",
string.format("%s üzerinizde ;%s denedi fakat koruma kalkanınız engelledi!", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name),
Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11),
3
)
end
else
local tChar = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character
local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local tHum = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local secondArgVal = numericArg and tostring(numericArg) or nil
if numericArg and numericArg >= 9901 and numericArg <= 9995 then
local secPlrs = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, numericArg - 9900)
if secPlrs and secPlrs[1] then
secondArgVal = secPlrs[1].Name
end
end
local synthArgs = customArgsTable or {
[1] = (numericArg and numericArg <= 9900 and tostring(numericArg)) or (targetPlr and targetPlr.Name or "me"),
[2] = secondArgVal
}
pcall(function()
resolvedCmd.Action(targetPlr, synthArgs, tHrp, tHum, cam)
end)
if targetPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"P2P · " .. string.upper(resolvedCmd.Name),
string.format("%s sizin uzerinizde ;%s calistirdi!", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name),
GetTierData(ResolvePlayerRankLevel(sender)).Color,
2.5
)
end
end
end
State.PendingPeerNumericArg[sender.Name] = nil
State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
end
function Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, speedVal, trackObj)
if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return end
if type(speedVal) ~= "number" or speedVal < 8.0 or speedVal > 8500.0 then return end
local packetInt = math.floor(((speedVal - 8.0) * 1024.0) + 0.5)
if packetInt < 100 or packetInt > 7999999 then return end
State.SeenAnimationTracks = State.SeenAnimationTracks or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
if trackObj then
if State.SeenAnimationTracks[trackObj] == packetInt then
return
end
State.SeenAnimationTracks[trackObj] = packetInt
end
local dedupKey = plr.Name .. "_" .. tostring(packetInt)
local now = tick()
local dedupWindow = (packetInt >= 220000 and packetInt <= 410000) and 0.04 or 0.52
if State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey] and (now - State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey]) < dedupWindow then
return
end
State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey] = now
-- 1) TEK KANAL ATOMIK BIT-PACKED PAKETLER (1,000,000 .. 7,999,999):
if packetInt >= 1000000 and packetInt <= 7999999 then
local rem = packetInt - 1000000
local opcodeNum = math.floor(rem / 100000)
local rem2 = rem % 100000
local targetSlot = math.floor(rem2 / 1000)
local paramVal = rem2 % 1000
local opcodeStr = string.format("%02d", opcodeNum)
HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(plr, opcodeStr, targetSlot, paramVal)
return
end
-- 2) GERCEK ZAMANLI F3X CANLI GIZMO (MOVE/RESIZE/ROTATE/PAINT/SURF/ANCHOR/FX/CLONE/DEL) PAKETLERI (200,000 .. 499,999):
if packetInt >= 200000 and packetInt <= 499999 then
if Engine.HandleIncomingF3XRealtimePacket then
Engine.HandleIncomingF3XRealtimePacket(plr, packetInt)
end
return
end
-- 3) SAYISAL ON-PAKET (80,000 .. 89,999):
if packetInt >= 80000 and packetInt <= 89999 then
State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name] = packetInt - 80000
return
end
-- 4) EVRENSEL KOMUT & KLASIK OPCODE PAKETLERI (100 .. 79,999):
local cmdCode = math.floor(packetInt / 100)
local targetSlot = packetInt % 100
if cmdCode >= 701 and cmdCode <= 765 then
local opcodeStr = string.format("%02d", cmdCode - 700)
local paramVal = State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name]
State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name] = nil
HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(plr, opcodeStr, targetSlot, paramVal)
elseif cmdCode >= 1 and cmdCode <= #CommandList then
local paramVal = State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name]
Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(plr, cmdCode, targetSlot, paramVal, nil)
end
end
local function HookPlayerAnimateBridge(plr)
local function onCharAdded(char)
task.defer(function()
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(plr)
end)
local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
if not hum then return end
local animator = hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
if not animator then return end
animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
if not track then return end
local anim = track.Animation
local animId = tostring(anim and anim.AnimationId or "")
local prefixStr = "rbxassetid://9900"
if string.sub(animId, 1, #prefixStr) == prefixStr then
local payload = string.sub(animId, #prefixStr + 1)
local opcode = string.sub(payload, 1, 2)
local targetUidStr = string.sub(payload, 3)
HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(plr, opcode, targetUidStr, track.Speed)
return
end
if track.Speed >= 8.0 then
Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, track.Speed, track)
else
local conn
conn = track:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Speed"):Connect(function()
if track.Speed >= 8.0 then
if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, track.Speed, track)
end
end)
task.delay(0.35, function()
if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
end)
end
end)
end
if plr.Character then
task.spawn(onCharAdded, plr.Character)
end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharAdded)
if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
local peerPfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(plr.Name)
local defPfx = TableDB.DefaultPrefix or ";"
local clean = nil
if string.sub(msg, 1, #peerPfx) == peerPfx then
clean = string.sub(msg, #peerPfx + 1)
elseif string.sub(msg, 1, #defPfx) == defPfx then
clean = string.sub(msg, #defPfx + 1)
elseif string.sub(msg, 1, 1) == ";" or string.sub(msg, 1, 1) == "!" then
clean = string.sub(msg, 2)
else
local lmsg = string.lower(string.gsub(msg or "", "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
if string.sub(lmsg, 1, 6) == "locust" or string.sub(lmsg, 1, 9) == "adminmode" then
clean = msg
end
end
if not clean then return end
clean = string.gsub(clean, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
if clean == "" then return end
local parts = Engine.ParseCommandTokensWithQuotes(clean)
local cmdName = string.lower(parts[1] or "")
table.remove(parts, 1)
local resolvedCmd = CommandRegistry[cmdName]
if not resolvedCmd then
for _, c in ipairs(CommandList) do
for _, alias in ipairs(c.Aliases) do
if string.lower(alias) == cmdName then
resolvedCmd = c
break
end
end
if resolvedCmd then break end
end
end
if resolvedCmd and resolvedCmd.CmdIndex then
local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(parts[1] or "me")
if resolvedCmd.Name == "uncontrol" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unfollow" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unorbit" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unloopgoto" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unbackpack" then
slot = 0
elseif parts[1] == nil or string.lower(parts[1]) == "me" or string.lower(parts[1]) == "ben" then
slot = 98
end
Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(plr, resolvedCmd.CmdIndex, slot, tonumber(parts[2] or parts[1]), parts)
end
end)
end
end
_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners = _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners or {}
_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners[LocalPlayer.Name] = function(senderPlr, packetType, a, b, c)
if not senderPlr or senderPlr == LocalPlayer then return end
if packetType == "OPCODE" then
HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(senderPlr, a, b, c)
elseif packetType == "CMD" then
local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(b or "me")
if b == nil or string.lower(tostring(b)) == "me" then slot = 98 end
if string.lower(tostring(b)) == "all" then slot = 0 end
Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(senderPlr, a, slot, tonumber(c and (c[2] or c[1])), c)
end
end
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
HookPlayerAnimateBridge(plr)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(HookPlayerAnimateBridge)
end

local function MakeDraggable(dragHandle, targetFrame)
local dragging = false
local dragInput = nil
local dragStart = Vector3.zero
local startPos = UDim2.new()
dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true
dragStart = input.Position
startPos = targetFrame.Position
input.Changed:Connect(function()
if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
dragging = false
end
end)
end
end)
dragHandle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragInput = input
end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input == dragInput and dragging then
local delta = input.Position - dragStart
targetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
startPos.X.Scale,
startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
startPos.Y.Scale,
startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
)
end
end)
end
function UI.Tr(trText, enText)
if State.Language == "EN" then
return enText or trText
end
return trText
end

return

ttDesc.Text = descStr
CmdHoldTooltip.Visible = true
end

function UI.RefreshCommandListUI(filterText)
CmdTextBox.PlaceholderText = UI.Tr(
string.format("Komut Barı (%s)", State.Prefix),
string.format("Command Bar (%s)", State.Prefix)
)
for _, child in ipairs(CmdsScroll:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("TextButton") then
child:Destroy()
end
end
local rawFilter = filterText or ""
if string.sub(rawFilter, 1, #State.Prefix) == State.Prefix then
rawFilter = string.sub(rawFilter, #State.Prefix + 1)
elseif string.sub(rawFilter, 1, 1) == ";" then
rawFilter = string.sub(rawFilter, 2)
end
local q = string.lower(string.gsub(rawFilter, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
local firstWord = string.split(q, " ")[1] or ""
local visibleCount = 0
for idx, cmd in ipairs(CommandList) do
local descToSearch = (State.Language == "EN" and cmd.DescriptionEn) and cmd.DescriptionEn or cmd.Description
local match = (firstWord == "")
or string.find(string.lower(cmd.Name), firstWord, 1, true) ~= nil
or string.find(string.lower(descToSearch), firstWord, 1, true) ~= nil
if not match then
for _, al in ipairs(cmd.Aliases) do
if string.find(string.lower(al), firstWord, 1, true) then
match = true
break
end
end
end
if match then
visibleCount = visibleCount + 1
local unlocked = (State.LocalRankLevel >= cmd.MinTier) or Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer)
local rowBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
rowBtn.Name = "CmdRow_" .. cmd.Name
rowBtn.LayoutOrder = idx
rowBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 19)
rowBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 43)
rowBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
rowBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
rowBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
rowBtn.TextSize = 11
rowBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
rowBtn.TextColor3 = unlocked and Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245) or Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 150)
local aliasText = #cmd.Aliases > 0 and (" / " .. table.concat(cmd.Aliases, " / ")) or ""
local dispArgs = (State.Language == "EN" and cmd.ArgsEn) and cmd.ArgsEn or cmd.Args
local argsText = (dispArgs and #dispArgs > 0) and (" " .. dispArgs) or ""
local lockSuffix = unlocked and "" or string.format(UI.Tr(" [Kilit T%d]", " [Lock T%d]"), cmd.MinTier)
rowBtn.Text = "  " .. cmd.Name .. aliasText .. argsText .. lockSuffix
rowBtn.Parent = CmdsScroll
local isHolding = false
local holdTriggered = false
rowBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(false)
isHolding = true
holdTriggered = false
task.delay(0.35, function()
if isHolding then
holdTriggered = true
PlayUiSound("tab")
UI.ShowCmdHoldTooltip(cmd)
end
end)
end)
rowBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
isHolding = false
if holdTriggered then
task.delay(1.6, function()

function UI.TriggerHalloweenIntro()
FullIntroOverlay.Visible = true
FullIntroOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
local oldBlur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("BerksHalloweenBlur")
if oldBlur then oldBlur:Destroy() end
local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
blur.Name = "BerksHalloweenBlur"
blur.Size = 0
blur.Parent = Lighting
TweenService:Create(blur, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = 15 }):Play()
for i = 1, 18 do
task.spawn(function()
local pmp = DrawProceduralIcon(FullIntroOverlay, "pumpkin", Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22))
local sz = math.random(22, 38)
pmp.Size = UDim2.new(0, sz, 0, sz)
local startX = math.random(4, 94) / 100
pmp.Position = UDim2.new(startX, 0, -0.12, 0)
pmp.Rotation = math.random(-25, 25)
pmp.ZIndex = 84
local fallDur = 1.25 + (math.random(0, 80) / 100)
TweenService:Create(pmp, TweenInfo.new(fallDur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
Position = UDim2.new(startX + (math.random(-6, 6) / 100), 0, 1.12, 0),
Rotation = pmp.Rotation + math.random(-140, 140)
}):Play()
task.delay(fallDur + 0.1, function()
if pmp and pmp.Parent then pmp:Destroy() end
end)
end)
end
task.delay(2.2, function()
TweenService:Create(blur, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Size = 0 }):Play()
TweenService:Create(FullIntroOverlay, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
BackgroundTransparency = 1
}):Play()
task.delay(0.6, function()
if blur and blur.Parent then blur:Destroy() end
FullIntroOverlay.Visible = false
end)
end)
end
end

end
if #rName == 0 then
rName = "ÖzelRank_" .. tostring(rLvl)
rankNameBox.Text = rName
end

if createdLvl then
local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(drawerSelectedTargetName)
if not targetPlr or (targetPlr == LocalPlayer and not isB1rkt) then
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if p ~= LocalPlayer then targetPlr = p; drawerSelectedTargetName = p.Name; break end
end
end

Engine.SetPlayerRankInTable(targetPlr, createdLvl)
elseif UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("RANK OLUŞTURULDU", string.format("'%s' (Tier %d) oluşturuldu! Kendi rütbeniz (Tier %d) düşmesin diye korundu; listeden istediğiniz oyuncuya 'Yeni Rankı Ver' ile verebilirsiniz.", rName, createdLvl, myRank), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 4)
end

end)

local function RefreshBanKickModalView()

kickNoPermBanner.Visible = not isBan
unbanBtn.Visible = isBan
executeBtn.Size = isBan and UDim2.new(0.65, -8, 0, 32) or UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 32)
executeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isBan and Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(217, 119, 6)
if isBan then
permToggleBtn.Text = isPermBan
and UI.Tr("Perm Ban mı?: EVET (KALICI PERM)", "Permanent Ban?: YES (PERM BAN)")
or UI.Tr("Perm Ban mı?: HAYIR (SÜRELİ BAN)", "Permanent Ban?: NO (TIMED BAN)")
permToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isPermBan and Color3.fromRGB(153, 27, 27) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 64, 175)
local durStr = isPermBan and UI.Tr("Sınırsız (PERM)", "Unlimited (PERM)") or durationOptions[durationIdx]
durationBtn.Text = UI.Tr("Ban Süresi: ", "Ban Duration: ") .. durStr
executeBtn.Text = UI.Tr("BAN UYGULA (P2P)", "APPLY BAN (P2P)")
else
kickNoPermBanner.Text = UI.Tr(
"BİLGİ: Kick işleminde Perm / Süre olmaz.\nHedef oyuncu belirttiğiniz sebeple anlık atılır.",
"INFO: Kick has no Perm / Duration option.\nTarget player is kicked immediately with reason."
)
executeBtn.Text = UI.Tr("KICK UYGULA (ANLIK AT)", "APPLY KICK (INSTANT)")
end
end

curIdx = i
break
end
end
local nextPlr = list[(curIdx % #list) + 1]
if nextPlr then
selectedTargetName = nextPlr.Name
end
end
RefreshBanKickModalView()
end)

elseif durationIdx == 6 then
durationIdx = 2
end

end)
durationBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
PlayUiSound("click")
durationIdx = (durationIdx % #durationOptions) + 1
isPermBan = (durationIdx == 6)
RefreshBanKickModalView()
end)
executeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
PlayUiSound("command")
local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(selectedTargetName) or LocalPlayer
local reasonTxt = (#reasonBox.Text > 0) and reasonBox.Text or "Admin Kararı"
if State.BanKickMenuMode == "BAN" then
local durTxt = isPermBan and "PERM (Sınırsız)" or durationOptions[durationIdx]
local fullReason = string.format("[%s] Sebep: %s", durTxt, reasonTxt)
TableDB.BanDetailsByUsername[selectedTargetName] = {
IsPerm = isPermBan,
Duration = durTxt,
Reason = reasonTxt,
BannedBy = LocalPlayer.Name
}
Engine.ExecuteTablePersistentBan(targetPlr, fullReason)
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("BAN UYGULANDI", "BAN EXECUTED"),
string.format("%s -> %s (%s)", selectedTargetName, durTxt, reasonTxt),
Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
3.5
)
end
else
Engine.ExecuteAdminKick(targetPlr, reasonTxt)
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("KICK UYGULANDI", "KICK EXECUTED"),
string.format("%s (%s)", selectedTargetName, reasonTxt),
Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11),
3.5
)
end
end
end)
unbanBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
PlayUiSound("click")
TableDB.BanDetailsByUsername[selectedTargetName] = nil
TableDB.BannedUsers[selectedTargetName] = nil
SyncTablePersistence()
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("BAN KALDIRILDI", "USER UNBANNED"),
selectedTargetName .. UI.Tr(" yasağı kaldırıldı.", " has been unbanned."),
Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
3
)
end
end)
bkClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
PlayUiSound("drawerClose")
State.BanKickMenuOpen = false
BanKickFrame.Visible = false
end)
function UI.OpenBanKickModal(mode, targetPlr)
State.BanKickMenuMode = (mode == "KICK") and "KICK" or "BAN"
if typeof(targetPlr) == "Instance" and targetPlr:IsA("Player") then
selectedTargetName = targetPlr.Name
elseif type(targetPlr) == "string" and #targetPlr > 0 then
selectedTargetName = targetPlr
end
State.BanKickMenuOpen = true
BanKickFrame.Visible = true
PlayUiSound("drawerOpen")
RefreshBanKickModalView()
end
UI.RefreshBanKickModalView = RefreshBanKickModalView
end

mcrNameInput.Text = rName

end

Engine.SetPlayerRankInTable(targetPlr, createdLvl)
elseif UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("RANK OLUŞTURULDU", string.format("'%s' (Tier %d) oluşturuldu! Kendi rütbeniz (Tier %d) düşmesin diye korundu; listeden istediğiniz oyuncuya 'Rankı Ver' ile verebilirsiniz.", rName, createdLvl, myRank), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 4)
end
end
RefreshServerInfoModalContent()
end)

local function IsPointInFrame(pt, frame)
if not frame or not frame.Visible then return false end
local fp = frame.AbsolutePosition
local fs = frame.AbsoluteSize
return (pt.X >= fp.X and pt.X <= fp.X + fs.X and pt.Y >= fp.Y and pt.Y <= fp.Y + fs.Y)
end

local pos = input.Position
local insideDock = IsPointInFrame(pos, MainFrame)
local insideOtherAdminUI = IsPointInFrame(pos, UI.TopLeftBadge)
or IsPointInFrame(pos, UI.ServerInfoModal)
or IsPointInFrame(pos, UI.SideCmdsDrawer)
or IsPointInFrame(pos, UI.Topk3kWindow)
or IsPointInFrame(pos, UI.FloatingCircleBtn)
if insideDock then
if State.DockAutoShrunk then
UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(false)
end
elseif not insideOtherAdminUI then
if State.MenuOpen and MainFrame.Visible and not State.DockAutoShrunk and not CmdTextBox:IsFocused() and not State.SettingsPaneOpen then
UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(true)
end
if UI.CmdHoldTooltip then
UI.CmdHoldTooltip.Visible = false
end
end
end
end)
-- [12] KOMUT CALISTIRICI MOTOR & ARAMA KANCALARI
function UI.ExecuteCommandString(rawInput)
local activePfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(LocalPlayer.Name)
local clean = rawInput or ""
if string.sub(clean, 1, #activePfx) == activePfx then
clean = string.sub(clean, #activePfx + 1)
elseif string.sub(clean, 1, 1) == ";" then
clean = string.sub(clean, 2)
end
clean = string.gsub(clean, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
if clean == "" then return end
local parts = Engine.ParseCommandTokensWithQuotes(clean)
local cmdName = string.lower(parts[1] or "")
table.remove(parts, 1)
local args = parts
local resolvedCmd = CommandRegistry[cmdName]
if not resolvedCmd then
for _, c in ipairs(CommandList) do
for _, alias in ipairs(c.Aliases) do
if string.lower(alias) == cmdName then
resolvedCmd = c
break
end
end
if resolvedCmd then break end
end
end
if not resolvedCmd then
PlayUiSound("error")
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("BİLİNMEYEN KOMUT", "UNKNOWN COMMAND"),
string.format(UI.Tr("'%s' komutu bulunamadı.", "Command '%s' not found."), cmdName),
Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
)
return
end
if State.LocalRankLevel < resolvedCmd.MinTier and not Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) then
local reqTier = GetTierData(resolvedCmd.MinTier)
PlayUiSound("error")
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("YETKİ KİLİTLİ", "RANK LOCKED"),
string.format(UI.Tr("'%s' için %s (Tier %d) yetkisi gerekiyor.", "'%s' requires %s (Tier %d)."), resolvedCmd.Name, reqTier.Name, resolvedCmd.MinTier),
Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
)
return
end
PlayUiSound("command")
local rawSelector = args[1] or State.SelectedTargetMode or "me"
if args[1] == nil then
local cmdArgSpec = string.lower(tostring(resolvedCmd.Args or ""))
if resolvedCmd.Name == "adminmode" or resolvedCmd.Name == "locust" or resolvedCmd.Name == "polaria" or resolvedCmd.Name == "topk3k" or resolvedCmd.Name == "patrick" or resolvedCmd.Name == "primadon" or resolvedCmd.Name == "f3x" or cmdArgSpec == "" or (not string.find(cmdArgSpec, "oyuncu") and not string.find(cmdArgSpec, "hedef")) then
rawSelector = "me"
end
elseif tonumber(args[1]) ~= nil then
rawSelector = "me"
end
local targets = ResolveTargetPlayers(rawSelector)
if #targets == 0 then
if args[1] and tonumber(args[1]) == nil then
local cmdArgSpec = string.lower(tostring(resolvedCmd.Args or ""))
if string.find(cmdArgSpec, "<oyuncu") or string.find(cmdArgSpec, "<hedef") or string.find(cmdArgSpec, "isim") then
PlayUiSound("error")
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("OYUNCU BULUNAMADI", "PLAYER NOT FOUND"),
string.format(UI.Tr("'%s' adinda bir oyuncu sunucuda bulunamadi.", "Player '%s' not found in server."), tostring(args[1])),
Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
)
return
end
end
targets = { LocalPlayer }
rawSelector = "me"
end
local filteredTargets = {}
local blockedB1rkt = false
for _, targetPlr in ipairs(targets) do
if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(LocalPlayer, targetPlr) then
blockedB1rkt = true
else
table.insert(filteredTargets, targetPlr)
end
end
if blockedB1rkt then
PlayUiSound("error")
UI.SendNotification(
UI.Tr("B1RKT KORUMA KALKANI", "B1RKT PROTECTION SHIELD"),
UI.Tr("Kurucu B1rkt kendisine komut kullanmanıza izin vermedi!", "Founder B1rkt has not permitted you to use commands on him!"),
Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
3.5
)
if #filteredTargets == 0 then
return
end
end
targets = filteredTargets
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · KOMUT] ;%s calistirildi | Hedef: %s (%d oyuncu)", resolvedCmd.Name, tostring(rawSelector), #targets))
State.IsInsideCommandExecution = true
for _, targetPlr in ipairs(targets) do
local tChar = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character
local tHrp = (tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) or myHrp
local tHum = (tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) or myHum
pcall(function()
resolvedCmd.Action(targetPlr, args, tHrp, tHum, cam)
end)
end
State.IsInsideCommandExecution = false
Engine.BroadcastUniversalP2PCommand(resolvedCmd, args, targets, rawSelector)
UI.SendNotification(
string.upper(resolvedCmd.Name) .. UI.Tr(" ÇALIŞTIRILDI", " EXECUTED"),
string.format(UI.Tr("Hedef: %s (%d oyuncu · P2P Senkron)", "Target: %s (%d players · P2P Synced)"), rawSelector, #targets),
GetTierData(State.LocalRankLevel).Color,
2.5
)
if not State.KeepMenuOpen then
UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(true)
end
end

UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(false)
if State.SettingsPaneOpen then
UI.ToggleSettingsGearDrawer()
end
UI.RefreshCommandListUI(CmdTextBox.Text)
end)
CmdTextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
if enterPressed and #CmdTextBox.Text > 0 then
local txt = CmdTextBox.Text
CmdTextBox.Text = ""
UI.RefreshCommandListUI("")
UI.ExecuteCommandString(txt)
end
end)

UI.ExecuteCommandString(trimmed)
end
end)
end

-- [13.7] COK DETAYLI ARASTIRILMIS HD ADMIN / HOMELANDER CIFT GOZ RAYCAST LAZER SISTEMI
for plrName, active in pairs(State.LaserEyesPlayers) do
if active then
local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
local char = p and p.Character
local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
if head then
local rigName = "BerksLaserRig_" .. plrName
local rig = Workspace:FindFirstChild(rigName)
if not rig then
rig = Instance.new("Model")
rig.Name = rigName
rig.Parent = Workspace
end
local leftOrigin = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.26, 0.16, -0.55)).Position
local rightOrigin = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.26, 0.16, -0.55)).Position
local aimTargetPos = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -140)).Position
if p == LocalPlayer then
local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
if mouse and mouse.Hit then
aimTargetPos = mouse.Hit.Position
elseif cam then
aimTargetPos = cam.CFrame.Position + (cam.CFrame.LookVector * 160)
end
end
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, rig }
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local dirVec = (aimTargetPos - head.Position)
if dirVec.Magnitude < 1 then dirVec = head.CFrame.LookVector * 120 end
local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(head.Position, dirVec.Unit * 180, rayParams)
local hitPos = rayResult and rayResult.Position or (head.Position + dirVec.Unit * 120)
local function updateLaserSegment(segName, startPos, endPos, radius, col, trans)
local seg = rig:FindFirstChild(segName)
if not seg then
seg = Instance.new("Part")
seg.Name = segName
seg.Anchored = true
seg.CanCollide = false
seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
seg.Parent = rig
end
local dist = (endPos - startPos).Magnitude
seg.Size = Vector3.new(radius, radius, dist)
seg.Color = col
seg.Transparency = trans
seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(startPos, endPos) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist / 2)
end
updateLaserSegment("LeftOuter", leftOrigin, hitPos, 0.38, Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), 0.28)
updateLaserSegment("LeftCore", leftOrigin, hitPos, 0.15, Color3.fromRGB(254, 249, 195), 0)
updateLaserSegment("RightOuter", rightOrigin, hitPos, 0.38, Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), 0.28)
updateLaserSegment("RightCore", rightOrigin, hitPos, 0.15, Color3.fromRGB(254, 249, 195), 0)
local impactOrb = rig:FindFirstChild("ImpactOrb")
if not impactOrb then
impactOrb = Instance.new("Part")
impactOrb.Name = "ImpactOrb"
impactOrb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
impactOrb.Anchored = true
impactOrb.CanCollide = false
impactOrb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
impactOrb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(251, 146, 60)
impactOrb.Parent = rig
local pl = Instance.new("PointLight", impactOrb)
pl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
pl.Brightness = 4.5
pl.Range = 16
end
local pulseSz = 1.6 + math.sin(tick() * 35) * 0.45
impactOrb.Size = Vector3.new(pulseSz, pulseSz, pulseSz)
impactOrb.Position = hitPos
if rayResult and rayResult.Instance then
local hitInst = rayResult.Instance
local hitChar = hitInst.Parent
local hitHum = hitChar and hitChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local hitHrp = hitChar and hitChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hitHum and hitHrp and hitChar ~= char then
hitHum:TakeDamage(2.5)
hitHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dirVec.Unit * 55 + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0)
if not hitHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksLaserFire") then
local f = Instance.new("Fire")
f.Name = "BerksLaserFire"
f.Size = 7
f.Parent = hitHrp
task.delay(2.5, function() if f and f.Parent then f:Destroy() end end)
end
elseif not hitInst.Anchored then
hitInst.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dirVec.Unit * 65
hitInst.Color = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 28)
end
end
end
end
end
for plrName, active in pairs(State.SeizurePlayers) do
if active then
local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
local h = p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if h then
h.CFrame = h.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(-25, 25)), math.rad(math.random(-25, 25)), math.rad(math.random(-25, 25)))

end

for plrName, active in pairs(State.GlitchPlayers) do
if active then
local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
local h = p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if h and math.random(1, 3) == 1 then
h.CFrame = h.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-3, 3), 0, math.random(-3, 3))
end
end
end
if (State.WalkFling or State.TouchFling) and myHrp then
local pwr = State.WalkFling and State.WalkFlingPower or State.TouchFlingPower
local origVel = myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = origVel * pwr + Vector3.new(0, pwr, 0)
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
if myHrp and myHrp.Parent then
myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = origVel
end
end
if State.DiscoMode then
local hue = (tick() * 0.45) % 1
Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.3) % 1, 0.85, 1)
end
for plrName, active in pairs(State.RainbowPlayers) do
if active then
local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
if p and p.Character then
local col = Color3.fromHSV((tick() * 0.6) % 1, 0.85, 1)
for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
part.Color = col
end
end
end
end
end
if State.LoopGod and myHum then
myHum.MaxHealth = math.huge
myHum.Health = math.huge
elseif State.SemiGod and myHum then
if myHum.MaxHealth < 5000 then myHum.MaxHealth = 5000 end
if myHum.Health < myHum.MaxHealth then
myHum.Health = math.min(myHum.MaxHealth, myHum.Health + 15)
end
end
if State.LevitateMode and myHrp then
myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,
2.2 + math.sin(tick() * 3.5) * 2.5,
myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
)
end
if State.NoGravMode and myHrp then
local bf = myHrp:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_NoGravForce")
if not bf then
bf = Instance.new("BodyForce")
bf.Name = "Topk3k_NoGravForce"
bf.Parent = myHrp
end
bf.Force = Vector3.new(0, (myHrp.AssemblyMass or 15) * Workspace.Gravity * 0.96, 0)
elseif myHrp and myHrp:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_NoGravForce") then
myHrp.Topk3k_NoGravForce:Destroy()
end
end)

  -- ==========================================================================
  -- 2. F3X BUILDING TOOLS ("Building Tools by F3X" - 3D Handles + ArcHandles + CANLI 1:1 P2P SENKRON)
  -- ==========================================================================
  local F3XState = {
    SelectedPart = nil,
    Mode = "Move",
    Step = 1.0,
    ColorIndex = 1,
    MaterialIndex = 1,
    History = {},
    SelectionBox = nil,
    MoveHandles = nil,
    ArcHandles = nil,
    DockGui = nil,
    DragStartCF = nil,
    DragStartSize = nil,
    LastBroadcastedMoveSnap = 0,
    LastBroadcastedResizeSnap = 0,
    LastBroadcastedRotDeg = 0,
    LastDragPacketTick = 0,
    PartRegistryById = {},
    PeerSelectedParts = {},
    PeerSelectionBoxes = {}
  }

  local F3XPalette = {
    { Name = "Cyan", Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233) },
    { Name = "Purple", Color = Color3.fromRGB(129, 26, 255) },
    { Name = "Crimson", Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) },
    { Name = "Emerald", Color = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94) },
    { Name = "Gold", Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21) },
    { Name = "Orange", Color = Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22) },
    { Name = "Pink", Color = Color3.fromRGB(236, 72, 153) },
    { Name = "White", Color = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252) },
    { Name = "Dark", Color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 27) },
    { Name = "RoyalBlue", Color = Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235) }
  }

  local F3XMaterials = {
    Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
    Enum.Material.Neon,
    Enum.Material.ForceField,
    Enum.Material.Glass,
    Enum.Material.Metal,
    Enum.Material.DiamondPlate,
    Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
    Enum.Material.Ice,
    Enum.Material.Grass
  }

  local F3XLimbCodes = {
    Head = 1,
    HumanoidRootPart = 2,
    Torso = 3,
    UpperTorso = 3,
    LowerTorso = 4,
    ["Left Arm"] = 5,
    LeftUpperArm = 5,
    LeftLowerArm = 6,
    LeftHand = 6,
    ["Right Arm"] = 7,
    RightUpperArm = 7,
    RightLowerArm = 8,
    RightHand = 8,
    ["Left Leg"] = 9,
    LeftUpperLeg = 9,
    LeftLowerLeg = 10,
    LeftFoot = 10,
    ["Right Leg"] = 11,
    RightUpperLeg = 11,
    RightLowerLeg = 12,
    RightFoot = 12
  }

  -- Her parca icin hareket etse veya boyutu degisse bile ASLA degismeyen deterministik PartId (1..999) uretir:
  function Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return 0 end
    local existingId = part:GetAttribute("F3X_PartId")
    if existingId and existingId >= 1 and existingId <= 999 then
      F3XState.PartRegistryById[existingId] = part
      return existingId
    end

    -- 1) Spawn edilen F3X / Topk3k bloklari: Topk3k_P2PBlock_<N> -> 701..999
    local blkIdx = string.match(part.Name, "^Topk3k_P2PBlock_(%d+)$")
    if blkIdx then
      local pid = 701 + ((tonumber(blkIdx) - 1) % 298)
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", pid)
      F3XState.PartRegistryById[pid] = part
      return pid
    end

    -- 2) Oyuncu karakter uzuvlari (Head, Torso, Arm, Leg vb.) -> 501..699
    local charModel = part.Parent
    local charPlr = charModel and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(charModel)
    if not charPlr and charModel and charModel.Parent then
      charPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(charModel.Parent)
      if charPlr then charModel = charModel.Parent end
    end
    if charPlr then
      local slot = math.clamp(Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(charPlr.Name), 1, 15)
      local limbCode = F3XLimbCodes[part.Name] or ((string.byte(part.Name, 1) or 1) % 12 + 1)
      local pid = 500 + ((slot - 1) * 13) + limbCode
      pid = math.clamp(pid, 501, 699)
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", pid)
      F3XState.PartRegistryById[pid] = part
      return pid
    end

    -- 3) Harita parcalari: Ilk dokunulmamis koordinati ve boyutundan 1..500 arasi sabit ID:
    if not part:GetAttribute("F3X_InitPosX") then
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_InitPosX", math.floor(part.Position.X + 0.5))
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_InitPosY", math.floor(part.Position.Y + 0.5))
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_InitPosZ", math.floor(part.Position.Z + 0.5))
    end
    local ix = part:GetAttribute("F3X_InitPosX") or 0
    local iy = part:GetAttribute("F3X_InitPosY") or 0
    local iz = part:GetAttribute("F3X_InitPosZ") or 0
    local b1 = string.byte(part.Name, 1) or 65
    local b2 = string.byte(part.Name, #part.Name) or 90
    local hash = (math.abs(ix + 4096) * 97 + math.abs(iy + 1024) * 53 + math.abs(iz + 4096) * 29 + b1 * 13 + b2 * 7) % 499 + 1
    part:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", hash)
    F3XState.PartRegistryById[hash] = part
    return hash
  end

  function Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(partId, senderPlr)
    local pid = tonumber(partId) or 0
    if pid <= 0 then
      if senderPlr and F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[senderPlr.Name] then
        local cached = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[senderPlr.Name]
        if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local direct = F3XState.PartRegistryById[pid]
    if direct and direct.Parent then
      return direct
    end
    -- Eger 701..999 arasi bir F3X blogu ise:
    if pid >= 701 and pid <= 999 then
      local blkNum = pid - 700
      local foundBlk = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_P2PBlock_" .. tostring(blkNum))
      if foundBlk and foundBlk:IsA("BasePart") then
        foundBlk:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", pid)
        F3XState.PartRegistryById[pid] = foundBlk
        return foundBlk
      end
    end
    -- Tum Workspace'te tara ve ID eslesmesini bul:
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
      if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsA("Terrain") then
        if Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(obj) == pid then
          return obj
        end
      end
    end
    if senderPlr and F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[senderPlr.Name] then
      local fallback = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[senderPlr.Name]
      if fallback and fallback.Parent then return fallback end
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function F3X_SendPacket(packetInt, channelIdx)
    if Engine.BroadcastRawP2PPacketInt then
      Engine.BroadcastRawP2PPacketInt(packetInt, channelIdx or 1)
    elseif Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack then
      Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, channelIdx or 1)
    end
  end

  -- Secili parca karakter veya model ise onlari da 1:1 olcekleyen yardimci:
  local function F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(part, newSizeVec, axisDir, snapOffset, fromP2P, senderPlr)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return end
    local sx = math.clamp(newSizeVec.X, 0.2, 240)
    local sy = math.clamp(newSizeVec.Y, 0.2, 240)
    local sz = math.clamp(newSizeVec.Z, 0.2, 240)
    part.Size = Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz)
    if axisDir and snapOffset then
      part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(axisDir * (snapOffset * 0.5))
    end
    -- Eger buyutulen parca bir oyuncunun Kafasi (Head) ise SpecialMesh / HeadScale de guncellensin:
    local charPlr = part.Parent and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(part.Parent)
    if charPlr and part.Name == "Head" then
      local headFactor = math.clamp(sy / 1.0, 0.25, 12.0)
      local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
      if mesh then
        if not mesh:GetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleX") then
          mesh:SetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleX", mesh.Scale.X)
          mesh:SetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleY", mesh.Scale.Y)
          mesh:SetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleZ", mesh.Scale.Z)
        end
        mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(
          (mesh:GetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleX") or 1.25) * (sx / 2.0),
          (mesh:GetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleY") or 1.25) * headFactor,
          (mesh:GetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleZ") or 1.25) * (sz / 1.0)
        )
      end
      if not fromP2P and Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor then
        Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor(charPlr.Character, headFactor, false, charPlr)
      end
    end
  end

  -- Gercek Zamanli F3X P2P Paket Alicisi (200,000 .. 449,999):
  function Engine.HandleIncomingF3XRealtimePacket(sender, packetInt)
    if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
    local pkt = tonumber(packetInt) or 0
    if pkt < 200000 or pkt > 499999 then return end

    -- 1) [200,000 .. 209,999] +Part Spawn (Renk + PartId):
    if pkt >= 200000 and pkt <= 209999 then
      local rem = pkt - 200000
      local colIdx = math.clamp(math.floor(rem / 1000), 1, #F3XPalette)
      local assignedId = rem % 1000
      local spawned = Engine.Topk3k_SpawnP2PBlock(sender, colIdx, assignedId)
      if spawned then
        F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name] = spawned
      end
      return
    end

    -- 2) [210,000 .. 210,999] Parca Secimi (Peer Selection Sync):
    if pkt >= 210000 and pkt <= 210999 then
      local pid = pkt - 210000
      local targetPart = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if targetPart then
        F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name] = targetPart
        pcall(function()
          if F3XState.PeerSelectionBoxes[sender.Name] then
            F3XState.PeerSelectionBoxes[sender.Name]:Destroy()
          end
          local sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
          sb.Name = "F3X_PeerBox_" .. sender.Name
          sb.Adornee = targetPart
          sb.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
          sb.LineThickness = 0.04
          sb.Parent = Workspace
          F3XState.PeerSelectionBoxes[sender.Name] = sb
        end)
      end
      return
    end

    -- 3) [220,000 .. 249,999] Canli Move Delta (Axis 0..2, Sign 0..1, MagTen 1..4999):
    if pkt >= 220000 and pkt <= 249999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      if not p or not p.Parent then return end
      local rem = pkt - 220000
      local axisIdx = math.floor(rem / 10000)
      local rem2 = rem % 10000
      local signIdx = math.floor(rem2 / 5000)
      local magTen = rem2 % 5000
      local delta = (magTen / 10.0) * ((signIdx == 1) and 1 or -1)
      local moveVec = (axisIdx == 0 and Vector3.new(delta, 0, 0))
        or (axisIdx == 1 and Vector3.new(0, delta, 0))
        or Vector3.new(0, 0, delta)
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(moveVec)
      return
    end

    -- 4) [250,000 .. 269,999] Kesin Konum Senkronu (Sender HRP'ye gore X/Y/Z offset):
    if pkt >= 250000 and pkt <= 269999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      local sHrp = sender.Character and sender.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not p or not p.Parent or not sHrp then return end
      local code = pkt - 250000
      local qx = math.floor(code / 729)
      local rem = code % 729
      local qy = math.floor(rem / 27)
      local qz = rem % 27
      local ox = (qx - 13) * 2.0
      local oy = (qy - 13) * 2.0
      local oz = (qz - 13) * 2.0
      local rotOnly = p.CFrame - p.CFrame.Position
      p.CFrame = CFrame.new(sHrp.Position + Vector3.new(ox, oy, oz)) * rotOnly
      return
    end

    -- 5) [270,000 .. 299,999] Canli Resize Delta (Axis 0..2, Sign 0..1, MagTen 1..4999):
    if pkt >= 270000 and pkt <= 299999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      if not p or not p.Parent then return end
      local rem = pkt - 270000
      local axisIdx = math.floor(rem / 10000)
      local rem2 = rem % 10000
      local signIdx = math.floor(rem2 / 5000)
      local magTen = rem2 % 5000
      local delta = (magTen / 10.0) * ((signIdx == 1) and 1 or -1)
      local dVec = (axisIdx == 0 and Vector3.new(delta, 0, 0))
        or (axisIdx == 1 and Vector3.new(0, delta, 0))
        or Vector3.new(0, 0, delta)
      local ns = p.Size + dVec
      F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, ns, nil, nil, true, sender)
      return
    end

    -- 6) [300,000 .. 339,999] Kesin Boyut Senkronu (Exact Size X/Y/Z veya Karakter Olcegi):
    if pkt >= 300000 and pkt <= 339999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      if not p or not p.Parent then return end
      local code = pkt - 300000
      local qx = math.floor(code / 1024)
      local rem = code % 1024
      local qy = math.floor(rem / 32)
      local qz = rem % 32
      local sx = math.max(0.5, qx * 1.5)
      local sy = math.max(0.5, qy * 1.5)
      local sz = math.max(0.5, qz * 1.5)
      F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz), nil, nil, true, sender)
      return
    end

    -- 7) [340,000 .. 369,999] Canli Rotate Delta (Axis 0..2, Deg 0..359):
    if pkt >= 340000 and pkt <= 369999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      if not p or not p.Parent then return end
      local rem = pkt - 340000
      local axisIdx = math.floor(rem / 10000)
      local deg = rem % 10000
      if deg > 180 then deg = deg - 360 end
      local rad = math.rad(deg)
      local rotCF = (axisIdx == 0 and CFrame.Angles(rad, 0, 0))
        or (axisIdx == 1 and CFrame.Angles(0, rad, 0))
        or CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad)
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * rotCF
      return
    end

    -- 8) [370,000 .. 389,999] Model / Karakter Tam Olcek (Uniform Scale 0.2x .. 25.0x):
    if pkt >= 370000 and pkt <= 389999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      local scaleVal = math.clamp((pkt - 370000) / 20.0, 0.1, 30.0)
      if p and p.Parent then
        local charPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(p.Parent)
        if charPlr and charPlr.Character then
          Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(charPlr.Character, scaleVal)
        else
          F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, Vector3.new(6 * scaleVal, 6 * scaleVal, 6 * scaleVal), nil, nil, true, sender)
        end
      end
      return
    end

    -- 9) [390,000 .. 414,999] Paint (Renk Degisimi: partId * 20 + colIdx):
    if pkt >= 390000 and pkt <= 414999 then
      local rem = pkt - 390000
      local pid = math.floor(rem / 20)
      local colIdx = (rem % 20)
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p and F3XPalette[colIdx] then
        p.Color = F3XPalette[colIdx].Color
      end
      return
    end

    -- 10) [415,000 .. 431,999] Surface / Material (partId * 15 + matIdx):
    if pkt >= 415000 and pkt <= 431999 then
      local rem = pkt - 415000
      local pid = math.floor(rem / 15)
      local matIdx = (rem % 15)
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p and F3XMaterials[matIdx] then
        p.Material = F3XMaterials[matIdx]
      end
      return
    end

    -- 11) [432,000 .. 434,999] Anchor Toggle (partId * 2 + anchorBit):
    if pkt >= 432000 and pkt <= 434999 then
      local rem = pkt - 432000
      local pid = math.floor(rem / 2)
      local isAnc = (rem % 2) == 1
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p then
        p.Anchored = isAnc
      end
      return
    end

    -- 12) [435,000 .. 436,999] FX Toggle (Fire + PointLight):
    if pkt >= 435000 and pkt <= 436999 then
      local pid = pkt - 435000
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p then
        local fl = p:FindFirstChild("F3X_Fire")
        if fl then
          fl:Destroy()
          local pl = p:FindFirstChild("F3X_Light")
          if pl then pl:Destroy() end
        else
          local fire = Instance.new("Fire", p)
          fire.Name = "F3X_Fire"
          fire.Size = 8
          local pl = Instance.new("PointLight", p)
          pl.Name = "F3X_Light"
          pl.Range = 24
          pl.Brightness = 3
          pl.Color = p.Color
        end
      end
      return
    end

    -- 13) [438,000 .. 439,999] Clone Part:
    if pkt >= 438000 and pkt <= 439999 then
      local pid = pkt - 438000
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p and p.Parent then
        State.SpawnedBlocksCount = (State.SpawnedBlocksCount or 0) + 1
        local newId = 701 + ((State.SpawnedBlocksCount - 1) % 298)
        local cl = p:Clone()
        cl.Name = "Topk3k_P2PBlock_" .. tostring(State.SpawnedBlocksCount)
        cl.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, p.Size.Y, 0)
        cl:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", newId)
        cl.Parent = Workspace
        F3XState.PartRegistryById[newId] = cl
        F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name] = cl
      end
      return
    end

    -- 14) [440,000 .. 441,999] Delete Part by F3X_PartId:
    if pkt >= 440000 and pkt <= 441999 then
      local pid = pkt - 440000
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p and p.Parent then
        table.insert(State.DeletedPartsBackup, {
          Part = p,
          Parent = p.Parent,
          CFrame = p.CFrame,
          Transparency = p.Transparency,
          CanCollide = p.CanCollide,
          Anchored = p.Anchored
        })
        p.Parent = nil
        PlayUiSound("explosion")
      end
      return
    end

    -- 15) [449,999] Undo:
    if pkt == 449999 then
      Engine.Topk3k_RestoreDeletedParts()
      return
    end
  end

  function Engine.HandleIncomingF3XSync(sender, opCode)
    local code = tonumber(opCode) or 1
    if code >= 10 and code <= 19 then
      local spawned = Engine.Topk3k_SpawnP2PBlock(sender, code - 9)
      if spawned and sender then
        F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name] = spawned
      end
    elseif code == 20 then
      Engine.Topk3k_DeletePartByHash(sender, nil)
    elseif code >= 100 and code <= 8999 then
      Engine.Topk3k_DeletePartByHash(sender, code)
    elseif code == 30 then
      Engine.Topk3k_BuildP2PTrowelWall(sender)
    elseif code == 40 then
      Engine.Topk3k_RestoreDeletedParts()
    end
  end

  local function F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    local pid = Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(part)
    if pid > 0 then
      F3X_SendPacket(210000 + pid, 1)
    end
  end

  local function F3X_BroadcastMoveDelta(axisVec, deltaStuds)
    if math.abs(deltaStuds) < 0.05 then return end
    local axisIdx = (math.abs(axisVec.X) > 0.5 and 0) or (math.abs(axisVec.Y) > 0.5 and 1) or 2
    local signedDelta = (axisIdx == 0 and (axisVec.X * deltaStuds))
      or (axisIdx == 1 and (axisVec.Y * deltaStuds))
      or (axisVec.Z * deltaStuds)
    local signIdx = (signedDelta >= 0) and 1 or 0
    local magTen = math.clamp(math.floor(math.abs(signedDelta) * 10 + 0.5), 1, 4999)
    F3X_SendPacket(220000 + (axisIdx * 10000) + (signIdx * 5000) + magTen, 2)
  end

  local function F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(axisVec, deltaStuds, part)
    if math.abs(deltaStuds) < 0.05 then return end
    local axisIdx = (math.abs(axisVec.X) > 0.5 and 0) or (math.abs(axisVec.Y) > 0.5 and 1) or 2
    local signedDelta = (axisIdx == 0 and (axisVec.X * deltaStuds))
      or (axisIdx == 1 and (axisVec.Y * deltaStuds))
      or (axisVec.Z * deltaStuds)
    local signIdx = (signedDelta >= 0) and 1 or 0
    local magTen = math.clamp(math.floor(math.abs(signedDelta) * 10 + 0.5), 1, 4999)
    F3X_SendPacket(270000 + (axisIdx * 10000) + (signIdx * 5000) + magTen, 2)
  end

  local function F3X_BroadcastRotateDelta(axisVec, degDelta)
    if math.abs(degDelta) < 1 then return end
    local axisIdx = (math.abs(axisVec.X) > 0.5 and 0) or (math.abs(axisVec.Y) > 0.5 and 1) or 2
    local signedDeg = (axisIdx == 0 and (axisVec.X * degDelta))
      or (axisIdx == 1 and (axisVec.Y * degDelta))
      or (axisVec.Z * degDelta)
    local normDeg = math.floor(signedDeg + 0.5) % 360
    if normDeg < 0 then normDeg = normDeg + 360 end
    F3X_SendPacket(340000 + (axisIdx * 10000) + normDeg, 3)
  end

  local function F3X_ClearGizmos()
    if F3XState.SelectionBox then pcall(function() F3XState.SelectionBox:Destroy() end); F3XState.SelectionBox = nil end
    if F3XState.MoveHandles then pcall(function() F3XState.MoveHandles:Destroy() end); F3XState.MoveHandles = nil end
    if F3XState.ArcHandles then pcall(function() F3XState.ArcHandles:Destroy() end); F3XState.ArcHandles = nil end
  end

  local function F3X_AttachGizmos(part)
    F3X_ClearGizmos()
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.Parent then return end
    Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(part)
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or UI.ScreenGui
    if not pg then return end

    local sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
    sb.Name = "F3X_SelectionBox"
    sb.Adornee = part
    sb.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 176, 0)
    sb.SurfaceColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 176, 0)
    sb.SurfaceTransparency = 0.85
    sb.LineThickness = 0.04
    sb.Parent = pg
    F3XState.SelectionBox = sb

    if F3XState.Mode == "Move" or F3XState.Mode == "Resize" or F3XState.Mode == "Scale" then
      local h = Instance.new("Handles")
      h.Name = "F3X_Handles"
      h.Adornee = part
      h.Style = (F3XState.Mode == "Move") and Enum.HandlesStyle.Movement or Enum.HandlesStyle.Resize
      h.Color3 = (F3XState.Mode == "Move") and Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
        or (F3XState.Mode == "Scale" and Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94))
      h.Parent = pg
      F3XState.MoveHandles = h

      h.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        if F3XState.SelectedPart then
          F3XState.DragStartCF = F3XState.SelectedPart.CFrame
          F3XState.DragStartSize = F3XState.SelectedPart.Size
          F3XState.LastBroadcastedMoveSnap = 0
          F3XState.LastBroadcastedResizeSnap = 0
          F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        end
      end)

      h.MouseDrag:Connect(function(face, distance)
        local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
        if not p or not p.Parent or not F3XState.DragStartCF then return end
        local snap = math.floor((distance / F3XState.Step) + 0.5) * F3XState.Step
        local dir = Vector3.FromNormalId(face)
        local now = tick()
        if F3XState.Mode == "Move" then
          p.CFrame = F3XState.DragStartCF * CFrame.new(dir * snap)
          local diff = snap - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedMoveSnap or 0)
          if math.abs(diff) >= 0.5 and (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.045 then
            F3XState.LastBroadcastedMoveSnap = snap
            F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
            F3X_BroadcastMoveDelta(dir, diff)
          end
        elseif F3XState.Mode == "Resize" then
          local axisDelta = Vector3.new(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Y), math.abs(dir.Z)) * snap
          local newSize = F3XState.DragStartSize + axisDelta
          p.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.5, newSize.X), math.max(0.5, newSize.Y), math.max(0.5, newSize.Z))
          p.CFrame = F3XState.DragStartCF * CFrame.new(dir * (snap * 0.5))
          local diff = snap - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedResizeSnap or 0)
          if math.abs(diff) >= 0.5 and (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.045 then
            F3XState.LastBroadcastedResizeSnap = snap
            F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
            local absDir = Vector3.new(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Y), math.abs(dir.Z))
            F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(absDir, diff, p)
          end
        elseif F3XState.Mode == "Scale" then
          local charPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(p.Parent)
          local factor = math.clamp(1.0 + (snap * 0.15), 0.2, 20.0)
          if charPlr and charPlr.Character then
            Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(charPlr.Character, factor)
            if (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.08 then
              F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
              Engine.SetP2PCharacterScale(charPlr, factor)
            end
          else
            local newSz = F3XState.DragStartSize * factor
            p.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.5, newSz.X), math.max(0.5, newSz.Y), math.max(0.5, newSz.Z))
            if (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.08 then
              F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
              F3X_SendPacket(370000 + math.clamp(math.floor(factor * 20 + 0.5), 2, 600), 2)
            end
          end
        end
      end)

      h.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function(face)
        local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
        if not p or not p.Parent then return end
        local dir = face and Vector3.FromNormalId(face) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        if F3XState.Mode == "Move" and F3XState.DragStartCF then
          local totalMoved = (p.Position - F3XState.DragStartCF.Position)
          local projected = totalMoved.X * dir.X + totalMoved.Y * dir.Y + totalMoved.Z * dir.Z
          local remDiff = projected - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedMoveSnap or 0)
          if math.abs(remDiff) >= 0.1 then
            F3X_BroadcastMoveDelta(dir, remDiff)
          end
        elseif F3XState.Mode == "Resize" and F3XState.DragStartSize then
          local absDir = Vector3.new(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Y), math.abs(dir.Z))
          local totalSized = (p.Size.X - F3XState.DragStartSize.X) * absDir.X
            + (p.Size.Y - F3XState.DragStartSize.Y) * absDir.Y
            + (p.Size.Z - F3XState.DragStartSize.Z) * absDir.Z
          local remDiff = totalSized - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedResizeSnap or 0)
          if math.abs(remDiff) >= 0.1 then
            F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(absDir, remDiff, p)
          end
          F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, p.Size, nil, nil, false, LocalPlayer)
        end
      end)
    elseif F3XState.Mode == "Rotate" then
      local ah = Instance.new("ArcHandles")
      ah.Name = "F3X_ArcHandles"
      ah.Adornee = part
      ah.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22)
      ah.Parent = pg
      F3XState.ArcHandles = ah

      ah.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        if F3XState.SelectedPart then
          F3XState.DragStartCF = F3XState.SelectedPart.CFrame
          F3XState.LastBroadcastedRotDeg = 0
          F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        end
      end)
      ah.MouseDrag:Connect(function(axis, relativeAngle)
        local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
        if not p or not p.Parent or not F3XState.DragStartCF then return end
        local degSnap = math.floor((math.deg(relativeAngle) / 15) + 0.5) * 15
        local radSnap = math.rad(degSnap)
        local axisVec = Vector3.FromAxis(axis)
        local rotVec = axisVec * radSnap
        p.CFrame = F3XState.DragStartCF * CFrame.Angles(rotVec.X, rotVec.Y, rotVec.Z)
        local diffDeg = degSnap - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedRotDeg or 0)
        local now = tick()
        if math.abs(diffDeg) >= 15 and (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.045 then
          F3XState.LastBroadcastedRotDeg = degSnap
          F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
          F3X_BroadcastRotateDelta(axisVec, diffDeg)
        end
      end)
      ah.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function(axis)
        local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
        if not p or not p.Parent then return end
        local diffDeg = (F3XState.LastBroadcastedRotDeg or 0)
        if axis and math.abs(diffDeg) > 0 then
          F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(p)
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  local function F3X_NudgeSelected(axisVec, sign)
    local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
    if not p or not p.Parent then return end
    F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(p)
    local stepVal = F3XState.Step * sign
    local d = axisVec * stepVal
    if F3XState.Mode == "Move" then
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(d)
      F3X_BroadcastMoveDelta(axisVec, stepVal)
    elseif F3XState.Mode == "Resize" then
      local ns = p.Size + d
      F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, ns, nil, nil, false, LocalPlayer)
      F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(axisVec, stepVal, p)
    elseif F3XState.Mode == "Scale" then
      local charPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(p.Parent)
      if charPlr and charPlr.Character then
        local curScale = charPlr.Character:GetAttribute("BerksAppliedScale") or 1.0
        local nextScale = math.clamp(curScale + (0.25 * sign), 0.2, 20.0)
        Engine.SetP2PCharacterScale(charPlr, nextScale)
      else
        local ns = p.Size * ((sign > 0) and 1.2 or 0.8)
        F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, ns, nil, nil, false, LocalPlayer)
        F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), ns.X - p.Size.X, p)
        F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), ns.Y - p.Size.Y, p)
        F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), ns.Z - p.Size.Z, p)
      end
    elseif F3XState.Mode == "Rotate" then
      local deg = 15 * sign
      local ang = math.rad(deg)
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(axisVec.X * ang, axisVec.Y * ang, axisVec.Z * ang)
      F3X_BroadcastRotateDelta(axisVec, deg)
    end
  end

        b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        b.TextSize = 10
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        b.Text = ac.L
        b.ZIndex = 161
        Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
        b.Activated:Connect(function()
          PlayUiSound("click")
          ac.Fn()
        end)
      end

      F3XState.DockGui = dock
      return dock
    end

    local mouseConn = nil
    local keyConn = nil

    tool.Equipped:Connect(function(mouse)
      local dock = EnsureF3XDock()
      if dock then dock.Visible = true end
      F3X_AttachGizmos(F3XState.SelectedPart)

      if mouse then
        mouseConn = mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
          local target = mouse.Target
          if target and target:IsA("BasePart") and not target:IsA("Terrain") then
            F3XState.SelectedPart = target
            local pid = Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(target)
            F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(target)
            if F3XState.Mode == "Paint" then
              target.Color = F3XPalette[F3XState.ColorIndex].Color
              F3X_SendPacket(390000 + (pid * 20) + F3XState.ColorIndex, 1)
            elseif F3XState.Mode == "Material" then
              target.Material = F3XMaterials[F3XState.MaterialIndex]
              F3X_SendPacket(415000 + (pid * 15) + F3XState.MaterialIndex, 1)
            end
            F3X_AttachGizmos(target)
            PlayUiSound("click")
          end
        end)
      end

      keyConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
        if gp then return end
        if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then F3XState.Mode = "Move"; F3X_AttachGizmos(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then F3XState.Mode = "Resize"; F3X_AttachGizmos(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M then F3XState.Mode = "Scale"; F3X_AttachGizmos(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then F3XState.Mode = "Rotate"; F3X_AttachGizmos(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then F3XState.Mode = "Paint"
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then F3XState.Mode = "Material"
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.J then
          local newest = Engine.Topk3k_SpawnP2PBlock(LocalPlayer, F3XState.ColorIndex)
          if newest then
            local pid = Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(newest)
            F3XState.SelectedPart = newest
            F3X_AttachGizmos(newest)
            F3X_SendPacket(200000 + (F3XState.ColorIndex * 1000) + pid, 1)
          end
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
          local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
          if p and p.Parent then
            local pid = Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(p)
            p.Parent = nil
            F3XState.SelectedPart = nil
            F3X_ClearGizmos()
            F3X_SendPacket(440000 + pid, 1)
          end
        end
      end)
    end)

    tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
      if mouseConn then mouseConn:Disconnect(); mouseConn = nil end
      if keyConn then keyConn:Disconnect(); keyConn = nil end
      if F3XState.DockGui then F3XState.DockGui.Visible = false end
      F3X_ClearGizmos()
    end)

    tool.Parent = bp
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end) end
  end

            d.Anchored = true

          end

        h.Anchored = true
        h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

          (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45

      local progress = math.clamp(1 - (dist / totalStartDist), 0, 1)

            "\n[0x17161264706 // PATRICK_CONSUMPTION_PROTOCOL]\n" ..
            "Karanlığın içinde nefes aldığını duyabiliyorum.\n" ..
            "Bacakların neden hareket etmedi sanıyorsun? Onlar artık senin değil.\n" ..
            "Gözlerini kapattığında gördüğün o pembe silüet ekranın içinden çıkmadı.\n" ..
            "Şu an tam arkanda duruyor. Sakın arkana dönme. Çok geç.\n" ..
            "[OTURUM_KARANLIK_TARAFINDAN_SONLANDIRILDI]"
          )
        end)
      end
    end)
